Viña del Mar Agreement (Acuerdo Latinoam: विना डेल मार समझौता (एकुएर्डो लैटिनोअमेरिकानो) की स्थापना - लैटिन अमेरिका का पहला क्षेत्रीय PSC समझौता

विना डेल मार समझौता (एकुएर्डो लातिनोअमेरिकानो) लैटिन अमेरिका का पहला क्षेत्रीय बंदरगाह राज्य नियंत्रण समझौता है, जो 14 सदस्य देशों के साथ दक्षिण, मध्य अमेरिका और कैरेबियन में नियंत्रण का समन्वय करता है। इसकी स्थापना पेरिस एमओयू मॉडल से प्रेरित होकर की गई थी और यह CIALA क्षेत्रीय सूचना प्रणाली के माध्यम से ऑडिट डेटा साझा करता है। इस क्षेत्र में एक अद्वितीय गतिशीलता है: पनामा, जिसके पास दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी जहाज रजिस्ट्री है, इस भूगोल में स्थित है, इसलिए इस क्षेत्र में बंदरगाह राज्य और ध्वज राज्य दोनों भूमिकाओं की गहन बातचीत होती है।
Viña del Mar Agreement bölgesinin kendin: विना डेल मार समझौता क्षेत्र की एक अनूठी गतिशीलता यह है कि पनामा, जिसके पास दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी जहाज रजिस्ट्री है, यहीं स्थित है। इससे क्षेत्र में ध्वज राज्य और बंदरगाह राज्य की भूमिकाओं का गहरा अंतर्संबंध होता है: क्षेत्र को पार करने वाले जहाजों का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा पनामा-ध्वजांकित है, इसलिए ये जहाज अपने स्वयं के ध्वज राज्य दायित्वों और कॉल के बंदरगाह के PSC निरीक्षण दोनों के अधीन हैं। पनामा-ध्वजांकित जहाजों के लिए, यह सुनिश्चित करना विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है कि उनके ध्वज राज्य निरीक्षण और प्रमाणन प्रक्रियाएं बंदरगाह राज्य की अपेक्षाओं के अनुरूप हों। यह संदर्भ सुनिश्चित करता है कि क्षेत्रीय PSC न केवल विदेशी झंडों का निरीक्षण करता है बल्कि विश्व स्तर पर व्यापक ध्वज रजिस्ट्री की गुणवत्ता से सीधे संबंधित है।
Viña del Mar Agreement'in 14 üye devleti: विना डेल मार समझौते के 14 सदस्य देश पर्यवेक्षी क्षमता और संसाधन स्तर के मामले में व्यापक रूप से शामिल हैं: ब्राजील और मैक्सिको जैसे बड़े और अपेक्षाकृत विकसित समुद्री प्रशासन से लेकर अधिक सीमित वित्तीय और मानव संसाधनों वाले छोटे कैरेबियन और मध्य अमेरिकी राज्यों तक। यह अंतर ऑडिटर प्रशिक्षण स्तर, ऑडिट उपकरण तक पहुंच और यहां तक कि लगातार जोखिम प्रोफ़ाइल गणना कैसे लागू की जाती है, में असमानताएं पैदा कर सकता है। CIALA इस अंतर को दो तरीकों से बंद करने का प्रयास करता है: पहला, यह सभी सदस्यों को क्षेत्रीय सूचना प्रणाली के माध्यम से समान ऑडिट डेटा और कमी कोड तक पहुंच प्रदान करके एक न्यूनतम आम भाषा बनाता है; दूसरा, IMO के तकनीकी सहयोग कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से अधिक अनुभवी सदस्य प्रशासनों से ऑडिटर प्रशिक्षक और सामान्य चेकलिस्ट प्रदान किए जाते हैं। यह प्रयास रैखिक और तीव्र नहीं है - क्षमता अंतराल पूरी तरह से बंद नहीं हुआ है - लेकिन इसका उद्देश्य समय के साथ क्षेत्र में ऑडिट गुणवत्ता को और अधिक सुसंगत रेखा के करीब लाना है; इस प्रकार, जहाज किस सदस्य बंदरगाह पर कॉल करता है, इससे उसके सामने आने वाली निरीक्षण कठोरता में महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव नहीं आना चाहिए।
Viña del Mar bölgesini diğer MoU'lardan: सबसे खास बात जो विना डेल मार क्षेत्र को अन्य एमओयू से अलग करती है, वह यह है कि पनामा, जिसके पास दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी जहाज रजिस्ट्री है, भौगोलिक रूप से इस एमओयू के संचालन क्षेत्र के भीतर एक ध्वज राज्य और एक बंदरगाह राज्य दोनों है। अधिकांश बड़ी खुली रजिस्ट्रियों (जैसे पनामा, मार्शल द्वीप, लाइबेरिया) में ध्वज राज्य का कार्य भौगोलिक रूप से उस क्षेत्र से अलग होता है जिसमें जहाज वास्तव में चलता है; लेकिन पनामा के मामले में यह भेद मिट जाता है। एक पनामा-ध्वज वाला जहाज पनामा नहर को पार कर रहा है और क्षेत्रीय बंदरगाहों पर कॉल कर रहा है, एक साथ दो अलग-अलग निरीक्षण लेंस के तहत है: अपने स्वयं के ध्वज का प्रमाणीकरण और निरीक्षण जिम्मेदारी और विना डेल मार सदस्य बंदरगाह राज्य का PSC निरीक्षण - और यह बंदरगाह राज्य अक्सर पनामा ही हो सकता है। यह दोहरी स्थिति पनामा को अपनी रजिस्ट्री की गुणवत्ता बनाए रखने के लिए अतिरिक्त प्रेरणा देती है, क्योंकि इसकी रजिस्ट्री में एक जहाज को अपने ही बंदरगाह में रोकना सीधे रजिस्ट्री की अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतिष्ठा को प्रभावित करता है। क्षेत्र के अन्य सदस्य देशों के लिए, यह स्थिति पनामा के झंडों के साथ भारी यातायात के कारण परिचित होने और सावधानीपूर्वक निगरानी करने की आवश्यकता पैदा करती है।

Yük hattı çizgisinin ihlali, teorik bir: लोड लाइन लाइन का उल्लंघन करने से सैद्धांतिक नियम के उल्लंघन की तुलना में कहीं अधिक गंभीर परिणाम होते हैं। यदि किसी जहाज का लोड लाइन चिह्न बंदरगाह राज्य नियंत्रण के तहत डूबा हुआ पाया जाता है, तो इसे PSC निरीक्षण में कमियों की सबसे गंभीर श्रेणियों में से एक माना जाता है और आमतौर पर सीधे हिरासत में लिया जाता है, जहाज को बंदरगाह छोड़ने की अनुमति नहीं दी जाती है जब तक कि वह अतिरिक्त माल नहीं उतारता है या अपनी गिट्टी को समायोजित नहीं करता है। बीमा और पी एंड आई क्लबों के लिए परिणाम भी गंभीर हैं: नीतिगत शर्तों के लिए अक्सर जहाज को कानूनी लोड लाइन सीमा के भीतर चलाने की आवश्यकता होती है; ओवरलोडिंग के दौरान दुर्घटना या हानि के मामले में, पी एंड आई क्लब और हल एंड मशीनरी बीमाकर्ता इस आधार पर मुआवजा देने से इनकार कर सकते हैं कि जहाज समुद्र में चलने योग्य नहीं है या जहाज मालिक को सब्रोगेशन के माध्यम से सहारा दे सकता है। समुद्री इतिहास ने दर्दनाक रूप से दिखाया है कि फ्रीबोर्डिंग को इतनी सख्ती से संरक्षित क्यों किया जाता है: 19 वीं शताब्दी में, ब्रिटिश कोयला जहाजों की ओवरलोडिंग और हर साल उनमें से सैकड़ों के डूबने से प्लिमसोल का संघर्ष शुरू हुआ, और आधुनिक काल में, अनुचित भंडारण और थोक और सूखे मालवाहक जहाजों में ओवरलोडिंग के कारण स्थिरता के नुकसान के कारण गंभीर दुर्घटनाएं हुईं। इसीलिए लोड लाइन निरीक्षण एक ऐसा कदम है जिसे कैप्टन की प्री-लोडिंग चेकलिस्ट में कभी नहीं छोड़ा जाना चाहिए।
Yük Hattı Sözleşmesinin tüm mantığı tek: लोड लाइन समझौते का संपूर्ण तर्क एक ही अवधारणा पर आधारित है: फ्रीबोर्ड, यानी डेक किनारे और पानी की सतह के बीच न्यूनतम ऊंचाई। यह दूरी जहाज के आरक्षित बिल्ज वॉल्यूम को निर्धारित करती है और इसलिए बिना डूबे समुद्र में बने रहने की इसकी क्षमता निर्धारित करती है। 19वीं शताब्दी में ओवरलोडेड जहाजों के डूबने पर सैमुअल प्लिमसोल के नेतृत्व में हुए संघर्ष के परिणामस्वरूप जहाज के बोर्ड पर 'प्लिमसोल ब्रांड' अंकित किया गया। एलएलसी इस विचार को एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानक में बदल देता है: प्रत्येक जहाज के लिए अधिकतम स्वीकार्य लोडिंग किनारे पर लोड लाइन चिह्नों द्वारा दिखाई देती है और किसी भी परिस्थिति में इसे इस लाइन के नीचे लोड नहीं किया जा सकता है।
Yük hattı, keyfi bir çizgi değil, ayrınt: लोड लाइन कोई मनमानी लाइन नहीं है बल्कि विस्तृत इंजीनियरिंग गणना का परिणाम है। गणना जहाज के प्रकार के अनुसार एक तालिका (सारणीबद्ध) फ्रीबोर्ड मूल्य से शुरू होती है: टाइप ए जहाजों (तरल बल्क कार्गो, छोटे डेक क्लीयरेंस ले जाने वाले टैंकर) का मूल्यांकन कम फ्रीबोर्ड के साथ किया जाता है, जबकि टाइप बी जहाजों (अन्य) का मूल्यांकन उच्च फ्रीबोर्ड के साथ किया जाता है। इस आधार मान को कई सुधार कारकों द्वारा समायोजित किया जाता है: ब्लॉक गुणांक (सीबी) के लिए सुधार, जहाज की गहराई (डी) के लिए सुधार, सुपरस्ट्रक्चर और पूर्वानुमान की बंद लंबाई के लिए छूट, जहाज की सीधी और धनुष ऊंचाई। परिणामी फ्रीबोर्ड जहाज की आरक्षित बिल्ज मात्रा का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है और इसलिए बिना डूबे समुद्र में बने रहने की इसकी क्षमता है। यह गणना जहाज के लोड लाइन प्रमाणपत्र पर प्रलेखित है और किनारे पर चिह्नों की स्थिति निर्धारित करती है।

Yükleme öncesi cargo hold hazırlığını (h: कार्गो होल्ड की तैयारी (होल्ड क्लीनिंग) लोडिंग से पहले टीम के साथ की जाती है: सफाई, धुलाई (समुद्र का पानी / ताजा पानी), सूखापन सुनिश्चित करना, हैच कोमिंग / ट्रैक की सफाई और पिछले कार्गो अवशेषों (दाग) को पूरी तरह से हटाना। थोक अनाज/सांद्रित/कोयला/लौह अयस्क में अलग-अलग सफाई मानकों की आवश्यकता होती है; मुखिया इन मानकों को जानता है और उन्हें लागू करता है। सीढ़ी पकड़ना, लाइट फिक्स्चर और बिल्ज वेल की सफाई इस काम का हिस्सा है।
Yükleme öncesi deplasman 8,450 t ve yükl: यदि लोडिंग से पहले विस्थापन 8,450 टन है और लोडिंग के बाद 21,300 टन है, तो लोड किया गया भार कितने टन है?
Yükleme öncesi kargonun durumu kontrol e: लोडिंग से पहले माल की स्थिति की जाँच की जाती है। नुकसान के नोट मेट की रसीद पर काटे जाते हैं।
Yükleme öncesi otomatik test, seferde ar: स्वचालित प्री-इंस्टॉलेशन परीक्षण तुरंत विफलता के जोखिम को काफी कम कर देता है।
Yükleme öncesi tankerde yapılan 'ship/sh: लोडिंग से पहले टैंकर पर बनाई गई 'जहाज/तट सुरक्षा जांच सूची' क्या प्रदान करती है?
Yükleme öncesi ve sonrası deplasman fark: लोडिंग से पहले और बाद में विस्थापन में अंतर लोड की मात्रा बताता है।
Yükleme öncesi ve sonrası deplasmanlar h: लोडिंग से पहले और बाद में विस्थापन की गणना की जाती है; अंतर लगातार वजन सुधार के साथ पेलोड देता है।
Yükleme öncesi ve sonrası ölçülen balast: लोडिंग से पहले और बाद में गिट्टी के अंतर को क्यों ध्यान में रखा जाता है?
Yükleme penceresine sığdırmak için B/L'y: लोडिंग विंडो में फिट होने के लिए बी/एल की पूर्व-डेटिंग करना धोखा है; जब ऐसा होता है, तो यह वाणिज्यिक और आपराधिक दायित्व और गारंटी की हानि दोनों लाता है। अल्पकालिक सुविधा बड़ा दीर्घकालिक जोखिम है।
Yükleme planı hazırlamak, stability/stre: The primary duty of the Chief Officer is to prepare a loading plan, check stability/stress calculations, conduct draft surveys, implement the lashing/securing plan and ensure consistency between the cargo manifest and the stowage plan. Any situation that poses a risk of cargo damage, shifting or marine pollution is the responsibility of the Chief Officer. It controls the application of IMDG Code segregation rules in dangerous cargoes.
Yükleme planı hazırlanırken öncelikle ha: लोडिंग योजना तैयार करते समय सबसे पहले किस सीमा की जाँच की जाती है?
Yükleme planı hem stabilite hem trim içi: लोडिंग योजना को स्थिरता और ट्रिम दोनों के लिए अनुकूलित किया जाना चाहिए
Yükleme planında balast değişimi neden a: लोडिंग योजना में गिट्टी प्रतिस्थापन की गणना अलग से क्यों की जाती है?
Yükleme planında bir IMDG konteyneri yaş: लोडिंग योजना आवास के निकट एक IMDG कंटेनर और एक ताप स्रोत दिखाती है। आप क्या करते हैं?
Yükleme planının her aşamasında hull lon: यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि लोडिंग योजना के हर चरण में पतवार की अनुदैर्ध्य ताकत समुद्र और बंदरगाह सीमा के भीतर बनी रहे।
Yükleme planının onaylanması, stabilite: यह लोडिंग योजना के अनुमोदन, स्थिरता गणना के नियंत्रण, लैशिंग/सुरक्षित नियंत्रण और IMO श्रेणी की खतरनाक लोड प्रक्रियाओं के कार्यान्वयन की निगरानी करता है। यह कार्गो संचालन जोखिमों का मूल्यांकन करता है जो जहाज के प्रकार (थोक, टैंकर, कंटेनर) के आधार पर भिन्न होता है और आवश्यक होने पर संचालन को रोकने के लिए प्राधिकरण का उपयोग करता है। कप्तान शिपर द्वारा घोषित कार्गो जानकारी की सटीकता पर सवाल उठाता है और इसमें VGM और MSDS जैसे दस्तावेज़ों की जाँच की जाती है।
Yükleme programı üreticinin belirlediği: लोडिंग प्रोग्राम निर्माता द्वारा निर्दिष्ट अवधि के भीतर लागू किया जाता है।
Yükleme sınırı belirlenirken fribord ned: लोडिंग सीमा निर्धारित करते समय फ्रीबोर्ड क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
Yükleme sırası (loading sequence) neden: टर्मिनल को लोडिंग अनुक्रम लिखित रूप में क्यों दिया जाता है?
Yükleme sırası (sequence) stabilite kada: लोडिंग क्रम स्थिरता जितना ही महत्वपूर्ण है। गलत मध्यवर्ती चरण के साथ सही अंतिम मूल्यों तक पहुंचने से जहाज पर अस्थायी रूप से दबाव पड़ सकता है। कप्तान मध्यवर्ती चरण मानों को भी नियंत्रित करता है।
Yükleme sırasında ağırlık merkezinin yer: लोडिंग के दौरान गुरुत्वाकर्षण के केंद्र का विस्थापन जोड़े गए या हटाए गए वजन के स्थान पर निर्भर करता है। जब जहाज पर कोई नया भार लिया जाता है, तो इस भार के भार को उसकी ऊर्ध्वाधर दूरी से गुणा करके एक नया क्षण बनाया जाता है और उसे कुल क्षण में जोड़ा जाता है। इसी तरह, जहाज से हटाया गया वजन वर्तमान क्षण से घटा दिया जाता है। गुरुत्वाकर्षण के वर्तमान केंद्र की गणना करने के लिए नए कुल क्षण को नए कुल वजन से विभाजित किया जाता है। संचालन का यह क्रम हमेशा एक ही तर्क के साथ किया जाता है और कोई भी चरण छोड़ा नहीं जाता है।
Yükleme sırasında ambar sıcaklığı ölçümü: लोडिंग के दौरान किस लोड के लिए गोदाम का तापमान माप अनिवार्य है?
Yükleme sırasında ambarlar arası ağırlık: लोडिंग के दौरान गोदामों के बीच वजन में बड़े अंतर का क्या कारण है?
Yükleme sırasında freeboard ve trim kont: लोडिंग के दौरान फ्रीबोर्ड और ट्रिम नियंत्रण
Yükleme sırasında geminin meyili neden s: लोडिंग के दौरान जहाज के झुकाव की लगातार निगरानी क्यों की जानी चाहिए?
Yükleme sırasında geminin trim'i neden k: लोडिंग के दौरान जहाज की ट्रिम को नियंत्रित क्यों रखा जाता है?
Yükleme sırasında kesme kuvveti (shear f: यदि लोडिंग के दौरान अपरूपण बल सीमा पार हो जाए तो क्या किया जाना चाहिए?
Yükleme sırasında taşmayı önlemek ve mik: लोडिंग के दौरान अतिप्रवाह को रोकना और मात्रा नियंत्रण प्रदान करना
Yükleme sırasında yer değiştiren buhar s: लोडिंग के दौरान विस्थापित भाप का प्रबंधन तट वाष्प रिटर्न या जहाज प्रणालियों द्वारा किया जाता है। कार्गो कंप्रेसर, द्रवीकरण और उबाल-बंद गैस की खपत टैंक के दबाव को सीमा पर रखती है। वाल्व बंद होने, दर में बदलाव या गर्म उत्पाद मिश्रण के कारण अचानक दबाव बढ़ सकता है। टैंक राहत प्रणालियाँ कभी भी पृथक नहीं होती हैं।
Yükleme sırasını değiştirip 5.1'i en son: मैं इंस्टॉल ऑर्डर बदलता हूं और अंत में 5.1 इंस्टॉल करता हूं
Yükleme sonrası ambar kapaklarının sızdı: लोडिंग के बाद हैच कवर की जकड़न को किस विधि से जांचा जा सकता है?
Yükleme sonrası deplasman farkı 18,600 t: यदि लोडिंग के बाद विस्थापन अंतर 18,600 टन है, गिट्टी में कमी 1,200 टन है और ईंधन की खपत 60 टन है, तो लोड किया गया भार कितने टन है?
Yükleme sonrası düzenlenen 'draft survey: लोड करने के बाद तैयार की गई 'ड्राफ्ट सर्वेक्षण रिपोर्ट' में क्या शामिल होना चाहिए?
Yükleme sonrası stabilite hesabında hang: पोस्ट-लोड स्थिरता गणना में कौन सा सुधार नहीं भूलना चाहिए?
Yükleme sonrası ve öncesi deplasman fark: लोडिंग से पहले और बाद में विस्थापन अंतर से स्थिरांक और तरल पदार्थ (गिट्टी, ईंधन, पानी) के परिवर्तन को ठीक करके
Yükleme tamamlandı; birden fazla balast: स्थापना पूर्ण; कई गिट्टी और ईंधन टैंक आधे भरे हुए हैं (सुस्त), गणना की गई GM कम है और जहाज बंदरगाह में सुचारू रूप से व्यवहार कर रहा है। आप निम्न GM के मूल कारण का समाधान कैसे करते हैं?
Yükleme tamamlandığında draft survey ve/: जब लोडिंग पूरी हो जाती है, तो ड्राफ्ट सर्वेक्षण और/या यूलेज सर्वेक्षण किया जाता है।
Yükleme tamamlandığında düzenlenen 'carg: लोडिंग पूर्ण होने पर 'कार्गो मेनिफेस्ट' सूची क्या करती है?
Yükleme ve boşaltma için çarter sözleşme: चार्टर समझौते में पट्टेदार को लोडिंग और अनलोडिंग के लिए दी गई अवधि
Yükleme ve boşaltma için öngörülen izin: लोडिंग और अनलोडिंग के लिए परिकल्पित परमिट अवधि।
Yükleme ve boşaltma sırasında hacim deği: लोडिंग और अनलोडिंग के दौरान वॉल्यूम परिवर्तन को समायोजित करता है; इसे जमने और अवरुद्ध होने से बचाया जाता है।
Yükleme ve boşaltma sürelerinin toplu de: लोडिंग और अनलोडिंग समय का कुल मूल्यांकन
Yükleme ve deballast hızları uyuşmazsa a: यदि लोडिंग और डीबलास्ट दरें मेल नहीं खाती हैं, तो मध्यवर्ती चरणों में ड्राफ्ट अतिरिक्त या एसएफ/BM सीमा का उल्लंघन होता है; योजना को चरण दर चरण सत्यापित किया जाता है.
Yükleme ve tahliye operasyonları sırasın: यह लोडिंग और अनलोडिंग परिचालन के दौरान डेक और होल्ड/टैंकों पर की जाने वाली एक सतत निगरानी निगरानी है।
Yükleme yazılımı onay sürecinin iki teme: इंस्टॉलेशन सॉफ़्टवेयर अनुमोदन प्रक्रिया के दो प्रमुख चरण क्या हैं?
Yükleme, istif, ayrım ve güvenlik gerekl: लोडिंग, स्टैकिंग, पृथक्करण और सुरक्षा आवश्यकताएँ।
Yükleme, kalkış, seyir, varış: लोड हो रहा है, प्रस्थान, नौवहन, आगमन
Yükleme, seyir ve tahliye sürecinde meyd: यह लोडिंग, नेविगेशन और अनलोडिंग प्रक्रिया के दौरान होने वाली या पाई जाने वाली कार्गो क्षति के दस्तावेजीकरण, रिपोर्टिंग और रोकथाम की प्रक्रिया है।
Yükleme/boşaltma boru sistemleri, manifo: पाइपिंग सिस्टम, मैनिफोल्ड्स की लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग और सुरक्षा सावधानियां।
Yükleme/boşaltma laytime'dan önce tamaml: यदि लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग निर्धारित समय से पहले पूरी हो जाती है, तो जहाज मालिक बचाए गए समय के लिए चार्टरर को डिस्पैच (प्रीमियम) का भुगतान कर सकता है; यह आमतौर पर विलंब शुल्क दर का आधा है। लेखांकन के दो सामान्य आधार हैं: 'सभी सहेजे गए समय पर प्रेषण' या 'बचे हुए समय पर प्रेषण' (केवल बचत को विलंबित समय के रूप में गिना जाता है)। डिस्पैच किरायेदार को तेजी से संचालन के लिए प्रोत्साहित करता है। प्रेषण गणना: समय की बचत × डिस्पैच दर.
Yükleme/boşaltma öncesi stability bookle: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग से पहले स्थिरता पुस्तिका संगत GM गणना और SF/BM सीमाएं
Yükleme/boşaltma planlaması, debi/basınç: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग योजना, प्रवाह/दबाव नियंत्रण, ईएसडी और बंकरिंग सुरक्षा।
Yükleme/boşaltma sırasında çalışan motor: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान चलने वाले इंजन CO और ज्वलनशील वाष्प उत्पन्न करते हैं; मैकेनिकल वेंटिलेशन बंद किए बिना वाहन की आवाजाही की अनुमति नहीं है।
Yükleme/boşaltma sırasında draft değişir: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान ड्राफ्ट बदलता है, ज्वार गोदी की ऊंचाई बदलता है; यदि गैंगवे/आवास सीढ़ी के कोण को लगातार तदनुसार समायोजित नहीं किया जाता है, तो यह फंस जाएगा या खतरनाक ढलान पर आ जाएगा। समय-समय पर नियंत्रण आवश्यक है.
Yükleme/boşaltma sırasında hava koşullar: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान, मौसम की स्थिति, विशेष रूप से बिजली और तूफान, सीधे स्थानांतरण सुरक्षा को प्रभावित करते हैं। बिजली निकलने वाले कार्गो वाष्प को प्रज्वलित कर सकती है। यह खंड हवाई निगरानी और स्थानांतरण अवरोधन मानदंड पर चर्चा करता है।
Yükleme/boşaltma sırasında segregated ba: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान अलग-अलग गिट्टी (एसबीटी) प्रतिस्थापन जहाज के ड्राफ्ट, ट्रिम और ताकत संतुलन को बनाए रखता है। गिट्टी संचालन कार्गो संचालन के साथ समन्वय में किया जाता है और बीडब्ल्यूटीएस और BWM कन्वेंशन के अनुसार किया जाता है। यह अनुभाग सुरक्षित गिट्टी/डीबलास्ट प्रबंधन को संबोधित करता है।
Yükleme/boşaltma sırasında tespit edilen: जहाज मालिक के हितों की रक्षा के लिए लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान पाए गए नुकसान की रिकॉर्डिंग और एलओपी की व्यवस्था करना।
Yükleme/boşaltmada deniz yüzeyine bir da: यदि लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान तेल की एक बूंद भी समुद्र की सतह पर फैलती है, तो SOPEP (शिपबोर्ड ऑयल पॉल्यूशन इमरजेंसी प्लान) सक्रिय हो जाता है और टर्मिनल और बंदरगाह प्राधिकरण को तुरंत सूचित किया जाता है। दंड अलग-अलग देशों में अलग-अलग होते हैं; संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में, USD को लाखों में व्यक्त किया जाता है।
Yükleme/boşaltmada konteyner hasarı, yan: यदि लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान कंटेनर क्षति, अनुचित हैंडलिंग या पहले से मौजूद क्षति का पता चलता है, तो इसे तस्वीरों, रिकॉर्ड और विरोध पत्र (एलओपी) के साथ दस्तावेजित किया जाता है; यह बाद के कार्गो दावों के विरुद्ध बचाव का आधार है। इस अनुभाग में क्षति संबंधी दस्तावेज़ शामिल हैं।
Yükleme/boşaltmada stabilite ve trim sın: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग के दौरान स्थिरता और ट्रिम सीमाएं बनाए रखी जाती हैं; उपचार/प्रतिस्थापन के बिना डिस्चार्ज सीमाएं लागू होती हैं।
Yükleme/tahliye hızı, yük dağılımı ve ba: लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग गति, लोड वितरण और मूरिंग स्थिति की निगरानी की जाती है।
Yüklemenin hiçbir ara aşamasında intact: लोडिंग के किसी भी मध्यवर्ती चरण में अक्षुण्ण स्थिरता मानदंड का उल्लंघन नहीं किया जा सकता है; यहां तक कि एक "हस्तक्षेपकारी" चरण में भी, GZ वक्र और क्षेत्र मानदंड को संतुष्ट किया जाना चाहिए।
Yüklemenin/boşaltmanın laytime'dan önce: लेटटाइम से पहले लोडिंग/अनलोडिंग पूरी होने की स्थिति में मालिक द्वारा पट्टेदार को प्रीमियम का भुगतान किया जाता है
Yüklemeyi durdurur, nem/TML sertifikalar: मैं लोडिंग रोकता हूं, एनईएम/टीएमएल प्रमाणपत्र सत्यापित करता हूं और कैप्टन को सूचित करता हूं
Yüklemeyi sürdürüp seyirde ilave balastl: मैं नौकायन के दौरान अतिरिक्त गिट्टी के साथ इसे लोड करता रहता हूं और संतुलित करता हूं।
Yüklenecek kargonun toplam ağırlığı, tür: लोड किए जाने वाले कार्गो का कुल वजन, प्रकार, खतरनाक सामान वर्ग, पैकेजिंग प्रकार और निर्वहन क्रम निर्धारित किया जाता है।

Yüksek basıncın uzantısı; genellikle sak: उच्च दबाव का विस्तार; आमतौर पर शांत/साफ मौसम

Yüksek basınç hem pompa gücünü hem kaçak: उच्च दबाव से पंप की शक्ति और रिसाव प्रवाह दर दोनों बढ़ जाती है।
Yüksek basınç ince atomizasyon sağlar; h: उच्च दबाव बारीक परमाणुकरण प्रदान करता है; लाइनों और कनेक्शनों में सुरक्षा सावधानियां महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

Yüksek basınç kesici (HP cutout) ne yapa: उच्च दबाव कटआउट (एचपी कटआउट) क्या करता है?
Yüksek basınç merkezi, çevre basınçtan d: उच्च दबाव केंद्र एक ऐसा क्षेत्र है जहां दबाव आसपास के दबाव से अधिक होता है। यहाँ हवा ऊपर से नीचे उतरती है और सतह पर फैलती है; नीचे की ओर आने वाली हवा गर्म हो जाती है और इसकी नमी क्षमता बढ़ जाती है, इस प्रकार बादल घुल जाते हैं और आम तौर पर साफ, शांत मौसम की स्थिति उत्पन्न होती है। उत्तरी गोलार्ध में, हवा उच्च दबाव के आसपास दक्षिणावर्त (एंटीसाइक्लोनिक) घूमती है। उच्च दबाव प्रणालियाँ अक्सर धीमी गति से चलती हैं या अर्ध-स्थायी स्थिति में स्थित होती हैं (अज़ोरेस उच्च दबाव, साइबेरियाई उच्च दबाव, आदि)। लेकिन उच्च दबाव का मतलब हमेशा शांत समुद्र नहीं होता है: सिस्टम के किनारों पर बनने वाले मजबूत दबाव प्रवणता महत्वपूर्ण हवा की गति तक पहुंच सकते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त, जब उच्च दबाव रहता है, तो विकिरण कोहरे या व्युत्क्रम परत के कारण खराब दृश्यता का खतरा होता है।
Yüksek basınç merkezi; genellikle açık v: उच्च दबाव केंद्र; यह आम तौर पर साफ़ और शांत मौसम की स्थिति लाता है।
Yüksek basınç nedeniyle çöken kabarcıkla: उच्च दबाव के कारण बुलबुले टूट रहे हैं
Yüksek basınç ortak hatta sürekli tutulu: सामान्य लाइन में लगातार उच्च दबाव बना रहता है; कम गति पर भी अच्छा परमाणुकरण प्राप्त होता है, और उत्सर्जन और खपत में सुधार होता है।

Yüksek basınç pompasının sürekli 800-100: आम रेल में, जहां उच्च दबाव पंप लगातार ईसीयू नियंत्रण के तहत 800-1000 बार पंप करता है

Yüksek basınçlı sıvının basıncını düşürm: उच्च दबाव वाले तरल का दबाव कम करना (आंशिक वाष्पीकरण)

Kuzey kardinal, pratikte “kesintisiz ser: The north cardinal is recognised by a rhythm that feels like an uninterrupted series of flashes and is shown on the chart mostly as Q or VQ. The east cardinal's signature is a group of three: Q(3) or VQ(3). The south cardinal's signature is a group of six plus a long flash: Q(6)+LFl or VQ(6)+LFl. The west cardinal's signature is a group of nine: Q(9) or VQ(9). Suppose a cardinal mark on the chart is labelled “VQ(6)+LFl 10s”. This identifies a south cardinal. Within the 10-second period there are six very quick flashes and one long flash, and the pattern repeats. The right decision here is not made with a slogan such as “which side do I leave the mark”, but with the logic “safe passage is made to the south of the danger”. Read together with the danger symbol on the chart, the passage line becomes clear.
Tüm denizci bağlarının temelini oluştura: The simplest stopper knot and the basis of all seamanship knots. It temporarily stops the working end from running out through a sheave or block and keeps the rope from unlaying into its strands.
Çımaya atılan durdurucu (stopper) düğümd: A stopper knot tied in the working end; it stops the rope from running out through a block, a sheave or a hole. It is easy to untie even after being under load.
Adi düğümün (overhand) aksine sekizli, y: Unlike the overhand knot, the figure-of-eight is easy to untie even after it has jammed under load — that is why it is preferred. In Turkish it is often also called 'Kropi bağı'.
Aynı çaptaki iki halatın çımasını birbir: Ties together the working ends of two ropes of the same size (a binding knot). Widely used for reefing sails and tying up covers.
Halatın ucunda yük altında sıkışmayan, k: Forms a fixed loop (eye) at the end of a rope that does not jam under load and is easy to untie. The most important seamanship knot for rescue, passing mooring lines and general use.
Halatı bir babaya, baraya, çubuğa veya k: Used to make a rope fast temporarily to a bollard, a rail, a post or a handrail. Quick to tie and quick to release.
Halatı bir baraya, ringe, babaya veya ağ: Quickly makes a rope fast to a rail, a ring, a bollard or a tree. The two half hitches tied round the rope's own standing part form a sliding loop that tightens as the load comes on.
Bir halatı baraya, ringe veya babaya emn: Makes a rope securely fast to a rail, a ring or a bollard. The round turn takes the load and the two half hitches lock the knot. It can be tied and untied even under load.
Palamar, şamandıra veya yat halatını güv: Makes a mooring line, buoy line or yacht line securely fast to a deck cleat. It holds firmly under load and can be released quickly when needed.
Bir halatı, çekiş yönü neredeyse paralel: Makes a rope fast to another rope under tension, or to a rail, so that it does not slip when the pull is almost parallel to it. The standard hitch on board for taking the load off a loaded rope jammed on a windlass or winch (putting on a stopper).
Seren, bumba, kütük gibi silindirik cisi: Used to grip and haul, tow or lift round objects such as spars, booms and logs. It holds firmly under load and loosens by itself when the load comes off, so it is easy to untie.
Halatı demir bedenine (anchor) veya ring: Makes a rope securely fast to an anchor shackle or a ring. It does not jam when wet or under load and stands up well to jerking loads.
Farklı çaptaki iki halatı birleştirir. K: Joins two ropes of different sizes. A bight is made in the thicker rope and the thinner rope is passed through it and tucked under itself.
Çapları çok farklı, ıslak veya kaygan ik: Securely joins two ropes of very different sizes, or ropes that are wet or slippery. It is the sheet bend with a second turn; the extra turn greatly reduces the chance of slipping.
İki ince halatı, savloyu veya gırcalayı: Joins two thin lines end to end. Each working end ties an overhand knot round the standing part of the other line; under load the two knots jam against each other. Reliable in wet, thin line.
Palamar, yedek halatı gibi iki kalın hal: Joins two heavy ropes such as mooring lines or towlines end to end. A classic seaman's bend that can still be untied after a heavy load and stays reliable when wet.
Uzun bir halatı kesmeden geçici olarak k: Temporarily shortens a long rope without cutting it, or takes a worn (weak) section out of use by placing it in the middle part, which carries no load.

The great-circle distance is always shorter than or equal to the rhumb-line distance (they are equal only along the equator and along a meridian). Chapter II ve III – Güverte ve makine ye: Chapters II and III – deck and engine competences: Chapter II defines the competences of the bridge hierarchy step by step: the officer of the watch (OOW) must be able to carry out navigation, cargo and ship operations at the operational level; the chief mate and master must also cover passage planning, stability, damage control, legal obligations and crisis management at the management level. Chapter III applies the same logic to the engine department: competences in machinery operation, electrical/electronic systems, maintenance and management of ship systems are defined for the engineer officer of the watch, the second engineer and the chief engineer. The Electro-Technical Officer (ETO), a separate category, was formalised by the Manila amendments in response to the growing automation and electronic complexity of modern ships. These chapters also set the minimum sea service and approved training/assessment requirements for each level. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.
Chapter V ve VI – Özel ve zorunlu emniye: Chapters V and VI – special and mandatory safety training: Chapter V makes additional training mandatory for certain ship types: basic and advanced oil/chemical/gas tanker training for tanker personnel, IGF Code training for gas-fuelled ships, Polar Code training for navigation in polar waters, and crowd management and crisis management training for passenger ship personnel. Chapter VI sets the common safety and security training for all seafarers: Basic Safety Training (BST – fire prevention and firefighting, personal survival techniques, first aid, personal safety and social responsibilities), proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats (PSCRB), advanced firefighting, medical first aid/medical care, and security awareness and designated security duties training under ISPS. Chapter VIII – Vardiya, dinlenme ve göre: Chapter VIII – watchkeeping, rest and fitness for duty: Chapter VIII treats fatigue as an explicit safety risk and regulates how both bridge and engine room watches are kept. The minimum hours of rest are firm: at least 10 hours of rest in any 24-hour period and at least 77 hours in any 7-day period; rest may be divided into no more than two periods, one of which must be at least 6 hours long. These hours are recorded and frequently examined in port State control. The 'fitness for duty' principle also covers the alcohol and drug policy; STCW sets a standard maximum alcohol limit for watchkeepers (0.05% BAC or 0.25 mg/L in breath). The chapter also defines watch handover, keeping a lookout and the bridge/engine room watch arrangements; these rules coincide directly with the lookout requirements of COLREG and with the ship's ISM safety management system. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Before the convention each country applied its own standard of competence; a master's certificate valid in one country could be considered inadequate under another flag. STCW resolves this chaos by placing the training, certification and watchkeeping standards of seafarers on an international minimum base. The convention divides duties into seven functions (navigation, cargo handling, controlling the operation of the ship/care for persons on board, marine engineering, electrical engineering, maintenance and repair, radiocommunications) and treats each function at three levels of responsibility: operational (officer of the watch), management (master/chief engineer and chief mate/second engineer) and support (ratings). NUC ve RAM ışık/şekli diğer gemilerin er: NUC and RAM lights/shapes let other ships keep clear early and widely, but these vessels also take action to avoid collision as far as the circumstances allow. A fishing vessel has this status only when engaged in fishing with gear that restricts her manoeuvrability in the Rule 3 sense; a boat trolling is not automatically engaged in fishing.
NUC, olağanüstü bir nedenle kuralların i: A NUC vessel is one which through some exceptional circumstance is unable to manoeuvre as required by the rules. A RAM vessel is one whose ability to manoeuvre is restricted by the nature of her work. CBD applies only to a power-driven vessel and describes a severe restriction on deviating from her course because of the available depth and width of water. Being large or deep-draughted does not by itself give this status.
ODMCS, deşarj edilen suyun anlık yağ ora: The ODMCS monitors the instantaneous oil content (ppm) of the discharged water and the total discharge; if the MARPOL Annex I (Regulation 31) limits (e.g. the instantaneous rate of discharge in litres per nautical mile and the total quantity) are exceeded, it closes the discharge valve automatically and keeps a record. This is a system specific to cargo tank discharge, different from the 15 ppm oily water separator (OWS) used for bilges.
ODMCS: 10000 GT üzeri gemilerde yağ deşa: ODMCS: an oil discharge monitoring and control system is mandatory on ships above 10000 GT.
Oil mist detector (yağ bulutu algılayıcı: The oil mist detector detects overheating before a crankcase explosion.

Pervane kanat yüzeyinde basıncın suyun b: It is the collapse, in a high-pressure region, of vapour bubbles formed when the pressure on the propeller blade surface falls below the vapour pressure of the water.
Pervane kanat yüzeyinde lokal basınç düş: Vapour bubbles form on the propeller blade surface as a result of a local pressure drop and erode the surface when they collapse. Excessive cavitation shortens propeller life and creates noise/vibration.
Pervane kanatlarının değişken yük altınd: The fluctuation in thrust produced by the propeller blades under varying load excites the shaft axially. At resonance the thrust bearing, gearbox and hull are overloaded. Solution: design the axial natural frequency away from the operating speed, or use an axial damper.

Politropik üs n, süreç sırasında çevreyl: The polytropic exponent n is an empirical parameter representing the level of heat exchange with the surroundings during the process and the internal losses of the machine. n is therefore not just a theoretical number but also an indicator of equipment performance.
Pompa kapasitelerini önceden hesaplayın: Calculate the pump capacities in advance
Power-driven crossing durumda stand-on g: In a power-driven crossing situation, when the stand-on vessel takes action by her own manoeuvre, she shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, not alter course to port for a vessel on her own port side. This sentence is not applied as an absolute prohibition when there is another danger or special circumstances; Rule 2 and the whole traffic picture still apply.
Power-driven vessel underway; masthead,: A power-driven vessel underway shows both her status and her aspect through the combination of masthead lights, sidelights and sternlight. In towing/pushing, the additional masthead/towing lights, the diamond shape and the signals that depend on the length of tow make the real danger area of the tow visible. The unseen line between the tug and the tow is taken into account, especially in a crossing decision.
Power-driven vessel, sailing vessel, ves: The terms power-driven vessel, sailing vessel, vessel engaged in fishing, not under command, restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, constrained by her draught, underway, making way and restricted visibility are used with their Rule 3 definitions, not their everyday meanings. For example, underway means not at anchor, made fast to the shore or aground; moving through the water is the separate concept of making way.
Pre-departure check karanlıkta dış gözle: The pre-departure check should include an external observation in the dark and, if possible, a visibility check from different bearings; the panel lamp alone is not enough.
Proper lookout; görme ve işitmenin yanın: A proper lookout requires sight and hearing as well as all available means appropriate in the prevailing circumstances. Radar/ARPA, AIS, ECDIS, binoculars, VHF and external alarm information complement the visual lookout; none of them replaces it on its own. The lookout's attention must not be divided by other duties, and the officer of the watch must increase the capacity of the bridge team according to traffic and visibility.
Pruva hattının ilerisinde olduğu anlaşıl: If a fog signal is heard apparently forward of the beam, or a close-quarters situation with a vessel forward of the beam cannot be avoided, the vessel shall reduce her speed to the minimum at which she can be kept on her course; if necessary she shall take all her way off and navigate with extreme caution until the danger of collision is over. 'Minimum speed' is assessed according to the ship's steerage and the surrounding dangers.
PSC (liman devleti kontrolü) denetiminde: In a PSC (port State control) inspection the BWM Plan and the Record Book are examined together.
PSC denetimlerinde onay belgeleri isteni: Approval documents are requested in PSC inspections

Radar alone ile başka gemi tespit edildi: A vessel which detects by radar alone the presence of another vessel shall determine if a close-quarters situation is developing and/or risk of collision exists. If so, she shall take avoiding action in ample time. The stability of target tracking, the relative/true vector selection and the effect of own-ship manoeuvres are checked.
Radar belirsizliği hız ve zaman marjıyla: Radar uncertainty is managed with speed and time margins.
Radar hedefi baş omuzlukta yakınlaşır; s: A radar target closes on the bow; an alteration to starboard creates risk with another target, while an alteration to port runs against the Rule 19 guidance and towards the shoal.

Radar plot ve görsel trend doğrulanır, t: The radar plot and the visual trend are verified, the whole length of the tow is taken into account, and an early manoeuvre with a wide safety margin is prepared; until the uncertainty is resolved, speed is reduced and the master is called.
Radar plotting exercise yalnız CPA hesab: A radar plotting exercise should show not only the CPA calculation but also the effect of the chosen course/speed manoeuvre on the other targets and the direction restrictions of Rule 19(d).
Radar/AIS/ARPA bilgisini görsel ve işits: Cross-checking radar/AIS/ARPA information without letting it replace visual and aural lookout
RAM işaretini mutlak geçiş hakkı olarak: Interpreting a RAM signal as an absolute right of way
Restricted visibility checklist, ekipman: The restricted visibility checklist should cover not only the state of the equipment but also confirmation of the bridge team's division of duties and engine readiness.
Restricted visibility işaretleri ve dikk: Restricted Visibility Signals and Attracting Attention
Restricted visibility yalnız sis değildi: Restricted visibility is not only fog; it covers any condition in which visibility is restricted by mist, falling snow, heavy rainstorms, sandstorms or similar causes. Rule 19 applies to vessels not in sight of one another when navigating in or near an area of restricted visibility. Being just outside a fog bank does not take a ship out of the scope with respect to approaching targets.
Reynolds sayısı eylemsizlik kuvvetinin v: The Reynolds number is the ratio of inertial forces to viscous forces.
Rijit kaplinler (flanşlı) hiçbir kaçıklı: Rigid couplings (flanged) allow no misalignment and need perfect alignment (e.g. shaft line flanges). Flexible couplings (rubber element, gear, disc) tolerate some angular/parallel/axial misalignment, damp torsional shocks and reduce the transmission of vibration.
Risk = Olasılık × Şiddet formülüyle hesa: It is calculated with the formula Risk = Likelihood × Severity. A 5×5 matrix is widely used.
Risk of collision bütün mevcut araçlarla: Risk of collision is determined by all available means; if there is any doubt, risk is deemed to exist. A steady or barely changing compass bearing is the classic strong sign, but risk can exist even with an appreciable bearing change, especially when approaching a very large ship, a tow or a ship at close range. The visual bearing trend is complemented by radar plotting.
Rota değişikliği kadar hız azaltma ve wa: Reducing speed and taking way off are as much basic tools as altering course.
Rota işaretini (E/W, N/S) kadrana göre b: Forgetting to set the sign of the course (E/W, N/S) according to the quadrant.
Rota planında her bacak için Lm'i tek te: Calculate Lm for each leg of the passage plan separately; using a single Lm for the whole route increases the error.
Rotor, DC uyarma akımıyla manyetik alan: The rotor creates a magnetic field with DC excitation current. The diesel engine turns the rotor. The rotating magnetic field induces an EMF in the stator windings.
rp: Kompresör basınç oranı · wc: Kompres: rp: compressor pressure ratio · wc: compressor work · wt: turbine work
Rule 10 mümkün olduğunca dik heading ist: Rule 10 requires a heading as nearly as practicable at right angles, but safe navigation and the other rules still apply. Correcting only the ground track on the screen may make the ship's intention unclear to other ships.
Rule 13 overtaking, başka gemiye kıç doğ: Rule 13 overtaking starts with the definition of coming up with another vessel from a direction more than 22.5 degrees abaft her beam. If there is any doubt, she shall assume she is overtaking. The overtaking vessel keeps her responsibility until she is finally past and clear, even if the bearing later changes and it looks like a crossing.
Rule 14'te iki power-driven vessel recip: Under Rule 14, when two power-driven vessels are meeting on reciprocal or nearly reciprocal courses so as to involve risk, each alters course to starboard. If there is any doubt, she shall assume a head-on situation exists. Under Rule 15, in a crossing situation the power-driven vessel that has the other on her own starboard side is the give-way vessel and shall, if the circumstances admit, avoid crossing ahead of the other.
Rule 17'nin may/must aşamaları, mevcut m: The may/must stages of Rule 17, the current distance/time, the other ship's action and the last manoeuvre needed to avoid collision must be explained.
Rule 18, Rules 9, 10 ve 13 ile birlikte: Rule 18 is read together with Rules 9, 10 and 13.
Rule 18, Rules 9, 10 ve 13'te aksi gerek: Rule 18 sets the responsibilities between power-driven, sailing, fishing, NUC, RAM and CBD vessels except where Rules 9, 10 and 13 otherwise require. The overtaking rule comes before the relationship between vessel types; the not-to-impede provisions in narrow channels and TSSs also change the general scheme. A single memorised pyramid therefore does not solve every encounter.
Rule 18'i mutlak geçiş hakkı listesi yap: Turning Rule 18 into a list of absolute rights of way
Rule 19 görsel encounter kurallarının ko: Rule 19 is not a copy of the visual encounter rules.
Rule 19 koşullarında Rules 11-18 termino: In Rule 19 conditions avoid applying the Rules 11-18 terminology automatically
Rule 19'u her hedef için otomatik sancağ: Thinking Rule 19 is an automatic turn-to-starboard rule for every target
Rule 19(d) dikkate alınarak hedefin pruv: Taking Rule 19(d) into account, the target's position forward of or abaft the beam and the prevailing conditions must be explained.
Rule 2 kullanılan bir olayda vardiya zab: In an incident where Rule 2 was used, the officer of the watch should be able to explain, with log/VDR data, what the immediate danger was, why the standard rule was not enough and why the departure chosen was the safest option.
Rule 2'yi istenen manevrayı meşrulaştıra: Seeing Rule 2 as a free clause that justifies any desired manoeuvre
Rule 35, restricted visibility içinde ve: Under Rule 35, in or near an area of restricted visibility a vessel gives periodic sound signals according to her status and movement. The signals for a power-driven vessel making way and for one underway but stopped and making no way are different; vessels such as NUC, RAM, CBD, sailing, fishing and towing vessels use their own patterns. There are bell/gong and additional signals for vessels at anchor and aground.
Rule 36, başka geminin dikkatini çekmek: Rule 36 allows a vessel to make light or sound signals that cannot be mistaken for any signal authorised in the rules to attract the attention of another vessel; dazzling the other ship with a high-intensity searchlight is not appropriate. Using a laser or deck lights must not endanger the lookout either.
Rule 37 ve Annex IV distress ve yardım i: Rule 37 and Annex IV list the signals that indicate distress and need of assistance. DSC distress alerts, EPIRBs, MAYDAY, rockets/flares, orange smoke and other recognised signals are used according to the situation and equipment. A false distress signal can have serious legal and operational consequences; test procedures must prevent a real alert.
Rules 20-31 ışıkların sunset-sunrise ara: Rules 20-31 require lights to be shown from sunset to sunrise and in other conditions where necessary, including restricted visibility, and prohibit other lights that could be mistaken for them. Shapes are shown by day. Deck working lights, advertising/service lights or accommodation lights must not impair the visibility/character of the COLREG lights.
Rules 32-33 whistle, short/long blast ve: Rules 32-33 define the whistle, short/prolonged blasts and sound-signalling appliances. Rule 34 sets out the course/engine manoeuvring signals for power-driven vessels in sight of one another, the signal of at least five short and rapid blasts for doubt/warning, and the overtaking intention/agreement signals in a narrow channel. If light signals are used, they carry the same meaning.

The buoy system is interpreted according: The buoyage system is read according to the IALA scheme, and the world is divided into two main regions. Region A covers Europe, Africa, most of Asia and Australia — Türkiye is in Region A: when entering harbour, red marks are kept to port and green marks to starboard. Region B covers North and South America, Japan, Korea and the Philippines, and the lateral colours are REVERSED: when entering harbour, red is kept to starboard and green to port ('red right returning', as American seafarers memorise it). The critical point is that this is not a statement about colour but a passing instruction. Because the same colour can mean different sides in different regions, the first reflex on seeing a buoy symbol on the chart must be to ask 'which IALA region am I in?'. Although the region changes, the shape does not: the port-hand mark is cylindrical (can) in both regions and the starboard-hand mark is conical in both; when the colour cannot be read, the shape and topmark still give correct information. The chart often shows the buoy as a dot, but that dot marks the edge of a channel, the side on which to pass a danger, or confirmation of the approach line; the purpose of the symbol is therefore not just to inform but to guide action.

Since the local event happened earlier than at Greenwich, the longitude is east. Result: the ship is in about 33° East longitude.

The Greenwich time read on the chronometer at the same moment is noted. This time difference is the only input to the longitude calculation.

Mercator projeksiyonu, küresel Dünya yüz: The Mercator projection is based on developing the spherical surface of the Earth onto a cylinder, and it is the basis of rhumb line (loxodrome) sailing. Meridians are shown as vertical lines parallel to one another, and parallels of latitude as horizontal lines. As latitude increases the distance between the parallels grows, tending to infinity towards the poles. This deliberate distortion makes a constant-course track a straight line on the chart.
Mercator seyri, Mercator projeksiyonunun: Mercator sailing is a constant-course (loxodrome) sailing method that uses the mathematical structure of the Mercator projection. It removes the error that plane sailing produces as latitude increases by expressing latitude in 'meridional parts' (MP — enlarged latitude), which are in the same units as minutes of longitude. On the Mercator projection the meridians are parallel and the intervals of latitude are stretched proportionally towards the poles; a constant course therefore becomes a straight line on the chart, and the course angle can be measured directly from it. It is the standard method for long east–west legs, in high latitudes and on ocean crossings.

A few minutes after entering, the first crew member suffered dizziness and loss of coordination.
Kurtarma refleksiyle ikinci personel, ta: Acting on a rescue reflex, a second crew member entered the tank without full equipment or a lifeline; the incident quickly turned into a near-miss with two casualties.
Permit to Work sürecinin prosedürel bir: The main root causes were that the Permit to Work process had become a procedural formality, that no multi-point atmosphere test was made, and that the role of the standby person was misunderstood as simply 'waiting'.
Ayrıca 'işi hızlı bitirme' baskısı neden: In addition, pressure to 'get the job done quickly' led to the ventilation time being cut short, and the toolbox talk before entry was not held in sufficient depth.
İkincil kök neden, kurtarma planının eki: A secondary root cause was that the rescue plan had not been rehearsed by the team; this is why unauthorised rescue behaviour appeared during the incident.
Kapalı alan girişinde O₂, H₂S, CO ve LEL: On entry into an enclosed space, O₂, H₂S, CO and LEL must be measured at the top, middle and bottom levels, and the results recorded on the permit form with the time in hours and minutes. Measurement is not a one-off; it must continue periodically throughout the entry.
Mekanik havalandırma yeterli süre çalışt: Mechanical ventilation must be run for a sufficient time; if the ventilation stops, the entry must be suspended automatically. A personal multi-gas detector must be kept switched on by everyone inside.
Giriş gözcüsü, iletişim hattı ve kurtarm: Entry must not start until an attendant at the entrance, a communication link and rescue equipment (SCBA, tripod, retrieval line) are ready. Rescue must be carried out only by a trained team; an unauthorised second entry is strictly forbidden.
SOLAS III/19.3.3 gereği en az iki ayda b: Under SOLAS III/19.3.3, a realistic enclosed space entry and rescue drill must be held at least every two months, and the measurement, communication and evacuation times reported.
Kapalı alan olaylarında ikinci kayıp çoğ: In enclosed space incidents the second casualty is often caused by the 'reflex to help'. The right reflex is not an unplanned entry but raising the alarm, isolating, and calling in the trained rescue team.
En güçlü önlem ekipman değil, prosedürü: The strongest safeguard is not the equipment but the behaviour of the team applying the procedure. Safety comes not from filling in the form but from putting what the form requires into practice on site.

Balast Tank Sıralaması ise trim ve stabi: Ballast tank sequencing, on the other hand, is a process managed actively to control trim and stability. When ballasting, the double bottom tanks are filled first (to increase stability), then the fore peak tank (to correct the trim) and finally the side tanks (for fine adjustment). When deballasting, the upper tanks are emptied first (GM increases), then the side tanks (heel control) and the double bottom tanks last (final stage).
Ballast Arrival (Balast Varış) durumu, u: The Ballast Arrival condition is the scenario in which the ship reaches the port of arrival with minimum fuel after a long ballast passage. It usually corresponds to the lowest displacement and can be the weakest point for stability. With minimum fuel the position of the centre of gravity changes and GM can approach critical values.
Ballast Departure (Balast Kalkış) durumu: The Ballast Departure condition is the scenario in which the ship sails with ballast water only and no cargo. Full ballast tanks keep the propeller sufficiently immersed and the forward draft at an acceptable level. In ballast the displacement is low and the ship's windage area is large, so the wind heeling moment becomes more critical. Because KM differs at low displacements, a separate stability assessment is required for ballast conditions.

Büyük daire ise küre üzerindeki en kısa: Although the great circle is the shortest path on the sphere, it appears as a curve on a Mercator chart; only the equator and the meridians appear as straight lines.

Büyük daire mesafesi, küre üzerindeki ik: The great circle distance is the shortest surface path joining two positions on the sphere. It is defined by the central angle seen at the centre of the Earth. As the central angle increases, the great circle arc lengthens in direct proportion.
Büyük daire seyrinde rota genellikle yük: In great circle sailing the route usually curves towards higher latitudes. This is not practical in winter conditions, in areas with an ice risk or where the ship's operational limits are stretched. A composite route gives a safer and more predictable alternative to the great circle: the ship joins the great circle, leaves it before reaching the limiting latitude, follows the parallel of that latitude, and rejoins a great circle at a suitable point.
Büyük daire teorik olarak iki mevki aras: In theory the great circle gives the shortest spherical path between two positions. On long ocean passages, however, this route often runs into high latitudes. High latitudes are commercially unattractive because of severe weather systems, ice risk, longer and higher seas and temperature-related operational limits. A pure great circle route is therefore rarely sailed.
Büyük daire, küre üzerinde iki mevki ara: The great circle gives the shortest surface distance between two positions on the sphere; the rhumb line (loxodrome) is the track that appears as a straight line on the Mercator projection and is followed on a constant course throughout. A rhumb line is easier to manage; a great circle usually gives a shorter distance. In practice the decision is made not on distance alone but together with weather, traffic, safety and operational constraints.
Büyük dairede kurs sürekli değişir; rhum: On a great circle the course changes continuously; on a rhumb line the course is constant. Departure değeri daima deniz mili cinsin: Departure is always expressed in nautical miles, and its sign shows whether the ship is moving east or west. This directional information is used directly in course calculations and in the relationship with the change of longitude.

Full Load Arrival (Tam Yüklü Varış) duru: The Full Load Arrival condition is the scenario in which the ship, carrying the same cargo, reaches the port of arrival after consuming fuel, fresh water and stores during the passage. In this condition the fuel tanks are usually down to the 10% reserve. Fuel consumption can change the position of the ship's centre of gravity considerably; depending on where the fuel tanks are, KG may rise or fall. The arrival condition must therefore meet the stability criteria in its own right.
Full Load Departure (Tam Yüklü Kalkış) d: The Full Load Departure condition is the scenario in which the ship leaves port at maximum cargo capacity with 100% fuel and fresh water and all stores fully loaded. It usually corresponds to the highest displacement and, because the VCG (vertical centre of gravity) potential is highest, it is a critical scenario for stability. In the full load departure condition the draft and trim must not exceed the load line limits, and all IMO stability criteria must be met.

Göksel kürede gözlemcinin bulunduğu nokt: On the celestial sphere the observer's position is taken as the centre, the point directly overhead as the zenith and the point opposite as the nadir. The intersection of the plane tangent at the observer with the sphere forms the horizon. The points where the Earth's axis of rotation meets the sphere are the celestial poles, and the intersection of the plane of the equator with the sphere is the celestial equator.
Göz yüksekliği, objenin tabanı deniz sev: The height of eye is subtracted if the base of the object is at sea level
Greenwich meridyeni sabit referans kabul: The Greenwich meridian is taken as the fixed reference. The position of a celestial body is expressed by its Greenwich Hour Angle (GHA), and its position relative to the observer's meridian by the Local Hour Angle (LHA). The angular difference between the two meridians is the longitude.
Greenwich zamanı ile yerel zaman arasınd: The difference between Greenwich time and local time changes the position of the celestial body. This difference is used both in finding longitude and as an input to the Hc and azimuth calculations. In this way the chain time difference → angular difference → change of position is clearly established.
Güneş gözlemi yapılırken sextant dik tut: When observing the Sun the sextant is held vertical. The index arm is moved until the Sun's lower limb touches the horizon. As the ship rises and falls in the swell, the moments of contact are watched several times and an average point of contact is chosen. When the measurement is complete, Hs = 46° 12.4′ is read from the sextant and the time of the observation is taken from the chronometer at the same moment. This value is not yet a position; the use of the sextant ends here. Everything done after this is the correction and interpretation of this measurement. If the sextant is not used correctly, the result will not be reliable however carefully the calculations are done.
Güneş’in deklinasyonu (δ) ve zenit uzakl: The Sun's declination (δ) and its zenith distance are interpreted together. The Sun crosses the meridian either north or south of the observer; this decides the sign rule, and the latitude is obtained directly.
Güneş’in yükselip alçaldığı yay izlenir;: The arc along which the Sun rises and falls is watched; local noon is the moment of greatest altitude. This moment is found not from the clock but as the point at which the altitude reaches its maximum. Longitude is not needed at this stage.
Günlük İzleme kapsamında, 12 veya 24 saa: In daily monitoring, all tanks are sounded at 12- or 24-hour intervals, the fuel reports are updated, the stability calculation is renewed on the loading computer and the noon report data are prepared. A daily stability update allows the ship's safety condition to be monitored continuously throughout the passage.
GZ eğrisi, geminin pozitif stabilite men: The GZ curve gives clear information about the ship's range of positive stability and its stability reserve. These two concepts express the safety margin the ship has left against capsizing, especially at large angles.
Harita düzeltmeleri, basılı bir deniz ha: Chart correction is the manual entry on a printed chart of changes in the marine environment that have occurred since the chart was published. A chart starts to become out of date the moment it is printed, because the maritime infrastructure is not fixed. Buoys are moved, the characters of lights are changed, new wrecks are found, depths are resurveyed and some areas are legally restricted or released. The chart does not reflect these changes by itself. An uncorrected chart is therefore not valid for navigation even if correct courses and calculations are laid off on it.
Harita düzeltmeleri, resmî olarak yayıml: Charts are corrected using the officially published Notices to Mariners. These notices state clearly which chart is affected, the type of change, its geographical position and how it is to be shown on the chart. Every correction is numbered and dated. For a chart to be valid, all corrections up to the latest published Notice to Mariners must have been entered on it.
Harita ölçeği, deniz haritasının neyi ay: Chart scale is the basic structure that determines what a chart shows in detail and what it deliberately leaves out. In navigation, scale is not only a mathematical ratio; it is a practical filter that decides which information is sufficient for making decisions, which is deliberately left out, and which chart is to be used at which stage. The same route looks different on charts of different scales, because a chart reinterprets reality according to its scale. Scale therefore answers the question “which decision is this chart right for?” before the question “how accurate is this chart?”.
Harita ölçeği, tek başına seyri güvenli: Chart scale alone does not make navigation safe, but choosing the wrong scale makes even correct calculations dangerous. If Mariner's Book dealt with this subject only by defining “large and small scale”, the user might try to manage a port approach with a coastal chart, or assume that a danger not shown on a small-scale chart does not exist. Scale should therefore be presented not as a definition but as a reflex that teaches which chart to make decisions with at which stage. Once this reflex is in place, the chart becomes an active navigation tool rather than a passive drawing.
Harita ölçeğinin en kritik etkisi, genel: The most critical effect of chart scale is on generalisation. Small-scale charts deliberately simplify detail so that they can show a large area. Small rocks, extensions of shoals, the limits of narrow channels or secondary aids to navigation may not be shown at all on these charts, or may be shown reduced to a symbol. This is not a deficiency of the chart but a direct result of its scale. On large-scale charts the same area is shown in a much smaller frame, so the depth contours are closer together, there are more soundings, and lines of buoys and the limits of prohibited areas become clear.

Kaldırma kuvvetinin etkidiği nokta, kald: The point at which the buoyant force acts is called the centre of buoyancy. It is the geometric centre of the underwater volume, and the buoyant force always acts vertically upwards through it. When the ship heels or trims, the shape of the underwater volume changes, so the position of the centre of buoyancy changes too. This movement is the basic mechanism of ship stability.
Kalıcı düzeltmeler, uzun süreli veya kal: Permanent corrections cover long-term or permanent changes. Adding a new buoy, changing the position or character of a light, or adding a new wreck to the chart belong to this group. These corrections are entered permanently on the chart and are not erased.
Kalite Kontrol Prosedürü olarak, hesapla: As a quality control procedure, the calculated results must be checked for logic. For example, if loading 500 tonnes gives a change in draft of only a few centimetres, is this consistent with the TPC? If GM is very different from what was expected, what is the reason? Simple logical checks like these are very effective in catching large errors.

Kritik Olaylarda Acil Değerlendirme gere: Critical events call for an immediate assessment. Deteriorating weather (increasing wind force or wave height), a suspected cargo shift (a sudden change of heel, asymmetric rolling), tank leakage (an unexpected change of level, a trim anomaly) or any abnormal behaviour must trigger an immediate stability assessment.

What these cargoes have in common is that they can shift as the ship rolls. The angle at which a bulk cargo shifts depends on its particle size, moisture content, density and stowage method.

The basic spherical triangle used in navigation is formed by the North Pole, the departure position and the arrival position. In this triangle the sides are expressed by the co-latitudes and the difference of longitude; the angles are quantities directly related to navigation, such as the initial and final great circle courses.

Maden cevherleri taşımacılığında en cidd: The most serious risk in carrying ores is liquefaction. Granular cargoes whose moisture content is above a certain threshold can start to behave like a liquid under the ship's vibration and motion. This happens suddenly and turns the cargo into a flowing mass like a liquid cargo; a dramatic free surface effect appears and the ship can capsize within minutes. This is why the IMO introduced the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML): the moisture content of the cargo must not exceed the TML.
Mean Latitude Sailing, basitliği ve hızı: Mean latitude sailing is widely used in traditional navigation because it is simple and quick; but if it is used without knowing its latitude and distance limits, it can lead to serious position errors.

Thanks to its simplicity and speed, mean latitude sailing is one of the cornerstones of traditional navigation; but using it without knowing its limits of validity can lead to serious course errors, especially in high latitudes and over long distances.
Mean Latitude Sailing, kısa ve orta mesa: Mean latitude sailing is suitable for short and medium distances.
Mean Latitude Sailing’de boylam farkı, p: In mean latitude sailing the difference of longitude is converted into the actual distance along the parallel.
Mean Latitude Sailing’in doğrudan proble: The direct problem of mean latitude sailing, finding a new position from course and distance, is one of the basic calculations of traditional navigation and gives a practical and quick solution, especially on passages in middle latitudes.
Mercator projeksiyon, deniz haritalarınd: The Mercator projection is the mathematical projection used for nautical charts and forms the basis of navigational calculations. It is preferred at sea not for aesthetics or geographical accuracy but for navigational accuracy. The Mercator projection preserves direction and bearing relationships, so the course, bearing, distance and position work done at sea can be carried out directly and consistently on the chart.
Mercator projeksiyonda mesafe ölçümü, ya: On the Mercator projection distance is measured only on the latitude scale. The mathematical reason is that the projection deliberately stretches the scale in the direction of latitude. This stretching makes the latitude scale a reliable reference for distance.
Mercator projeksiyonda sabit bir hakiki: On the Mercator projection the track of a ship steering a constant true course is shown as a straight line on the chart. This line is called a loxodrome. This is why courses can be drawn, measured and followed directly on Mercator charts.
Mercator projeksiyonun en ayırt edici öz: The most distinctive feature of the Mercator projection is that the meridians are drawn parallel and equally spaced, while the parallels of latitude are drawn further apart as latitude increases. Near the equator the parallels are close together; towards the poles the distance between them increases. This is a deliberate distortion and the mathematical result of the projection.
Mercator projeksiyonunda enlemler arası: On the Mercator projection the spreading of the parallels of latitude is expressed by the isometric latitude. This conversion is the basic quantity of rhumb line calculations:
Mercator projeksiyonunun bu avantajı, al: This advantage of the Mercator projection is gained at the cost of distortions of area and distance that grow rapidly with latitude. Distances measured on a Mercator chart therefore do not give the true distance directly; they must be read only from the latitude scale.
Merkez açı d derece cinsinden bulunduğun: Once the central angle d has been found in degrees, its value in nautical miles can be calculated directly:
Mesafe, D.Lat ve Departure bileşenlerine: The distance is resolved into D.Lat and Departure components
Nötr denge ise geminin küçük bir yatma s: Neutral equilibrium is the special case in which the ship, after a small inclination, tends to stay in her new position. In this state there is neither a righting nor a capsizing moment. The ship stays at whatever angle she is left. It is possible in theory, but in practical ship operation it is undesirable and rarely met.

The loading plan is recorded. These documents are legally valid for PSC inspections and any casualty investigation.
Operasyonel Değerlendirme aşamasında, be: In the Operational Assessment stage, the expected weather, the length of the voyage and particular conditions on the route (narrow waters, shallow water) are taken into account. If heavy weather is expected, increasing the GM margin and minimising the free surface effect are considered.
Orta enlem seyri, düzlem seyirin geometr: Mean latitude sailing does not abandon the geometry of plane sailing completely; it only corrects the longitude component using the mean latitude. This gives a more accurate result over short and medium distances without the need for complex projections.
Orta enlem seyrinde, seyir boyunca değiş: In mean latitude sailing the latitude, which changes during the passage, is represented by a single value. This value is the arithmetic mean of the departure and arrival latitudes. When the change of longitude is calculated, the length of a minute of longitude is taken for this mean latitude.
Ortalama enlem, başlangıç ve varış enlem: The mean latitude is defined as the arithmetic mean of the departure and arrival latitudes. It represents the latitude of the ship over the passage with a single value. In the mean latitude sailing approach, east–west distances are assessed according to the length of a minute of longitude in this latitude.

Raporlama kapsamında, şirket DPA (Design: For reporting, the company DPA (Designated Person Ashore) is informed, the classification society and the flag State are notified and, if necessary, SAR (Search and Rescue) coordination is started. All actions are recorded with their times and results.
Rhumb line (loxodrom), küre üzerindeki t: A rhumb line (loxodrome) is a curve that cuts all meridians on the sphere at a constant angle and gives a constant course throughout the passage. Its appearance as a straight line on the Mercator projection makes practical navigation much easier.
Rhumb line, küre üzerinde meridyenleri s: A rhumb line is a curve that cuts the meridians on the sphere at a constant angle. Because the Mercator projection preserves angles, this curve appears on the chart exactly as a straight line. This lets the navigator draw the track of a ship steering a constant course on the chart with a ruler in one stroke.
Rota ve mesafe, bir dik seyir üçgeni olu: The course and distance form a right-angled sailing triangle
Running fix, açık denizde pratik ve işle: A running fix is practical and useful in the open sea; but if there is a change of course or speed, or if DR discipline is weak, the result is not considered reliable. The method should therefore be used, where possible, to supplement fixes from simultaneous LOPs, not to replace them.
Running fix, göksel seyirde aynı anda el: In celestial navigation a running fix is based on bringing position lines (LOPs) that cannot be obtained at the same time to a common time, allowing for the ship's movement. Observations made at different times are combined at a single time to obtain a fix. It is a practical solution when few celestial bodies are available or when the weather does not allow simultaneous observations.
Running Fix, klasik seyrüseferde tek obj: The running fix is one of the basic terrestrial fixing methods in traditional navigation; it allows a position to be found from a single object and gives high accuracy when time and the ship's movement are applied correctly.
Running Fix, klasik seyrüseferde zaman v: The running fix is one of the basic position-fixing methods in traditional navigation; it brings time and movement into the solution and is highly reliable when applied correctly.

Stabilite Kaybı Belirtileri ve bunlara k: The signs of loss of stability and the immediate actions against them can be summarised as follows:
Şamandıra düzeltmeleri, seyir güvenliğin: Buoy corrections are the chart corrections that affect navigational safety most directly. If a buoy is moved, removed or re-established, the symbol on the chart is cancelled completely and the new position is entered with the correct symbol. If the light character, colour or type of the buoy has changed, all the related descriptive information is updated together with the symbol.
t₁ anına ait LOP, geminin seyir doğrultu: The LOP for time t₁ is transferred parallel to itself along the ship's track by the distance run. This does not change the direction of the LOP; it only moves its position to time t₂.
Tank Yönetimi fonksiyonu, tüm tankların: The tank management function contains the capacity tables of all tanks, the sounding/ullage conversions and the free surface moments. As the contents of the tanks are entered, the software automatically calculates the weight, VCG, LCG and FSM values.
Taşınan LOP ile ikinci LOP’un kesişimi F: The intersection of the transferred LOP and the second LOP gives the fix
Taşınan LOP, orijinal LOP’a paralel kalı: The transferred LOP stays parallel to the original LOP.
Tehlike ile gemi arasında minimum mesafe: A minimum distance is kept between the danger and the ship
Tehlikeye teğet geçer: It passes tangentially to the danger
Tehlikeyi emniyetle teğet geçen bir doğr: A line that passes the danger safely at a tangent is chosen
Transfer Operasyonları seyir sırasında s: Transfer operations affect stability directly during the passage. When transferring fuel, port–starboard symmetry must be kept, the change in GM monitored and the number of slack tanks kept to a minimum. In ballast operations, trim optimisation, GM correction and the IMO Ballast Water Management (BWM) requirements must be assessed together. Especially during ballast exchange at sea, because the sequential method empties and refills the tanks one by one, the stability must be checked for every intermediate condition.
Transit (Leading Line), klasik seyirde e: A transit (leading line) is one of the most reliable and simplest position-fixing methods in traditional navigation and is indispensable especially in areas where navigational safety is critical.
Uyarı İşaretleri aşamasında stabilite ka: In the Warning Signs stage, the signs that a loss of stability has started must be recognised. A marked lengthening of the rolling period indicates that GM has decreased. A tendency of the ship to lean to one side from upright (a loll) shows that GM is approaching zero or has become negative. A steadily increasing angle of heel, with the ship unable to return upright by herself, indicates that a critical loss of stability has begun.
Üç LOP idealde tek noktada kesişir: Ideally three LOPs cross at a single point
Üçgen hem grafik, hem sayısal çözülebili: The triangle can be solved both graphically and numerically
Vardiya Bazında İzleme kapsamında, her v: In watch-by-watch monitoring, the fuel consumption is followed every watch, changes in tank levels are checked, the ship's draft and trim are observed and her rolling characteristics are assessed. A lengthening of the rolling period is an important sign that GM is decreasing and must be investigated at once.
Varsayılan mevki (AP), DR mevkiine yakın: The assumed position (AP) is a point close to the DR position and is the reference point for which Hc and Zn are calculated. The aim is not for it to be “the right point” but to be close enough to the true position. The intercept method works on this assumption of closeness.
VGM (Verified Gross Mass) zorunluluğu, S: Under SOLAS VI/2, the VGM (Verified Gross Mass) requirement has applied since 2016. The weighed or calculated gross mass of every container must be documented before loading. Containers without VGM information must not be loaded on board. The requirement was introduced to prevent stability casualties like those caused in the past by misdeclared weights.

Newly found wrecks and rocks are added to the chart with the correct symbol in the correct position. When tank data are entered, the density and temperature values are checked. The weights and positions of the cargo are specified. Separate calculations are made for both the departure and the arrival conditions, because fuel consumption during the passage can change stability considerably.
Yükleme bilgisayarının temel fonksiyonla: The basic functions of the loading computer fall under four main headings. Under stability calculation, the software calculates the draft, trim and heel, determines KG and GM, produces the GZ curve and checks all the IMO stability criteria automatically. If any criterion is not met, it gives an alarm or warning.
Yüzerlik şartını sağlayan bir gemi, kuvv: A ship that satisfies the condition of flotation is in equilibrium as far as forces are concerned; but this equilibrium alone does not explain how the ship behaves under a small external disturbance. The essence of ship stability is how the ship responds when she is displaced from her position of equilibrium. This response is described by the states of equilibrium and is studied in three basic classes: stable, unstable and neutral equilibrium.

İkincisi, enlem skalası mesafeyle doğru: Second, the latitude scale gives distance directly (1′ of latitude = 1 nautical mile).
Birincisi, hakiki rota (loxodrome) harit: First, a constant true course (loxodrome) appears as a straight line on the chart. Second, the latitude scale gives distance directly (1′ of latitude = 1 nautical mile).

Halatın serbest (çalışan) ucu; bağ atılı: The free end of a line, the part that is moved when making a knot or when the line is passed.
Sarı renkli Q bayrağı; 'Gemim sağlıklıdı: The yellow flag Q; it means 'My vessel is healthy and I request free pratique'. An arriving ship flies it until pratique is granted.
Yelken alanını küçültmek için yelkenin b: Reducing the area of a sail by gathering in part of it and tying it down; the flat knot used for this is the reef knot.
Paketlenmeden doğrudan ambara yüklenen t: Cargo such as grain, coal or ore loaded directly into the hold without packaging.
Sığ suda gemi hızıyla artan batma ve tri: The sinkage and change of trim of a ship moving in shallow water, increasing with speed; full-bodied ships (high Cb) squat more at the bow, fine-lined ships at the stern.
Göksel cisimlerin ufuk ile arasındaki aç: An optical instrument that measures the angle between a celestial body and the horizon; used in celestial navigation.
Yanmış gazların silindirden uzaklaştırıl: Removing the burnt gases from the cylinder and filling it with fresh air.
Yangın Güvenlik Sistemleri Kodu; yangın: The International Code for Fire Safety Systems; standards for fire detection and extinguishing systems.

In the fourth stage a line is drawn thro: In the fourth stage a line is drawn through the intercept point at right angles to the Zn direction. This line is the LOP. It represents every point where the ship could have been at the moment of the sight; the ship is somewhere on this line.
In the second stage a single line is dra: In the second stage a single line is drawn from the AP. This line is Zn and represents the direction in which the celestial body is seen. Zn is not a course and not the direction the ship is heading; it only carries the information “the body lies in this direction”, measured from true north.
In the third stage the difference betwee: In the third stage the difference between Ho and Hc is treated purely as a distance, taking 1′ = 1 nautical mile. This distance is laid off along the Zn line: towards the body if Ho > Hc, away from the body if Ho < Hc. There is still no LOP at this stage; only how far and in which direction the position lies from the AP is established.

The geographic range is the sum of the h: The geographic range is the sum of the horizon distances of the light and of the eye. Onaylı cargo/operations manual, loading: Verify the approved cargo/operations manual, loading plan, ship/shore checklist, communications and emergency stop method together.
Hat, tank/ambar, valf, vent, seviye-bası: Before the operation, confirm the lines, tanks/holds, valves, vents, level/pressure alarms, closing arrangements and appropriate gas measurements.
CSM, test sertifikası, PMS ve defect rep: CSM, test certificates, PMS and defect report
Yük bilgisi, istifleme, sabitleme ve teh: Provisions on cargo information, stowage, securing and dangerous goods
Gemi ve yük tipine uygulanabilen çevre v: Environmental and cargo codes applicable to the ship and cargo type
Gemiye özgü hat, limit, ESD ve operasyon: Ship-specific lines, limits, ESD and operating sequence
Başmühendis/atanmış mühendis; kayıt ve d: The Chief Engineer/assigned engineer; MARPOL/BWM responsibility together with the Master for records and discharge decisions
Onaylı plan/operating manual, sertifika,: Verify the approved plan/operating manual, certificate, calibration, sampling point and line arrangement on the actual pipework.
Bypass veya mühürlü vana durumunu, sensö: Check the status of any bypass or sealed valves, the sensor/alarm self-test and the tank capacity; do not start the operation simply because a type approval exists.
İlgili resmî record book ve elektronik k: The relevant official record book and electronic record
PMS, tank sounding ve reception facility: PMS, tank soundings and reception facility documents
Sistemin ürettiği deşarj, atık veya emis: Provisions applicable to the discharges, waste or emissions produced by the system
Balast yönetim planı, D-2 standardı ve k: Ballast water management plan, D-2 standard and records
Type-approved sistemin gemiye özgü çalış: The ship-specific operating envelope and limitations of the type-approved system
Kaptan gözetimindeki GOC/ROC yetkili tel: The GOC/ROC-qualified radio officer or assigned LSA officer under the Master's supervision; muster list duties for life-saving
Gemi sertifikası, sea area, ekipman kiml: Check the ship's certificate, sea area, equipment identity/MMSI, reserve power, self-test and date/time/position input.
LSA için erişim, securing, release/HRU,: For LSA, verify access, securing, release/HRU, weekly/monthly checks and authorised service dates against the maker's instructions; do not improvise a dangerous release test.
Radio log veya GMDSS test kaydı: Radio log or GMDSS test record
LSA haftalık/aylık kontrol ve drill kayd: LSA weekly/monthly check and drill record
Can kurtarma araçları, hazır bulundurma,: Life-saving appliances, readiness, maintenance and drills
Modernize GMDSS fonksiyonları, deniz ala: Modernised GMDSS functions, sea areas and radio equipment
Filika/rescue boat, launching appliance: Authority for the maintenance/testing of lifeboats/rescue boats, launching appliances and release gear
Windlass statik demirleme yükünü tek baş: The windlass is not left to carry the static anchoring load alone; the functions of the brake, clutch and chain stopper do not replace one another.
Zincirin yönü, şakül/marka, hız, yük ve: Monitor the lead of the chain, the vertical/marks, speed, load and the angle at which it leaves the seabed together.
Fren sıcaklığı, hidrolik basınç/kaçak, m: Assess the brake temperature, hydraulic pressure/leaks, motor current and abnormal noise/vibration as trends.
Köprü ile her komutta kapalı çevrim repe: Use closed-loop repeat-back with the bridge for every order; compare the observed chain movement with the control indicator.
