Demir yerine oturduğunda yükün stopper'a: When the anchor is housed, verify physically that the load has been transferred to the stopper; do not rely on the brake lever position alone.
Kontrolsüz zincir kaçırma, fren tutmamas: Do not continue the operation if the chain runs out uncontrolled, the brake does not hold or personnel enter the line of the chain.
Basınç/akım ani yükselmesi, zincirin haw: Stop and call the Master in the event of a sudden rise in pressure/current, the chain seating wrongly in the hawse pipe, or loss of communication.
Gerçek bir demir ırgadı örneği. Wildcat,: An example of a real anchor windlass. The wildcat, clutch, band brake and chain stopper arrangement varies from ship to ship; a photograph on its own is not an operating diagram.
SWL tek bir evrensel kapasite değildir;: SWL is not a single universal capacity; the outreach, jib angle, grab/spreader weight, dynamic load, trim/list and wind change the load chart.
Load chart, outreach, kanca yüksekliği,: Monitor the load chart, outreach, hook height, rope spooling, brake and limit indicators together with the movement of the load.
Rüzgâr, gemi hareketi, side-pull, yük sa: Continuously reassess the wind, ship movement, side pull, swing of the load and quality of communication.
Yük ağırlığı ve loose gear toplamını bel: Verify the total of the load weight and loose gear from documents/labels; do not lift an unknown load by guesswork.
Yüksüz fonksiyon-fren-limit testi ile fi: Check with a no-load function, brake and limit test that the physical movement matches the direction of the control.
Overload/limit alarmı, fren kaydırması,: Make the load safe in case of an overload/limit alarm, brake slip, wire damage, personnel under the load or loss of communication.
Beklenmeyen list/trim, çatlak/deformasyo: If there is an unexpected list/trim, cracking/deformation, a hydraulic leak or abnormal noise, do not continue without an authorised inspection.
Gemi güverte vinci örneği. Doğru kapasit: An example of a ship's deck crane. The correct capacity is determined not from a photograph but from that crane's load chart, SWL marking and certified loose gear records.
Auto-tension her rıhtım operasyonunda gü: Auto-tension is not a safe default in every berth operation; if the ship/terminal procedure and line arrangement are not suitable, it can cause lines to slacken and tighten in turn.
Halat lead'i, katmanlanma, aşınma, eşit: Physically monitor the line lead, layering, wear, equal load sharing and the snap-back direction.
Fren tutma, render/tension göstergesi, g: Assess the brake holding, render/tension indicator, tide/draft changes and the effect of wind/current together.
Mooring planındaki hat fonksiyonunu ve d: Verify on deck the function of the line in the mooring plan and the correct use of fairleads/bollards.
Fren test sonucu ile üretici/design MBL: Compare the brake test result with the setting based on the manufacturer's/design MBL; do not tighten by feel alone.
Personel bight/snap-back alanındaysa, ha: Stop the winch if personnel are in the bight/snap-back area, the line is jumping or communication is lost.
Fren kayması, pedestal/fairlead deformas: In the event of brake slip, pedestal/fairlead deformation or serious damage to the line, transfer the load to another line under control and report it.
Bir mooring winch kurulum örneği. Tambur: An example of a mooring winch installation. The drum, split drum, warping head and brake arrangement vary from ship to ship; the safe area is not just a painted stripe.
Cleat'leri aşırı sıkmak hasarlı conta, c: Over-tightening the cleats does not make up for a damaged gasket, compression bar or drain; a hose/ultrasonic test result is meaningful only with the correct procedure.
Panel hizası, teker/ray, hidrolik kaçak,: Monitor panel alignment, wheels/rails, hydraulic leaks, cross joints, gasket compression and the drain channel.
Kapatmada cleat yükünü dengeli uygula; c: When closing, apply the cleat load evenly; check the integrity of the coaming, drain non-return valves and access hatches together.
Kapanma sonrası fiziksel kilit/cleat poz: After closing, verify the physical lock/cleat positions and that the drains are clear by walking round with two people.
Yük/hava riskine göre yetkin kişiyle ult: Depending on the cargo/weather risk, carry out an ultrasonic or approved hose test with a competent person; do not mistake a chalk test for a watertightness test.
Panel hareket alanında kişi/engel, hizas: Stop the movement if there are people/obstructions in the path of the panels, panels out of alignment or a safety interlock fault.
Çatlak, kalıcı deformasyon, conta hattın: In the event of cracking, permanent deformation, a serious leak along the gasket line or a locking failure, escalate the decision to sail to the Master/class process.
Gerçek bir ambar kapağı örneği. Fotoğraf: An example of a real hatch cover. The photograph gives the general appearance of the type; weathertightness depends on the gasket, compression bar, cross joints and drains working together.
Capstan halatı kilitleyen bir depolama t: A capstan is not a storage drum that locks the rope; as the number of turns increases, the holding force and the risk of jamming/override increase together.
Halatın düzgün turunu, kuyruk tarafındak: Monitor the even turns of the rope, the stance of the person on the tail and the start of any override.
Motor yükü, warping head yüzeyi, ayak ku: Continuously check the motor load, the warping head surface, the return of the foot control and communications.
Halat lead'inin capstan eksenine uygun v: Before the operation, verify that the rope lead suits the capstan axis and that the fairlead is clear.
Kumandayı bıraktığında hareketin kesildi: Test at no load that the movement stops when the control is released; do not count switching the main switch as a test.
Halat üst üste binmeye, kişinin eli/giys: Stop immediately if the rope starts to override, a person's hand/clothing comes close or control of the tail is lost.
Kumanda takılması, frenlememe, anormal s: If the control sticks, it does not brake, it overheats or the pedestal is cracked, apply LOTO and report it.
Dikey capstan/warping head örneği. Halat: An example of a vertical capstan/warping head. The direction of the turns and the safe position of the operator are set by the ship's actual fairlead arrangement.
Radar her hedefi garanti ederek gösterme: Radar does not guarantee to show every target; clutter settings can remove a target, and the ARPA CPA/TCPA is an estimate that depends on the sensors, tracking time and target manoeuvres.
Brilliance, range, orientation/motion, g: Set the brilliance, range, orientation/motion, gain, tuning, sea/rain clutter and pulse to suit the conditions; check on different ranges that the automatic settings are not suppressing small targets.
Relative/true vector, vector time, targe: Do not treat CPA/TCPA as a decision value without reading the relative/true vector, vector time, target history, acquisition status and the heading/speed sensor.
Hedefi görsel kerteriz, ikinci radar, AI: Cross-check the target with a visual bearing, a second radar, the AIS identity and, if possible, the chart/PI; do not mistake an AIS symbol for a radar echo.
EBL/VRM ve paralel index'i sabit harita: Check the EBL/VRM and parallel index against a fixed charted object; if the heading marker/antenna alignment or range/bearing accuracy is in doubt, carry out a performance test.
Heading veya speed input kaybı, yanlış m: If the heading or speed input is lost, the motion/vector mode is wrong, there is a radar/antenna fault or obvious misalignment, do not trust the ARPA result and call the Master.
Kötü görüşte hedef algısı yetersizse saf: If target detection is inadequate in poor visibility, reassess the safe speed, reinforce the lookout and organise the team for early and substantial action in accordance with COLREG.
Radar performance/PM ve compass bearing: Radar performance/PM and compass bearing check record
Passage plan üzerindeki PI/clearing rang: PI/clearing range information on the passage plan
Gemi radarlarının revize performans stan: Revised performance standards for shipborne radar
Gözcülük, emniyetli hız, çatışma riski,: Look-out, safe speed, risk of collision, action to avoid collision and restricted visibility
Radar/ARPA kullanımı ve emniyetli köprüü: Use of radar/ARPA and a safe bridge watch
X-band bir radar PPI/ARPA konsolu örneği: An example of an X-band radar PPI/ARPA console. The green echoes on the screen show the real surroundings; the manufacturer's interface may be old, but the logic of range, gain, clutter, EBL/VRM, vectors and trails is the same on current radars.
ECDIS kendi başına emniyetli rota üretme: ECDIS does not produce a safe route on its own; legal equivalence depends on type approval, official and up-to-date data, correct use and an adequate independent back-up arrangement together.
Appraisal'da tüm rota için resmî ENC kap: In the appraisal, check official ENC coverage, usage band/scale, permits and update status for the whole route; in planning, check the safety depth/contour, XTD, look-ahead, no-go areas, wheel-over and abort points.
Monitoring sırasında seçili position/hea: During monitoring, watch the selected position/heading/speed source, chart scale/overscale, off-track, safety contour and special-condition alerts; do not acknowledge an alarm without understanding its cause.
Primary GNSS mevkiini radar/visual fix,: Cross-check the primary GNSS position with a radar/visual fix, a second independent PNT source or another suitable method; do not treat the radar overlay alignment as independent evidence of position.
Automatic route check sonrasında rotayı: After the automatic route check, inspect the route leg by leg visually at the largest suitable ENC scale; take mariner action for isolated dangers, CATZOC/quality, SCAMIN and temporary/preliminary information.
Resmî kapsam/permit/update yokluğu, upda: Do not approve the plan if official coverage/permits/updates are missing, an update is rejected, the datum/PNT is in doubt or the back-up arrangement cannot be used; escalate to the Master and the company procedure.
Position jump/freeze, heading uyuşmazlığ: In the event of a position jump/freeze, heading mismatch, safety alarm or unplanned deviation, first bring the ship into a safe navigational condition; do not let following the route line on the screen become an automatic reflex.
ENC update report, permit ve update reje: ENC update report, permit and update rejection record
Master-approved passage plan/revision ve: Master-approved passage plan/revision and alarm/position cross-check records
1 Ocak 2009-31 Aralık 2025 arasında kuru: Revised performance standards for ECDIS installed between 1 January 2009 and 31 December 2025
1 Ocak 2026-2028 kurulumlarında alternat: Alternative for installations from 1 January 2026 to 2028; the new/S-100 ECDIS standard from 1 January 2029
ECDIS için iyi uygulama, data/maintenanc: Good practice for ECDIS; data/maintenance/training roles
Gösterim, ENC veri/koruma ve denizci kul: Presentation, ENC data/protection and mariner's guidance for use
Ortadaki ekran ECDIS, yanlardaki ekranla: The display in the middle is the ECDIS; the displays on either side are radar consoles. The photograph shows the ECDIS in the context of an integrated bridge; although chart colours and menus vary with the manufacturer/standard, official data, safety settings and independent position checks do not change.
AIS hedef tespit sensörü değildir; yanlı: AIS is not a target detection sensor; data may be wrong, delayed, entered incorrectly by hand or not transmitted at all, and AIS alone does not carry a COLREG decision.
MMSI/call sign/IMO, draft, destination,: Keep the MMSI/call sign/IMO number, draft, destination, ETA and navigational status fields correct for the voyage; monitor the sensor status and position age.
CPA/TCPA ve association durumunu radar e: Compare the CPA/TCPA and association status with the radar echo; check whether the same target is producing two symbols or a wrong merge.
AIS kimliğini radar echo/bearing-range v: Match the AIS identity with the radar echo/bearing–range and visual observation; prove that the ship whose name appears on the screen is the same as the physical target.
Own-ship yayınını uygun test/shore repor: Verify the own-ship transmission with a suitable test/shore report or a second receiver according to the procedure; the decision to switch off for security reasons is made and recorded by the Master.
Yanlış own-ship identity/position, sürek: If the own-ship identity/position is wrong, there is a continuous TX alarm or spoofing is suspected, stop using the data as a basis for decisions and inform the Master.
Hedef manevrası AIS ile radar arasında u: If the target's manoeuvre does not agree between AIS and radar, go back to radar plotting and visual information; do not let a VHF agreement replace COLREG responsibility.
Bir Class A AIS MKD örneği. Bu fiziksel: An example of a Class A AIS MKD. This physical display is only the minimum display; on a modern ship AIS data are usually presented on the ECDIS/radar, and they are still not a radar echo.
GNSS ekrandaki hassasiyet kadar doğru ka: GNSS cannot be assumed to be as accurate as the precision shown on the display; the antenna/multipath, geometry, augmentation, jamming/spoofing and datum integrity affect the result.
Kullanılan constellation, datum, positio: Monitor the constellation used, datum, position age, HDOP/quality/RAIM and alarm indicators according to the phase of the voyage.
COG/SOG'nin düşük hızdaki oynaklığını he: Distinguish the fluctuation of COG/SOG at low speed from the heading/log data; remember that the same GNSS source can create a common error in all systems.
Mevkiyi radar/visual/terrestrial fix ve: Cross-check the position with a radar/visual/terrestrial fix and, if possible, an independent antenna/receiver; seeing the same coordinates on two displays is not independent verification.
Jamming/spoofing şüphesinde zaman, COG/S: If jamming/spoofing is suspected, check the time, COG/SOG, AIS targets, radar overlay and alignment with charted objects together.
Ani position jump, imkânsız hız/rota, in: In the event of a sudden position jump, impossible speed/course, an integrity alarm or the same deviation on several GNSS receivers, remove the dependence on the autopilot/track control and call the Master.
Kıyı yaklaşmasında doğrulanamayan mevkiy: When approaching the coast, do not rely on appearing within the planned XTD with a position that cannot be verified; go back to a safe speed/area and manual fixing.
Köprüüstü GNSS alıcısı örneği. Ekrandaki: An example of a bridge GNSS receiver. The coordinates on the screen are not proof of accuracy; the quality/integrity indicators and independent position checks must be read together.
Gyro ve manyetik pusula farklı kuzey ref: The gyro and magnetic compass have different north references and error models; repeaters showing the same value does not prove that the master compass is accurate.
Master-repeater farkı, gyro alarmı, lati: Monitor the master–repeater difference, gyro alarms, latitude/speed inputs and, on the magnetic compass, bubbles/freedom of the card/the effect of deviation.
Her vardiya ve belirgin rota/enlem/hız d: Check the compass error trend with a suitable method every watch and after significant changes of course/latitude/speed; do not accept a single measurement as absolute.
Gyro error'ı celestial azimuth/amplitude: Calculate the gyro error by celestial azimuth/amplitude or a reliable transit, and the magnetic error by separating variation and deviation.
Steering, radar ve ECDIS heading değerle: Compare the steering, radar and ECDIS heading values with the master/repeater; distinguish a distribution fault from a compass fault.
Heading jump, repeater uyumsuzluğu veya: In the event of a heading jump, repeater mismatch or a gyro error that cannot be checked, leave automatic/track steering appropriately and set up back-up navigation with the magnetic compass.
Manyetik pusula yakınına yeni ferromanye: If new ferromagnetic/electrical equipment has been placed near the magnetic compass, do not take the old card as definitive until the deviation has been checked.
Fotoğraf bir gyro repeater/azimuth circl: The photograph shows a gyro repeater/azimuth circle arrangement; it must not be confused with a magnetic compass binnacle. The master gyro, repeaters and magnetic compass have separate error checks.
Echo sounder charted depth veya tam UKC: The echo sounder reading is not the charted depth or the full UKC; draft, transducer offset, tide, squat/heel and sound velocity effects are dealt with separately.
Range, gain, frequency, keel/transducer: Monitor the range, gain, frequency, keel/transducer offset, shallow alarm and bottom lock against the actual depth of water.
Aeration, heavy weather, soft mud, steep: Recognise false traces such as aeration, heavy weather, soft mud, a steep bottom and second echoes; notice when automatic range loses the bottom.
Gösterim referansını gemi draftı/offset: Verify the display reference against the ship's draft/offset document; do not confuse 'below keel', 'below transducer' and 'below surface' values.
Charted depth+tide ile ölçümü trend olar: Compare the measurement with charted depth + tide as a trend; if they differ, consider survey quality, squat, heel and sound velocity.
Sığ su alarmı, bottom loss veya beklenme: On a shallow water alarm, bottom loss or an unexpectedly rapid decrease in depth, call the Master and reassess the speed/course and UKC plan.
Offset bilinmiyorsa ekrandaki sayıyı UKC: If the offset is not known, do not report the displayed figure as UKC; do not continue the approach without a reliable back-up measurement/area.
Tarihî kâğıt kayıtlı bir echo sounder ör: This is an example of a historical echo sounder with a paper recorder; modern bridges use colour digital displays. What matters in training is the transducer reference, gain/range, the bottom echo and the UKC distinction.
Tek bir exhaust temperature veya scaveng: There is no universal normal value for a single exhaust temperature or scavenge pressure; the trend between cylinders is read against the maker's limits.
Silindir egzoz sıcaklığı farkı, scavenge: Trend the exhaust temperature difference between cylinders, scavenge pressure/temperature, Pmax/IMEP, bearing/LO values and turbocharger behaviour together.
Slow steaming, manevra ve yük artışında: Apply the limits on thermal load, excess air, liner lubrication and the torsional barred range during slow steaming, manoeuvring and load increases.
Otomasyon değerini lokal gösterge/indepe: Verify the automation value with a local gauge/independent thermometer-pressure gauge and by comparison between cylinders.
Köprü telegraph komutu, governor/fuel in: Confirm in a closed loop the bridge telegraph order, the governor/fuel index and the actual rpm/pitch response.
Crankcase oil mist, scavenge fire işaret: In the event of crankcase oil mist, signs of a scavenge fire, severe bearing temperature/LO loss or overspeed, apply the maker's emergency response.
Anormal vuruntu, hızlı egzoz sapması vey: In the event of abnormal knocking, a rapid exhaust deviation or metal particles, reduce the load safely; the Chief Engineer decides on restart/inspection.
Düşük devirli iki zamanlı ana makinenin: An example of the top platform/cylinder covers of a slow-speed two-stroke main engine. The internal cycle and the oil–air–fuel flow must be read from the system diagram.
Ana tahrik ve genset uygulamasında gover: The governor/load sharing/gear limits differ between main propulsion and generator applications; automatic load acceptance does not replace mechanical preparation.
Egzoz sıcaklık balansı, charge air, LO/C: Monitor the exhaust temperature balance, charge air, LO/CW, crankcase, turbocharger speed and generator/gear load together.
Start-stop sayısı, düşük yükte kurum/wet: Manage the number of starts and stops, fouling/wet stacking at low load and the effect of sudden load steps according to the maker's limits.
Lokal basınç/sıcaklığı otomasyonla karşı: Compare local pressures/temperatures with the automation; prove a cylinder cut-out or load balance result with the exhaust trend.
Clutch/gear veya breaker bağlantısından: Before engaging the clutch/gear or closing the breaker, verify the rpm, phase/load sharing and permissive status.
LO loss, overspeed, crankcase mist, cool: In the event of LO loss, overspeed, crankcase mist, cooling failure or serious knocking, carry out a safe shutdown without bypassing the protection.
Start air/fuel leak, misfire veya yük pa: In the event of a starting air/fuel leak, misfiring or unstable load sharing, plan the changeover to the standby engine and inform the Chief Engineer.
An example of a medium-speed four-stroke engine. The generator or propulsion connection and the valve/turbocharger arrangement vary with the model.
Bearing sıcaklığının normal olması align: A normal bearing temperature does not on its own prove the alignment, wear-down and integrity of the stern tube seals.
Bearing temperature, vibration, stern tu: Trend the bearing temperature, vibration, stern tube oil level/pressure, seal leakage and coupling/shaft behaviour against rpm and load.
Hull deflection, draft/trim ve sıcaklık: Assess the effect of hull deflection, draft/trim and temperature changes on the alignment measurements in the context of maintenance.
Sensör trendini lokal inspection, oil sa: Cross-check the sensor trend with local inspection, oil samples, wear-down/poker gauge readings and class/maker tolerances.
Vibration artışını motor combustion, pro: Do not replace parts before separating an increase in vibration into combustion, propeller fouling/damage and shaft alignment sources.
Hızlı bearing temp artışı, metalik ses,: In the event of a rapid rise in bearing temperature, a metallic noise, a large oil loss/seal leak or severe vibration, reduce the rpm safely and inform the Chief Engineer.
Shaft earth/grounding veya turning gear: In the event of a shaft earthing/grounding or turning gear interlock fault, do not return to normal operation without a maker/class assessment.
Makine dairesindeki şaft hattı ve yatak: An example of the shaft line and a bearing in the engine room. The photograph gives the external appearance; thrust transmission, the stern tube and alignment measurements are understood from the diagram.
Pitch, rpm ve güç tek başına itme/verim: Pitch, rpm and power alone are not thrust or efficiency; wake, slip, cavitation, fouling, draft and sea state change the result.
Shaft rpm/power, CPP pitch feedback, vib: Monitor the shaft rpm/power, CPP pitch feedback, vibration, speed/slip and stern tube/gear load together.
Cavitation/ventilation işaretleri, ağır: Assess signs of cavitation/ventilation, racing in heavy weather and the barred range according to the operating conditions.
Pitch command-feedback'i ve shaft power': Compare the pitch command–feedback and shaft power with the sea trial/baseline trend; do not diagnose a propeller fault from loss of speed alone.
Underwater damage/fouling şüphesini vibr: Verify a suspicion of underwater damage/fouling with the vibration spectrum, the fuel–power–speed trend and a suitable inspection.
Pitch runaway/feedback mismatch, severe: In the event of pitch runaway/feedback mismatch, severe vibration or reaching the shaft torque limit, reduce the load with bridge–engine room coordination.
Blade/hub oil leak ya da grounding sonra: Do not use high power after a blade/hub oil leak or a grounding without a class/maker inspection.
Pervane ve dümen kurulum örneği. Blade g: An example of a propeller and rudder installation. Blade geometry, pitch and tip clearance are not measured from a photograph; approved drawings and survey data are used.
Rudder angle indicator komutu değil gerç: The rudder angle indicator must show the actual feedback, not the command; autopilot performance does not replace the steering gear safety test.
Command-actual rudder farkı, pump pressu: Monitor the difference between commanded and actual rudder, pump pressure/temperature, oil level/leaks, hunting and response time.
Heavy weather veya düşük hızda dümen etk: In heavy weather or at low speed, assess the rudder effect together with propulsion/wake; do not keep loading the limit stop continuously.
Pre-departure steering testinde full mov: In the pre-departure steering test, physically verify full movement, timing, pumps, remote/local/emergency control, indicators, alarms and bridge–steering gear room communications.
Gyro/autopilot hatasını lokal follow-up/: Separate a gyro/autopilot fault from the steering gear using local follow-up/non-follow-up control and the actual rudder feedback.
Rudder response kaybı, hydraulic burst/l: In the event of loss of rudder response, a hydraulic burst/leak, conflicting indicators or uncontrollable hunting, apply the emergency steering procedure and call the Master.
Bir güç ünitesi arızasında kalan kapasit: After a power unit failure, do not continue normal manoeuvring without verifying the remaining capacity and the SOLAS/maker limits.
External view of the rudder behind the propeller. The steering gear, ram/rotary vane and back-up control arrangement are inside the ship and are examined with a separate diagram.
Breaker'ın kapanması güvenli paraleli te: Closing the breaker does not on its own prove safe paralleling; phase sequence, voltage, frequency, synchronism, reverse power and load sharing work together.
kW/kVAr, current balance, voltage/freque: Monitor kW/kVAr, current balance, voltage/frequency, PF, winding/bearing temperatures and engine exhaust/LO/CW values together.
Load step, spinning reserve, preferentia: Manage load steps, spinning reserve, preferential trips and standby auto-start readiness according to the ship's operation.
Senkron koşullarını synchroscope/lamp ve: Verify the synchronising conditions with the synchroscope/lamps and the protection permissive; do not try paralleling with the wrong phase sequence.
Load sharing'i her jeneratörün kW/kVAr t: Cross-check load sharing with each generator's kW/kVAr response and the governor/AVR mode.
Reverse power, differential/earth fault,: Do not bypass the protection in the event of reverse power, a differential/earth fault, unstable frequency/voltage or a serious engine alarm.
Blackout riskinde kritik yükleri koru, s: If there is a risk of blackout, protect the critical loads, apply the standby/emergency source procedure and call the Chief Engineer.
Gemi dizel jeneratör seti örneği. Prime: An example of a ship's diesel generator set. The prime mover, the alternator and the MSB protection chain are separate components.
Su seviye göstergesi tek noktadan doğrul: A water level indication is not accepted as reliable without verification from more than one point; the low-low water and flame failure interlocks are not bypassed for operational convenience.
İki bağımsız level göstergesi, steam pre: Trend the two independent level indicators, steam pressure, flame, FD fan/draft, feed flow and water chemistry.
Light-up/purge, burner sequence ve sudde: During light-up/purge, the burner sequence and sudden load changes, distinguish the swell/shrink effect from the actual water level.
Gauge glass blow-through ve independent: Carry out the gauge glass blow-through and independent level alarm test in the maker/SMS sequence; do not accept the transmitter value on its own.
Safety valve, flame scanner ve low-water: Verify the safety valve, flame scanner and low-water trip tests with an authorised procedure and records.
Low-low water, flame failure sonrası yak: In the event of low-low water, fuel accumulation after a flame failure, a furnace blowback or a suspected tube leak, carry out a safe shutdown/purge immediately.
Susuz kazana doğrudan feed verme; soğutm: Do not feed water directly into a boiler that has run dry; the decision on cooling and inspection is set by the Chief Engineer/maker's procedure.
Gemi yardımcı kazanı örneği. Burner, fur: An example of a ship's auxiliary boiler. The burner, furnace, drum and safety devices are not fully visible in an external photograph.
Purifier kapasitesi nominal debi değildi: Purifier capacity is not the nominal flow rate; viscosity/temperature, density, interface setting and the actual contamination change the separation result.
Feed temperature/viscosity, pressure, bo: Monitor the feed temperature/viscosity, pressure, bowl speed, vibration, back pressure and discharge cycle.
Water seal/interface veya ALCAP water se: Manage the water seal/interface or ALCAP water sensor behaviour according to the oil type with the maker's settings.
Clean oil sample ve drain/sludge gözlemi: Compare the clean oil sample and drain/sludge observations with the inlet condition; do not take the absence of alarms as proof of separation.
Bowl assembly, gravity disc/parring disc: Verify the correct type/fitting of the bowl assembly, gravity disc/paring disc and sealing rings against the overhaul drawing.
High vibration, abnormal bowl noise, oil: In the event of high vibration, abnormal bowl noise, oil overflow or loss of speed, stop the feed and apply the maker's shutdown sequence.
Sıcak yağ kaçağında ignition kaynakların: In the event of a hot oil leak, isolate the sources of ignition; do not open the bowl until it has stopped completely.
Fuel-oil separator/purifier örneği. Bowl: An example of a fuel oil separator/purifier. The internal structure of the bowl and disc stack is not visible in the photograph; the correct flow diagram is what matters.
Receiver basıncı tek başına hava kalites: Receiver pressure alone does not prove air quality or compressor safety; the discharge temperature, drains, relief valves and oil carry-over are monitored.
Stage pressure/temperature, cooling wate: Monitor the stage pressures/temperatures, cooling water, LO, unloader and automatic drain behaviour.
Start frequency ve receiver pressure dec: Trend the start frequency and receiver pressure decay against leakage/air demand.
Interstage gauge ve relief/non-return du: Compare the interstage gauge and relief/non-return valve status by local checks with the automation.
Receiver drain condensate/oil miktarı il: Cross-check the amount of condensate/oil drained from the receiver with the discharge air quality and the compressor condition.
High discharge temp, relief lifting, kno: Stop the compressor in the event of a high discharge temperature, a relief valve lifting, knocking, loss of cooling or oil carry-over.
Receiver/line üzerinde çalışmadan pressu: Before working on the receiver/lines, isolate the pressure, drain and apply LOTO; do not rely on the stop button alone.
An example of a reciprocating starting air compressor. The intercooler, separator, non-return valve and receiver chain are an integral part of the system.
Pompa tipi ve duty point eşleşmeden 'val: An 'open the valve and run it' approach is not safe unless the pump type and duty point match; centrifugal and positive displacement pumps behave differently at shut-off.
Suction/discharge pressure, flow, motor: Monitor the suction/discharge pressure, flow, motor current, vibration, seal leakage and bearing temperature together with the duty point.
Cavitation, loss of prime, dead-heading: Distinguish cavitation, loss of prime, dead-heading and the minimum-flow requirement according to the pump type.
Valve lineup ve tank level'i P&ID/fiziks: Verify the valve line-up and tank level from the P&ID and a physical round; do not rely on the mimic display alone.
Basınç farkını gerçek akış/level change: Cross-check the pressure difference with the actual flow/level change; after maintenance, verify the direction of rotation at no load.
Dry running, cavitation, seal failure, r: Stop the pump in the event of dry running, cavitation, seal failure, a rapid rise in pressure/current or a PD relief valve failure.
Kimyasal/sıcak/yanıcı akışkan kaçağında: In the event of a leak of a chemical/hot/flammable fluid, isolate the area and move to the appropriate PPE/permit procedure.
Makine dairesindeki santrifüj pompa örne: An example of a centrifugal pump in the engine room. Not every pump application is the same; the P&ID, pump curve and minimum-flow arrangement must be read.
Üretilen düşük-salinity distillate otoma: The low-salinity distillate produced is not automatically drinkable; mineralisation/disinfection and the potable water standard are a separate chain.
Vacuum, temperatures, ejector/seawater f: Trend the vacuum, temperatures, ejector/seawater flow, production rate and salinity against the feed condition.
RO'da differential pressure/conductivity: Monitor the differential pressure/conductivity on an RO unit, and signs of scale/foaming and demister carry-over on an evaporator.
Salinometer'ı doğrulanmış sample/conduct: Cross-check the salinometer with a verified sample/conductivity; carry out the high-salinity automatic dump test according to the maker's procedure.
Potable transfer öncesi dezenfeksiyon ve: Before transfer to potable water tanks, verify the disinfection and laboratory/shipboard test requirements according to the ship's plan.
High salinity, vacuum loss, membrane pre: In the event of high salinity, loss of vacuum, membrane pressure limit or chemical dosing failure, do not deliver the product to the potable tank.
Contamination şüphesinde tankı izole et,: If contamination is suspected, isolate the tank, take a sample and await the decision of the Chief Engineer/Master.
Evaporator tip fresh-water generator örn: An example of an evaporator-type fresh water generator. An RO unit looks different; product quality control is mandatory for both systems.
Her gemi atığı yakılamaz; MARPOL, yerel/: Not all ship's waste can be incinerated; MARPOL, local/port prohibitions, the type approval and the maker's feed limits apply together.
Chamber temperatures, draft/O2, burner f: Monitor the chamber temperatures, draft/O₂, burner flame, feed rate and flue condition against the type-approved cycle.
PVC/halogenated material, pressurized co: Separate out PVC/halogenated material, pressurised containers, unknown chemicals and prohibited waste before feeding.
Atık kaynağı/miktarı ile incinerator/slu: Cross-check the source/quantity of waste with the incinerator/sludge tank mass balance and the quantity of ash.
Temperature sensor/interlock ve door sea: Verify the temperature sensors/interlocks and door seal with the PMS test; do not rely on the displayed value alone.
Flame failure, low temperature, positive: In the event of flame failure, low temperature, positive pressure/smoke leakage or refractory damage, stop the feed and carry out the purge/cool-down.
Yasak atık veya emisyon şüphesinde yakma: If prohibited waste or emissions are suspected, stop incinerating and follow the MARPOL/port procedure.
15 ppm göstergesi deşarj izni değildir;: A 15 ppm reading is not a permission to discharge; the Annex I conditions, special area/local restrictions, being en route, approved equipment and correct records must all be met together.
Feed condition, pressure drop, temperatu: Monitor the feed condition, pressure drop, temperature/emulsion, ppm trend, sample flow and the automatic stopping response.
Detergent/chemical emulsion ve clean-wat: Ensure that detergent/chemical emulsions and clean-water flushing do not falsify the real sample; do not create a bypass.
Gerçek valve lineup ve overboard/recircu: Compare the actual valve line-up and the overboard/recirculation return on a physical round with the mimic display.
15 ppm alarm/automatic stop testini onay: Verify the 15 ppm alarm/automatic stop test with the approved method and a valid calibration; the test result must agree with the ORB entry.
ppm yükselişi, sample loss, alarm/auto-s: Close the overboard discharge if the ppm rises, the sample is lost, the alarm/auto-stop fails, a seal/bypass is suspected or the legal position condition is not met.
Arızayı seyreltme veya manuel valfle aşm: Do not overcome a fault by dilution or with a manual valve; set up the holding capacity/reception facility plan with the Master and Chief Engineer.
Plant running göstergesi effluent standa: A 'plant running' indication does not prove the effluent standard; the hydraulic/organic load, disinfectant, sludge and Annex IV/local discharge conditions are monitored.
Blower/aeration, level, return sludge, d: Trend the blower/aeration, level, return sludge, disinfectant, odour/foam and effluent clarity daily.
Toxic cleaner/chemical shock, overload v: Manage the effect on the biomass of toxic cleaners/chemical shocks, overloading and long idle periods.
Effluent sample/test ve disinfectant res: Cross-check the effluent sample/test and disinfectant residual against the equipment limits.
Discharge/holding valve lineup'ını konum: Verify the discharge/holding valve line-up physically before reaching the position and checking the local rules.
Blower loss, overflow, failed disinfecti: In the event of blower loss, overflow, failed disinfection or non-compliant effluent, close the overboard discharge and move to the holding/reception plan.
Kapalı tank/plant müdahalesinde enclosed: Do not enter a closed tank/plant for work without an enclosed-space and biological hazard permit.
Outlet sıcaklığını tutturmak exchanger'ı: Holding the outlet temperature does not on its own show that the exchanger is clean or sound; bypass, flow and cross-contamination are monitored.
Her iki taraf inlet/outlet temperature,: Trend the inlet/outlet temperatures, pressure drop, flow and control valve position on both sides together.
Fouling, air lock, gasket/tube leak ve t: Assess signs of fouling, air locks, gasket/tube leaks and thermal expansion against changes in load.
Heat balance ve sample/level değişimiyle: Check for cross-leakage by heat balance and sample/level changes; do not look only at the pressure on one side.
Temizlik sonrası pressure test/plate tig: After cleaning, verify the pressure test/plate tightening or tube plugging record against the maker's tolerance.
Rapid cross-contamination, major leak, h: In the event of rapid cross-contamination, a major leak, high pressure drop or loss of cooling, reduce the load and isolate the exchanger.
Sıcak/basınçlı ekipmanı drain-vent-cool: Do not open hot/pressurised equipment without draining, venting, cooling and LOTO.
Suction/discharge pressure tek başına ch: Suction/discharge pressure alone does not diagnose the charge; superheat, subcooling, room/product temperature, airflow and defrost are assessed together.
Room/product temperature, suction/discha: Trend the room/product temperature, suction/discharge, superheat, condenser cooling, oil level and defrost cycle.
Ice pattern, fan/door seal, drain ve ref: Monitor the ice pattern, fan/door seals, drains and refrigerant leak detector status on a physical round.
Gauge readings'i calibrated thermometer: Cross-check gauge readings with a calibrated thermometer and the compressor current; rule out leak/airflow/defrost causes before adding refrigerant.
Stand-by compressor/room alarmı ve emerg: Test the standby compressor/room alarm and the emergency response before any risk to the cargo arises.
High discharge pressure/temp, low oil, s: Do not bypass the unit's protection in the event of high discharge pressure/temperature, low oil, a severe leak or signs of liquid slugging in the compressor.
Refrigerant kaçağında havalandır, alanı: In the event of a refrigerant leak, ventilate, isolate the area and apply the gas safety data/permit procedure.
Acil jeneratörün çalışması acil güç düze: The emergency generator running does not prove that the emergency power arrangement is sound; the automatic start time, the correct consumer list, separation of the interconnector and the supply duration are verified together.
Yakıt seviyesi, akü gerilimi/şarj, blok: Monitor the fuel level, battery voltage/charge, block heater, room ventilation and the mode (auto/manual) position.
Test sırasında gerilim/frekans oturma sü: During the test, assess the time taken for voltage/frequency to settle, the behaviour under load and signs of wet stacking.
Otomatik start dizisini ve interconnecto: Verify the automatic start sequence and the separation of the interconnector with a real loss-of-supply scenario, as far as the SMS allows; do not consider a manual start test sufficient.
Beslenen tüketicilerin onaylı elektrik ş: Check that the consumers supplied match the emergency consumer list on the approved electrical diagram.
Otomatik start, yük alma veya transfer a: In the event of a failure of automatic start, load acceptance or transfer, do not consider the arrangement serviceable; escalate it to the Chief Engineer/Master as a critical defect.
Testten sonra set otomatik modda değilse: If the set is not in automatic mode after the test, the ship is considered to be without emergency power; correct it immediately and record it.
Acil jeneratör mahalli örneği. Bağımsız: An example of an emergency generator room. The independent fuel, starting and emergency switchboard arrangements are not fully visible in the photograph.
Şaft jeneratörü ana makineye bağımlıdır;: The shaft generator depends on the main engine; since a main engine trip can mean a direct loss of electrical power, it is not managed as a sole source.
kW/kVAr, frekans/gerilim kararlılığı, ko: Monitor kW/kVAr, frequency/voltage stability, converter temperature, harmonics and the shaft speed/pitch feedback together.
Seyir safhasına göre stand-by dizel jene: Manage the readiness of the standby diesel generator and the PMS changeover logic according to the phase of the voyage.
Senkron koşullarını ve yük transferini g: Cross-check the synchronising conditions and load transfer with the actual kW response; actually try the changeover to the auxiliary generator before manoeuvring.
Konvertörlü düzende sabit frekansın gerç: In a converter arrangement, verify with an independent measurement that a constant frequency is really maintained.
Frekans/gerilim kararsızlığı, konvertör: In the event of frequency/voltage instability, converter overtemperature or operation of the protection, take the shaft generator off the busbar and change over to the auxiliary generator.
Manevra ve dar su geçişlerinde tek kayna: Do not rely on the shaft generator as the sole source during manoeuvres and narrow-water passages; bring standby capacity on line in advance.
İtici kuvveti gemi hızı arttıkça hızla d: Thruster force falls rapidly as the ship's speed increases, and the electrical load can create a blackout risk; the position of the control lever does not prove the actual thrust produced.
Motor akımı/sargı sıcaklığı, hatve geri: Monitor the motor current/winding temperature, pitch feedback, vibration, gearbox oil level and busbar frequency together.
Sürekli tam güç kullanım süresini ve tek: Manage the duration of continuous full-power use and the restart interval according to the manufacturer's limits.
Kumanda talebi, hatve göstergesi ve gemi: Compare the control demand, the pitch indicator and the ship's actual response during manoeuvres; do not rely on the indicator value alone.
Kullanım öncesi devrede yeterli jeneratö: Before use, verify from the PMS and busbar load that sufficient generator capacity is on line.
Aşırı titreşim, hatve geri besleme kaybı: Stop using it and inform the bridge in the event of excessive vibration, loss of pitch feedback, a motor temperature alarm or a fall in the oil level.
Tünel bölgesinde dalgıç/temizlik çalışma: If divers/cleaners are working in the tunnel area, do not give any command until the thruster has been electrically isolated and locked.
Tünel tipi baş itici örneği. Izgara, per: An example of a tunnel-type bow thruster. The grating, propeller and gearbox arrangement are not fully visible in the photograph.
Hedef sıcaklığın tutması eşanjörün temiz: Holding the target temperature does not show that the exchanger is clean or the circuit sound; flow, differential pressure, valve position and water chemistry are assessed together.
Deniz suyu süzgeç fark basıncı, pompa ba: Trend the seawater strainer differential pressure, pump pressures, HT/LT inlet and outlet temperatures and expansion tank level together with the load.
Sığ/çamurlu/buzlu sularda sandık seçimin: Manage the choice of sea chest and the MGPS status according to the operating conditions in shallow/muddy/icy waters.
Aynı yükte artan sıcaklık farkını temizl: Before interpreting a rising temperature difference at the same load as a need for cleaning, verify the flow and valve positions physically.
Genleşme tankındaki seviye değişimini ka: Cross-check level changes in the expansion tank with a pressure test, traces of oil/gas and chloride measurement to distinguish a leak from internal leakage.
Soğutma kaybı, deniz suyu emiş kaybı vey: In the event of loss of cooling, loss of seawater suction or suspected internal leakage, reduce the load, change over to the standby pump and inform the Chief Engineer.
Sıcak HT devresinde basınç düşürülüp sıc: Do not open a cover/valve on the hot HT circuit until the pressure has been released and the temperature has fallen to a safe level.
Sıcaklık değeri tek başına doğru enjeksi: The temperature value alone does not prove correct injection; the decisive quantity is viscosity, and the supply/booster pressure stages are needed to prevent gas locking.
Besleme/booster basıncı, ısıtıcı çıkış s: Monitor the supply/booster pressure, heater outlet temperature, viscosity value, filter differential pressure and automatic backflush frequency together.
Yakıt değişiminde sıcaklık değişim hızın: During fuel changeover, manage the rate of temperature change and the transition time in the mixing tank according to the manufacturer's limits.
Viskozimetre değerini numune/laboratuvar: Cross-check the viscometer value with sample/laboratory data and the heater outlet temperature.
Servis tankı drenajı ve filtre bulguları: Assess the service tank drain and filter findings together with separator performance; do not blame the filter alone.
Yakıt pompalarında sıkışma, ani basınç k: In the event of fuel pump seizure, sudden loss of pressure, a serious leak or loss of viscosity control, reduce the load and make a planned changeover to a safe fuel.
Sıcak yakıt kaçağında tutuşma kaynakları: In the event of a hot fuel leak, isolate the ignition sources; do not open the line while it is under pressure.
Yağ basıncının normal görünmesi film kal: A normal-looking oil pressure does not prove the film thickness or oil quality; water content, viscosity and wear metals are a separate chain.
Yağ basıncı/sıcaklığı, filtre fark basın: Record the oil pressure/temperature, filter differential pressure and the tank and stern tube header tank levels on rounds.
Silindir yağı besleme oranını yük ve yak: Manage the cylinder oil feed rate together with the load and fuel sulphur, and with the iron/alkalinity results of the scrape-down analysis.
Yağ numunesi sonuçlarını (su, viskozite,: Compare the oil sample results (water, viscosity, wear metals) with the trend; do not decide on an oil change from a single measurement.
Separatörün gerçekten yağ çektiğini ve b: Verify by local observation that the separator is really taking oil and that the discharge cycle is working.
Düşük yağ basıncı, yağda ciddi su veya k: In the event of low oil pressure, serious water in the oil or a crankcase temperature/mist alarm, do not bypass the protection; stop the engine safely.
Karter kapağını soğuma süresi beklemeden: Do not open the crankcase door without waiting for the cooling time; hot oil vapour carries a risk of explosion.
Mimik panodaki valf göstergesi gerçek ha: A valve indication on the mimic panel does not prove the actual line arrangement; separating the ballast and bilge lines is essential both for flooding safety and for pollution.
Pompa emiş/basma basıncı, tank seviye de: Monitor the pump suction/discharge pressure, the change in tank level, the effect on draft/trim and the eductor driving pressure together.
Sintine kuyusu seviyelerini ve yüksek se: Verify on rounds the bilge well levels and that the high-level alarms are in working order.
Kritik valfleri yerel olarak fiziksel do: Verify the critical valves physically on site; compare the change in level with the expected flow rate.
Kayıt defteri girişlerini gerçek soundin: Cross-check the record book entries with the actual soundings and operation times.
Beklenmeyen tank seviye değişimi, sintin: In the event of an unexpected change in tank level, a bilge level that does not fall or a suspicion of flooding, stop the operation and escalate to the Chief Engineer/Master.
Onaylı ayırıcı devre dışı veya koşullar: Do not discharge bilge water overboard while the approved separator is out of service or the conditions are not met; move to the holding and shore facility plan.
Sistem basıncının normal görünmesi yağ t: A normal-looking system pressure does not prove oil cleanliness, accumulator pre-charge or tightness; most failures are caused by contamination and moisture.
Sistem basıncı, motor akımı, yağ sıcaklı: Monitor the system pressure, motor current, oil temperature, filter differential pressure, tank level and signs of leakage.
Pompanın devreye girme sıklığını ve tüke: Trend the pump cut-in frequency and the speed of movement of consumers for internal leakage/loss of pre-charge.
Akümülatör ön şarjını yalnız sistem tara: Measure the accumulator pre-charge only after the system side has been drained; do not interpret frequent cutting-in without measuring.
Yağ numunesi partikül ve su sonuçlarını: Compare the particle and water results of the oil sample with the manufacturer's target cleanliness class.
Sürekli açan emniyet valfi, hızlı ısınma: In the event of a relief valve lifting continuously, rapid heating, a serious leak or loss of control, stop the unit and bring the consumer to a safe position.
Basınçlı hatta çalışmaya başlamadan bası: Before starting work on a pressurised line, release the pressure and drain the accumulator side; apply lock-out/tag-out.
Sludge tankının dolu olmaması uyumun kan: A sludge tank that is not full is not evidence of compliance; the consistency between production, disposal and tank level is assessed together with the records.
Transfer sırasında tank seviyeleri, pomp: During transfer, monitor the tank levels, pump pressure, heating temperature and overflow tank under continuous supervision.
Sludge üretim hızını yakıt kalitesi ve s: Trend the sludge production rate weekly together with the fuel quality and separator performance.
Seviye değişimini beklenen debiyle ve so: Cross-check the change in level with the expected flow rate and the soundings; check the condensate observation tank for a coil leak.
Kayıt defteri girişlerinin gerçek işlem,: Verify that the record book entries are consistent with the actual operations, quantities and receipts.
Basınç yükselip debi oluşmadığında pompa: If the pressure rises and there is no flow, stop the pump; do not keep pumping against a closed valve.
Taşma, kaçak veya kirlilik şüphesinde op: If an overflow, leak or pollution is suspected, stop the operation, implement the SOPEP and assess the reporting obligation with the Master.
Hidrantta basınç görülmesi tüm ring/main: Pressure at one hydrant does not prove the integrity of the whole ring main or the flow at the most distant nozzle; isolation and the independence of the emergency fire pump are tested.
Suction, discharge pressure, priming, le: Monitor suction, discharge pressure, priming, leakage and the performance at distant hydrants.
Isolating valves, international shore co: Keep the isolating valves, the international shore connection and the emergency pump access/power source ready.
En olumsuz hidrant düzeninde maker/SOLAS: Carry out the maker/SOLAS/SMS test with the most unfavourable hydrant arrangement; do not look only at the pump discharge gauge.
Emergency fire pump'ın ana makine daires: Physically verify that the emergency fire pump has a suction/power/start arrangement independent of a fire in the main engine room.
Dry running, suction loss, burst main ve: In the event of dry running, loss of suction, a burst main or an electrical hazard, use suitable isolation and an alternative pump/section.
Testte yetersiz pressure/flow veya froze: If insufficient pressure/flow or a frozen/seized valve is found in the test, report it immediately as a critical defect.
CO₂ release bir ilk müdahale düğmesi değ: Releasing CO₂ is not a first-response button; it creates an atmosphere that is lethal to people and is not used without evacuation, a headcount, ventilation/fuel shutdown and the Master's authority.
Release cabinet, pilot cylinder, selecto: Periodically check the release cabinet, pilot cylinder, selectors, alarm/time delay, bottle weight/level and the condition of the piping/nozzles.
Gerçek olayda mahal tahliyesi, personel: In a real incident, monitor the evacuation of the space, the headcount, boundary cooling and the re-entry atmosphere through the chain of command.
Protected space selector ve shutdown int: Verify the protected space selectors and shutdown interlocks against the Fire Control Plan/maker's diagram; do not rely on memory for valve positions.
Servis/quantity kontrolünü yetkili yönte: Carry out service/quantity checks by an authorised method; do not test the release line by discharging CO₂.
Personel sayımı tamam değilse veya yanlı: Do not release if the headcount is not complete or the wrong space may have been selected.
Release sonrası kontrolsüz yeniden giriş: After release, do not start uncontrolled re-entry/ventilation; the Master and the trained team decide on the basis of gas measurements.
Foam tipleri/yüzdeleri ve application ra: Foam types/percentages and application rates are not interchangeable; the wrong concentrate, incompatibility with seawater or forceful application can break the blanket.
Concentrate level/type, proportioning pr: Monitor the concentrate level/type, proportioning pressure, solution flow and access to the monitors/branch pipes.
Blanket bütünlüğü, wind, hot surface ve: Reassess the integrity of the blanket, the wind, hot surfaces and drainage/containment throughout the fire.
Foam concentrate certificate/compatibili: Compare the foam concentrate certificate/compatibility and the proportioning test result with the system design.
Yalnız köpük görünümüne bakma; applicati: Do not look only at the appearance of the foam; verify the application rate and coverage of the correct space/area against the plan.
Yanlış concentrate, düşük proportioning,: In the event of the wrong concentrate, low proportioning, electrical/chemical incompatibility or a risk of personnel exposure, rearrange the application.
PFOS veya yasaklı/uygunsuz concentrate ş: If PFOS or a prohibited/unsuitable concentrate is suspected, stop using the stock and escalate to the company/flag procedure.
Sprinkler ve high/low-pressure water mis: Sprinklers and high/low-pressure water mist are not the same system; nozzles, section valves, the pump/gas unit and the release logic vary with the maker's design.
Tank/pressure source, pump auto-start, s: Monitor the tank/pressure source, pump auto-start, section valves, detector/release panel and any nozzle obstruction.
Activation sonrası affected section, wat: After activation, manage the affected section, water demand, drainage/free surface and the risk of re-ignition through the chain of command.
Remote indication ve local valve positio: Compare the remote indication with the local valve position; verify the alarm/pump response through the test valve with the maker's procedure.
Nozzle cap/obstruction ve approved spaci: Check nozzle caps/obstructions and the approved spacing with the survey/PMS; do not discharge water at random.
Yanlış section release, piping rupture v: In the event of the wrong section being released, a piping rupture or an electrical hazard, set up isolation/alternative extinguishing according to the Fire Control Plan.
System impaired ise compensating measure: If the system is impaired, do not operate as if normal protection were in place until compensating measures and flag/class/company notification have been completed.
IGS patlamayı imkânsız kılmaz; O₂, basın: The IGS does not make an explosion impossible; O₂, pressure, the integrity of the deck seal/non-return devices, venting and cargo operation limits are maintained together.
O₂, deck main pressure/temp, scrubber le: Monitor the O₂, deck main pressure/temperature, scrubber level/flow, blower and seal water together with the cargo rate.
Tank pressure/vacuum, P/V breaker ve bra: Manage the tank pressure/vacuum, P/V breaker and branch isolations according to the loading/discharge/tank cleaning phase.
Fixed O₂ analyzer'ı portable calibrated: Cross-check the fixed O₂ analyser with a calibrated portable meter and the sampling point.
Deck seal/non-return ve alarm trips'i ma: Verify the deck seal/non-return devices and alarm trips with the maker/approved manual tests; do not rely only on the panel lamp.
O₂ veya pressure approved limit dışına ç: If the O₂ or pressure goes outside the approved limits, stop/reduce the cargo operation concerned according to the manual and call the Master/Cargo Officer.
Deck seal failure, gas backflow veya scr: In the event of a deck seal failure, gas backflow or a serious scrubber/blower failure, make the cargo line-up safe.
Normal panel tek tek detector temizliği/: A normal panel does not prove the cleanliness/accessibility of each detector or that no zone has been disabled; isolations and faults are managed as an active fire risk.
Panel power, loop/zone fault, disable/is: Monitor the panel power, loop/zone faults, the disable/isolate list and the alarm history throughout the watch.
Hot work, steam/dust ve ventilation deği: Manage the risk of false alarms/temporary isolation from hot work, steam/dust and ventilation changes through the permit system.
Seçilmiş detector/call point testini app: Test the selected detector/call point with the approved test medium and verify the correct address/zone on the panel.
Fire patrol ve mahal turunu disabled det: Record fire patrols and rounds of the spaces as compensating measures for disabled detectors; do not act as if automatic detection were in place.
Unknown isolation, repeated fault veya a: In the event of an unknown isolation, repeated faults or an alarm that does not match the space, do not just reset the panel and move on; carry out a physical investigation.
Gerçek alarm şüphesinde ventilation/fire: If a real alarm is suspected, start the ventilation/fire door and muster response according to the SMS.
Renk/etiket ve basınç göstergesi tek baş: The colour/label and the pressure gauge alone are not evidence of suitability; the agent, fire class, capacity, access, servicing and escape route are assessed together.
Doğru konum, erişim, pin/seal, corrosion: Check the correct location, access, pin/seal, corrosion/damage, pressure or weight and the service date.
Müdahalede ajan uyumu, wind, electrical: During the response, continuously assess the suitability of the agent, the wind, electrical isolation, re-ignition and the escape route.
Fire Control Plan inventory ile gerçek a: Compare the actual number/type/location with the Fire Control Plan inventory.
CO₂ ve cartridge/pressure tiplerinde mak: For CO₂ and cartridge/stored-pressure types, apply the maker's/service measurement method; do not assume it is fully charged because the gauge is green.
Yangın büyümüş, duman kaçışı kesmiş veya: If the fire has grown, smoke has cut off the escape or the agent is unsuitable, abandon personal action and move to the alarm/muster and fixed system.
Kullanılmış/kısmen boşalmış söndürücüyü: Do not put a used/partly discharged extinguisher back in place; mark it, replace it and open a record.
EEBD yangınla mücadele veya kapalı mahal: An EEBD is not a device for fire-fighting or enclosed-space entry; the SCBA duration is limited not by the nominal cylinder duration but by the user's effort and reserve/discipline.
Cylinder pressure/weight, mask/hood, str: Check the cylinder pressure/weight, mask/hood, straps, seal, whistle/low-air alarm and expiry/service status.
SCBA kullanımında entry control, tally,: When SCBA is used, monitor entry control, tallies, communications, team back-up and the turn-around pressure.
Donning, face-seal ve low-pressure alarm: Verify donning, the face seal and the low-pressure alarm with a training set/procedure; do not discharge the emergency set unnecessarily.
Fire Control Plan/muster inventory ile l: Compare the location/number and the spare cylinder/compressor status with the Fire Control Plan/muster inventory.
Mask seal yok, pressure yetersiz, alarm/: Do not enter if there is no mask seal, the pressure is insufficient, the alarm/communications are faulty or there is no back-up team.
EEBD ile yangına yaklaşma veya yeniden g: Do not approach a fire or re-enter with an EEBD; the device is only for reaching a clear escape route.
Tüm remote shutdown'ları aynı anda rastg: Pulling all the remote shutdowns at random at the same time is not safe; selecting the wrong system can affect propulsion, steering, emergency power or personnel safety.
Mühür, erişim, label, actuator energy ve: Check the seals, access, labels, actuator energy and remote/local position indication.
Gerçek olayda kapanmanın yangın sınırı,: In a real incident, manage the fire boundary, the propulsion/electrical consequences and the restart risk of a shut-off through the chain of command.
Testte komutun doğru valve/fan/pump üzer: In a test, verify by local observation that the command produces real movement of the correct valve/fan/pump; do not accept the panel light alone.
Fire Control Plan ve P&ID üzerindeki rem: Compare the remote stop/quick-closing mapping on the Fire Control Plan and P&ID with the physical labels.
Yanlış/kimliği belirsiz release veya stu: If there is a wrong/unidentified release or a stuck actuator, mark the system as a critical defect and put compensating measures in place.
Yangın mahali emniyetli ilan edilmeden r: Do not reset/reopen until the fire space has been declared safe; the Master/Chief Engineer brings it back into service under control.
Pompa discharge pressure tek başına güve: Pump discharge pressure alone does not mean a safe flow; tank venting, valve line-up, shore back pressure, NPSH, cargo properties and ESD are monitored together.
Tank level/rate, suction-discharge, pump: Monitor the tank level/rate, suction–discharge, pump current/speed, bearings/seals, manifold pressure and venting together.
Stripping aşamasında vapour/gas entrainm: In the stripping stage, manage vapour/gas entrainment, cavitation and the tank bottom condition according to the pump limits.
İki kişiyle valve line-up/tank identity: Verify the valve line-up/tank identity and manifold connection physically with two people according to the ship–shore checklist.
Transfer rate'i tank level/ullage change: Cross-check the transfer rate with the tank level/ullage change and the shore figure; do not rely on a single flowmeter.
Unexpected level/pressure, ESD/communica: In the event of an unexpected level/pressure, ESD/communication loss, a seal leak or a venting failure, stop the transfer using the agreed emergency sequence.
Yanlış tank/line contamination şüphesind: If contamination from the wrong tank/line is suspected, stop the flow without moving valves and go back to the sample/plan and the Cargo Officer's decision.
COW rutin suyla yıkama değildir; approve: COW is not routine washing with water; it is not carried out without the approved COW manual, inert condition, washing programme, oxygen/pressure control and stripping performance.
IG deck pressure/O₂, COW line pressure/t: Monitor the IG deck pressure/O₂, COW line pressure/temperature, machine cycle, tank atmosphere and stripping suction throughout the programme.
Static electricity, leakage, wash sequen: Manage static electricity, leakage, the washing sequence and the slop/tank level within the limits of the approved manual.
Machine movement/pressure ve stripping p: Verify the machine movement/pressure and stripping performance with the designated indicators/soundings.
COW planı ile gerçek tank/machine/line-u: Cross-check the COW plan with the actual tank/machine/line-up and the ORB entry.
IG pressure/O₂ limiti ihlali, COW line l: In the event of a breach of the IG pressure/O₂ limit, a COW line leak, a machine failure or loss of stripping, stop washing according to the manual.
Manual dışı tank/program veya uygun olma: Do not carry out COW on a tank/programme outside the manual or with an unsuitable crude; escalate to the Master/Cargo Officer.
Continuous radar gauge ile independent h: A continuous radar gauge and an independent high-level/overfill alarm are not the same function; common power/sensor failures and the effect of cargo foam/vapour are kept separate.
Level trend, rate, alarm health, vapour/: Monitor the level trend, rate, alarm health, effect of vapour/foam, sensor discrepancies and tank pressure.
Loading limit ve alarm setpoint'lerini t: Assess the loading limits and alarm set points together with the tank table, trim/list and thermal expansion.
Uygun kapalı manual gauging veya bağımsı: Cross-check the selected tank reading with suitable closed manual gauging or an independent sensor.
High/high-high alarm functional testini: Carry out the high/high-high alarm functional test with the approved procedure; do not mistake a process gauge simulation for a real test of the independent alarm.
Unknown/frozen level, alarm fault veya r: If the level is unknown/frozen, there is an alarm fault or the rate and level do not match, reduce/stop the loading rate and measure the tank independently.
Overfill alarmını susturup operasyona de: Do not silence the overfill alarm and carry on; apply the ship–shore ESD plan.
Görsel kapalı görünüm veya tebeşir izi t: Looking closed or a chalk test alone is not weathertight performance; structural condition, drainage, compression and testing are needed together.
Panel/track alignment, seal compression,: Monitor the panel/track alignment, seal compression, cross joints, cleats and the condition of the drain non-return valves.
Heavy weather ve cargo operation sonrası: After heavy weather and cargo operations, check for coaming/panel deformation and evidence of leakage.
Pre-loading/closing walkdown ve suitable: Verify the whole cover perimeter with a pre-loading/closing walkdown and a suitable leak test.
Repair sonrası local patch'i değil globa: After a repair, test the overall compression/drainage continuity, not just the local patch.
Panel hareket alanı açık değilse veya lo: Do not move the panels if their path is not clear or the locks/interlocks are not working.
Known leakage/deformation ile sea passag: With known leakage/deformation, escalate the decision on the sea passage to the Cargo Officer/Master/class assessment.
Lashing sayısı tek başına yeterlilik değ: The number of lashings alone does not determine adequacy; the calculation of cargo weight/CG, stowage position, accelerations, angles, MSL/CS and equipment condition does.
Correct gear/type, thread engagement, te: Monitor the correct gear/type, thread engagement, tension, lashing angle, stack geometry and any loose/damaged units.
Heavy weather, ice, vibration ve cargo s: Recheck the condition of the lashings after heavy weather, icing, vibration and settling of the cargo.
Actual stow/weight ile approved CSM/comp: Compare the actual stowage/weights with the approved CSM/computer input at bay–row–tier level.
Gear marking/certificate ve visual condi: Verify the gear markings/certificates and visual condition; do not use equipment that is illegible or deformed.
CSM dışı stow, unknown weight/CG, missin: Do not approve departure/the operation without correction if there is stowage outside the CSM, unknown weight/CG, missing/broken fittings or unsafe access.
Denizde lashing müdahalesi için risk ass: Do not send the team to work on lashings at sea without a risk assessment, weather/deck access assessment and fall protection.
Socket enerjili ve display normal olması: An energised socket and a normal display do not prove the pulp temperature of the cargo; the container unit, airflow, set point and cargo instructions are assessed together.
Set/supply/return temp, current, phase/a: Monitor the set/supply/return temperatures, current, phase/alarms, defrost and ventilation setting against the cargo instructions.
Plug/lead condition, water ingress, secu: Check the plug/lead condition, water ingress, securing and safe access on every round.
Container ID ve setpoint'i manifest/reef: Cross-check the container ID and set point with the manifest/reefer list, and remote monitoring with the local display.
Electrical isolation/dead test'i bağlant: Before disconnecting, verify electrical isolation/dead test with a suitable tester and permit.
Damaged/wet plug, earth fault, overheati: In the event of a damaged/wet plug, an earth fault, overheating or unsafe access, isolate the power and inform the ETO/Cargo Officer.
Temperature excursion'da setpoint'i izin: In a temperature excursion, do not change the set point without authorisation; record the time of the alarm, the local condition and the cargo instructions.
Closed lamp tek başına emniyet değildir;: A 'closed' lamp alone is not safety; physical locking, cleats, isolation of hydraulic pressure and the bridge indication are verified separately.
Movement zone, hinge/wire/cylinder load,: Monitor the movement zone, hinge/wire/cylinder loads, hydraulic leaks, the vehicle interface and wind/ship motion.
Closing'de seal/compression, lock sequen: When closing, check the seal/compression, lock sequence and local/bridge indication step by step.
Sorumlu kişi tüm locks/cleats'i fiziksel: The person in charge physically checks all locks/cleats and compares them with the bridge indicator.
Departure checklist ve shell-door alarm: Carry out the departure checklist and the shell door alarm test according to the SMS; do not treat CCTV as the only evidence.
Person/vehicle movement zone'da, interlo: Stop the movement if there are persons/vehicles in the movement zone, an interlock is bypassed, the movement is asymmetrical or there is a wire/hydraulic abnormality.
Lock/seal/indicator uyuşmazlığında deniz: If the locks/seals/indicators do not agree, escalate the decision to proceed to sea to the Master/class procedure.
Crane SWL, derrick union purchase SWL ve: Crane SWL, derrick union purchase SWL or loose gear MSL values are not directly convertible into one another; the rig configuration and resultant loads are calculated.
Rig geometry, preventer/guy tension, wir: Monitor the rig geometry, preventer/guy tension, wire leads, brakes/limits, load swing and weather.
Single agreed signaller, radio fallback: Keep a single agreed signaller, a radio fallback and the exclusion zone throughout the operation.
Cargo weight/CG, lift points ve tüm gear: Compare the cargo weight/CG, lift points and all gear certificates/SWL with the lift plan.
Yüksüz ve uygun test yükü altında brake/: Verify the brake/limit/function check at no load and under a suitable test load with the approved procedure.
Unknown weight, side pull, gear damage,: Stop lifting if the weight is unknown, there is a side pull, gear damage, loss of communication or a person under the load.
Any overload/structural contact sonrası: After any overload/structural contact, do not use it again without an examination by a competent person.
Tank cleaning kimyasal püskürtme değildi: Tank cleaning is not spraying chemicals; the atmosphere, static electricity, toxicity, tank coating, heating, slop capacity and discharge law are managed together.
Tank atmosphere, wash pressure/temp, mac: Monitor the tank atmosphere, wash pressure/temperature, machine cycle, slop level, stripping suction and deck leaks.
Simultaneous operations, venting/IG, che: Manage simultaneous operations, venting/IG, chemical exposure and enclosed-space boundaries with the permit/SMS.
Cleaning plan ile actual tank/line/machi: Cross-check the cleaning plan with the actual tank/line/machine programme and the slop capacity.
Eductor motive pressure-vacuum ve stripp: Verify the eductor motive pressure/vacuum and the stripping result with soundings/ullages.
Atmosphere limit dışı, IG/vent failure,: Stop cleaning if the atmosphere is outside the limits, or in the event of IG/vent failure, a leak, a jammed machine or a risk to slop capacity.
Tank entry için ayrı enclosed-space entr: Do not enter the tank until a separate enclosed-space entry permit, gas-freeing and LOTO have been completed.
Type approval her su kalitesi/flow koşul: Type approval does not guarantee compliance in every water quality/flow condition; the system design limitations, TRO/UV dose, holding time and contingency measures are applied.
Flow, filter differential pressure/backw: Compare the flow, filter differential pressure/backwash, UV intensity/UVT or TRO, temperature/salinity and treatment alarms with the SDL.
Bypass, sensor invalid, hold time ve neu: Manage bypass, invalid sensors, holding time and the neutralisation/discharge limits with the voyage plan.
Valve line-up ve treatment status'u actu: Cross-check the valve line-up and treatment status with the actual ballast tank/flow, and sensor readings with calibration/samples.
BWRB entry, BWMP contingency action ve a: Verify that the BWRB entry, the BWMP contingency action and the alarm export describe the same operation.
Treatment critical alarm, unapproved byp: Do not discharge as if compliant in the event of a critical treatment alarm, an unapproved bypass, an invalid sensor or conditions outside the SDL.
Contingency measure'i Kaptan/şirket/port: Determine and record the contingency measures through the Master/company/port authority process.
ppm ekranı veya clean-water test sonucu: A ppm display or a clean-water test result does not prove that the actual bilge flow is compliant; approved piping, alarm/stop, the position requirement and the ORB mass balance are required.
Feed homogenization, pressure drop, emul: Monitor feed homogenisation, pressure drop, emulsion, sample flow, the ppm trend and the automatic stop.
Tank sounding, processed quantity ve dis: Check that the tank sounding, processed quantity and discharge duration/rate are mathematically consistent.
Actual pipe/valve route'u approved drawi: Physically compare the actual pipe/valve route with the approved drawing.
Alarm/automatic stop testini approved pr: Verify the alarm/automatic stop test with the approved procedure and a valid calibration.
Sample/alarm/stop arızası, ppm limit aşı: If there is a sample/alarm/stop failure, the ppm limit is exceeded or the legal discharge conditions are not met, keep the overboard valve firmly closed.
Bypass/seyreltme yapma; reception facili: Do not bypass or dilute; set up a reception facility/holding plan and report the defect.
Genel '3/12 mil' ezberi tek başına karar: The general '3/12 miles' rule of thumb is not a decision tree on its own; the approved plant, comminution/disinfection, en route, rate, special area and coastal rules are read together.
Plant/blower/level/disinfection, effluen: Monitor the plant/blower/level/disinfection, effluent quality and holding capacity throughout the voyage.
Discharge position/speed/rate ve local/s: Verify the discharge position/speed/rate and local/special-area restrictions against the plan.
Valve line-up ve actual tank/effluent co: Compare the valve line-up and the actual tank/effluent condition with the panel.
Sample/test ve certificate/approved manu: Cross-check sample/test results against the certificate/approved manual limits.
Plant failure, poor effluent, overflow r: If there is a plant failure, poor effluent, a risk of overflow or the legal conditions are not met, close the overboard valve.
Tank/plant girişini enclosed-space/biolo: Do not enter the tank/plant without enclosed-space/biological hazard checks.
Sludge/garbage availability yakma izni d: The availability of sludge/garbage is not permission to incinerate; prohibited materials, port/local restrictions, the chamber condition and the operating manual are decisive.
Chamber temp/draft, flame, feed, flue ve: Monitor the chamber temperature/draught, flame, feed, flue and refractory condition.
Waste category/mass balance ve ash dispo: Manage the waste category/mass balance and the ash disposal route with the records.
Feed category'yi Garbage/Sludge record v: Verify the feed category against the Garbage/Sludge record and the MSDS.
Interlock/sensor testini PMS ve service: Cross-check the interlock/sensor test with the PMS and the service report.
Low temp/flame failure/smoke leak/refrac: Stop the feed on low temperature, flame failure, smoke leak or refractory damage.
Unknown/prohibited waste veya port ban v: Do not incinerate unknown/prohibited waste or where a port ban applies.
Set temperature indoor air quality değil: The set temperature is not indoor air quality; outside air, filters, damper/fire closure, humidity, condensate and space pressure are assessed together.
Supply/return temp, humidity, filter ΔP,: Monitor the supply/return temperature, humidity, filter ΔP, fan current, condensate and damper position.
Galley/hospital/battery/paint store gibi: Maintain the pressure and exhaust separation of special spaces such as the galley, hospital, battery room and paint store.
BMS value'yu calibrated room/duct measur: Cross-check the BMS value with a calibrated room/duct measurement and the airflow.
Fire damper/remote stop ve smoke-control: Verify the fire damper/remote stop and smoke-control functions with the Fire Control Plan/PMS.
Smoke/fire spread, refrigerant leak veya: On smoke/fire spread, refrigerant leak or contamination, isolate the affected zone in a planned way.
Confined duct/fan bakımına LOTO ve hygie: Do not enter a confined duct or carry out fan maintenance without LOTO and a hygiene check/permit.
Basınç normal olsa da potable water kali: Even if the pressure is normal, potable water quality, air charge, pump cycling, backflow and tank hygiene are checked separately.
Cut-in/out pressure, pump starts, tank l: Monitor the cut-in/cut-out pressure, pump starts, tank level/air cushion, leaks and the relief valve.
Chlorine/residual veya ship water plan p: Manage chlorine/residual or ship water plan parameters, tank cleanliness and the shore bunkering risk.
Pressure gauge/switch'i calibrated gauge: Cross-check the pressure gauge/switch with a calibrated gauge, and pump cycling with the actual demand/a leak test.
Potable quality'yi uygun sample/test ile: Verify potable quality with a suitable sample/test; appearance/taste is not the only evidence.
Contamination/backflow, tank bladder/air: On contamination/backflow, tank bladder/air loss or rapid cycling, isolate the affected supply and rectify.
Basınçlı tankı depressurize/LOTO olmadan: Do not open a pressurised tank without depressurising it and LOTO.
Room air temperature ürün çekirdek sıcak: Room air temperature alone does not show the product core temperature and quality; airflow, door openings, defrost and alarm duration are monitored.
Room/product temp, pressure, superheat,: Monitor the room/product temperature, pressure, superheat, defrost, fans and the door seal.
Alarm duration ve food segregation/conti: Manage the alarm duration and food segregation/contingency with the catering officer.
Remote sensor'u calibrated independent t: Compare the remote sensor with a calibrated independent thermometer.
Stand-by unit/alarm ve refrigerant leak: Test the stand-by unit/alarm and refrigerant leak detection.
