Severe refrigerant leak/high pressure/lo: Do not bypass the unit's protection on a severe refrigerant leak, high pressure or low oil.
Temperature excursion'da ürünü otomatik: After a temperature excursion, do not automatically treat the product as acceptable; carry out a food-safety assessment and record it.
Devreler arası cross-connection yanlış b: A cross-connection between circuits can spread incorrect pressure or contamination; the requirements for starting air, control air and working air are not the same.
Receiver pressures, dew point/oil-water: Monitor the receiver pressures, dew point/oil-water drains, compressor cycling and the non-return/relief valve condition.
Control-air quality ve starting-air rese: Assess the control-air quality and the starting-air reserve together with the manoeuvring demand.
Local gauges/receiver drains ve automati: Cross-check the local gauges/receiver drains and the automatic start-stop with the control system.
Isolation/cross-connection lineup'ını P&: Physically verify the isolation/cross-connection line-up with the P&ID and tags.
Oil carry-over/high temp/relief lift vey: On oil carry-over, high temperature, relief valve lifting or control-air contamination, isolate the affected source.
Starting-air manifold üzerinde turning g: Do not work on the starting-air manifold without the turning gear engaged/engine isolated and the system depressurised.
Steam valve open/pressure varlığı doğru: An open steam valve or the presence of pressure does not prove correct condensate drainage or trap operation; the water hammer and hot-surface risks are monitored.
Header/branch pressure, drain/trap, retu: Monitor the header/branch pressure, drains/traps, return temperature, hotwell level and the make-up trend.
Warm-through sırasında expansion, water: During warming through, manage the expansion, water hammer and condensate pocket risks by operating the valves slowly.
Trap function'ı temperature/ultrasonic m: Cross-check trap function with a temperature/ultrasonic method and the condensate return.
Valve lineup ve pressure-reducing/safety: Verify the valve line-up and the pressure-reducing/safety devices according to the P&ID/maker's test.
Water hammer, major leak, failed trap ca: On water hammer, a major leak, a failed trap causing flooding or overpressure, safely isolate the branch.
Hot/pressurized line'ı cool-drain-vent-L: Do not open a hot/pressurised line until cool-down, draining, venting and LOTO are complete.
GMDSS tek bir cihaz veya yalnız Inmarsat: GMDSS is not a single device or Inmarsat alone; how the functions are provided depends on the ship's sea area, the approved services/equipment and the duplication/shore-based maintenance arrangement.
Sea area, watch receivers, position/time: Monitor the sea area, watch receivers, position/time feed, printer/storage, antenna, reserve source of energy and the charger alarm.
NAVTEX/SafetyNET MSI coverage ve message: Match the NAVTEX/SafetyNET MSI coverage and message filtering to the voyage route.
Approved self-test/test call'ları radyo: Carry out approved self-tests/test calls according to the radio log procedure; do not accidentally send a distress alert to the live network.
Battery autonomy/capacity ve duplicated: Verify the battery autonomy/capacity and the duplicated equipment arrangement with the certificate/diagram.
Distress false alert'te approved cancell: On a false distress alert, immediately apply the approved cancellation procedure and establish the record trail with the RCC/coast station.
Watch/alerting fonksiyonu kaybında Maste: On loss of the watch/alerting function, inform the Master and set up the defect report/shore assistance and a compensating watch plan.
DSC distress alert ayrıntılı voice distr: A DSC distress alert does not replace detailed voice distress traffic; a wrong MMSI/position/time or an antenna fault corrupts the SAR data.
Ch 70 watch, GNSS age, MMSI, power sourc: Monitor the Ch 70 watch, GNSS position age, MMSI, power source, squelch/volume and antenna/VSWR faults.
Distress category/nature ve follow-up wo: Manage the distress category/nature of distress and the follow-up working channel with the incident procedure.
Internal/self-test ve izinli test call'ı: Verify the DSC path with the internal self-test and a permitted test call, and the audio path separately with a routine voice radio check.
Handset/channel/power selection'ı actual: Check the handset/channel/power selection against the actual display; do not mistake dual watch for the Ch 70 DSC watch.
False alert'te cihazı kapatıp susma; DSC: On a false alert, do not switch the set off and stay silent; apply the DSC cancellation and Ch 16 voice cancellation procedure.
Position/MMSI yanlışsa distress tuşunu k: If the position/MMSI is wrong, plan a manual correction/voice supplement rather than pressing the distress button unconditionally.
MF/HF menzili sabit değildir; frequency,: MF/HF range is not fixed; frequency, time, the ionosphere, the antenna/tuning and propagation determine it; it is not operated as a simple alternative to satellite.
Sea area/frequency watch, tuning result,: Monitor the sea area/frequency watch, tuning result, power, antenna earth, propagation and the selected mode.
Distress acknowledgement/relay ve workin: Manage distress acknowledgement/relay and working frequency changes with the GOC procedure.
Approved coast-station test call veya se: Verify the DSC path with an approved coast-station test call or self-test, and separately verify voice and the other installed functions listed in the Radio Record.
Position/time ve MMSI'yi alert ekranında: Compare the position/time and MMSI on the alert screen with the actual source.
Tuning/antenna fault veya repeated faile: On a tuning/antenna fault or repeated failed calls, do not blindly repeat the same action; change to a suitable band/service and the Master's plan.
False distress'te band/mode'a uygun canc: On a false distress alert, carry out the cancellation appropriate to the band/mode and the log entry/authority notification.
Terminal login/registered görünümü mesaj: A terminal showing logged-in/registered does not by itself prove that a message was delivered or that the correct ocean region/service is selected; delivery status and the EGC configuration are monitored.
Logged-in status, position/time, EGC are: Monitor the logged-in status, position/time, EGC areas, printer/storage, antenna and distress button protection.
Message priority, address ve delivery co: Check the message priority, address and delivery confirmation according to the operation.
Approved link/performance test ile termi: Verify the terminal path with an approved link/performance test, and the filtering by the route relevance of received EGC messages.
Distress position/identity display'ini G: Compare the distress position/identity display with the GNSS and the ship's certificate.
Failed delivery/login veya wrong identit: On failed delivery/login or a wrong identity/position, do not rely on a single channel; use alternative GMDSS means and notify the Master.
False distress'te recognized service can: On a false distress alert, apply the recognised service's cancellation procedure and notify the RCC.
EPIRB test mode dışında aktive edilmez;: An EPIRB is not activated except in test mode; the hydrostatic release frees it automatically, but incorrect mounting, lanyard arrangement or an obstruction prevents float-free operation.
Bracket erişimi, housing, lanyard'ın doğ: Check bracket access, the housing, correct stowage of the lanyard, HRU and battery expiry, the registration label and the GNSS self-test result.
Gerçek aktivasyonda beacon'ı açık gökyüz: On real activation, keep the beacon upright with a clear view of the sky and, if possible, tethered to the survival craft.
Maker self-test/GNSS testini izinli aral: Carry out the maker's self-test/GNSS test within the permitted interval; do not make an RF transmission test that looks like a real distress.
HEX ID/MMSI registration'ı certificate/d: Compare the HEX ID/MMSI registration with the certificate/database record; update it on a change of ship/flag.
Accidental activation'da beacon'ı kapatm: On accidental activation, do not just switch the beacon off; send a false alert cancellation to the RCC/coast station and log it.
Expired/damaged/failed self-test EPIRB'i: Do not treat an expired/damaged EPIRB or one that failed its self-test as serviceable; arrange an approved replacement/shore service.
Radar SART S-band radarda görünmez; ekra: A radar SART is not seen on S-band radar; the 12 response dots on the display can turn into arcs/rings with range/receiver saturation, and the antenna height determines the range.
Activation indication, mounting height/o: Monitor the activation indication, mounting height/orientation and accessibility in the survival craft.
Radar SART aramada X-band radar range/ga: During a radar SART search, manage the X-band radar range/gain/sea clutter settings so that they do not suppress the target response.
Maker self-test'i vessel radarına yanlış: Carry out the maker's self-test in the approved mode without creating a false target on the ship's radar.
Inventory, battery expiry ve correct typ: Compare the inventory, battery expiry and correct type with the muster/LSA plan.
Distress dışında operational mode'a alma: Do not switch to operational mode except in distress; if a false response occurs, inform the bridge team.
Failed self-test/expired battery cihazı: Do not treat a device with a failed self-test/expired battery as serviceable or put it back in the craft.
BNWAS gözcü veya vardiya zabiti yerine g: BNWAS does not replace the lookout or the officer of the watch; continuous/automatic pressing of the reset defeats the purpose of the system, and the authority to select the mode rests with the Master.
Operating mode, timer, reset locations,: At the start of the watch, check the operating mode, timer, reset locations, stage alarms and the back-up officer routing.
Reset'in gerçek bridge activity'yi temsi: Verify that the reset reflects real bridge activity and that the alarm can be heard above the ambient noise.
Stage sequence ve cabin routing testini: Verify the stage sequence and the cabin routing test through to the actual recipients with the SMS/maker procedure.
Mode access/keys ve power-failure alarmı: Compare mode access/keys and the power-failure alarm with the bridge equipment checklist.

Hava girişi, foot valve arızası, filtre: Air ingress, foot valve fault, filter blocked
Hava sızıntısını kapat, foot valve/filtr: Stop the air leak; check the foot valve/filter.
Impeller aşıntısı, ring clearance büyük,: Impeller wear, excessive ring clearance, cavitation
Impeller değiştir, suction koşullarını i: Replace the impeller; improve the suction conditions.
Alignment kontrolü, yatak değişimi, NPSH: Check the alignment, replace the bearings, check the NPSH.
Salmastrayı değiştir, soğutma akışını sa: Replace the seal; ensure the cooling flow.
Fire/emergency pump testini PMS/SMS sıkl: Test the fire/emergency fire pump at the PMS/SMS frequency, verifying priming, pressure, flow at a selected hydrant and the independent suction/power source.
Tank içine kuru pompa salmamak için sevi: Monitor the level so that the pump does not run dry on an empty tank.
Pompa motoru elektriksel izolasyon ve LO: The pump motor must be taken for maintenance with electrical isolation and LOTO.
Yağlı/zehirli sıvı pompalarında salmastr: Seal leakage on pumps handling oily/toxic liquids must be recorded.
Vakum evaporatörü, deniz suyunu düşük ba: A vacuum evaporator evaporates seawater at ~50 °C under low pressure.
Buhar yoğuşturucuda (condenser) deniz su: The vapour is cooled by seawater in the condenser and turns into fresh water.
Salinometer, üretilen suyun tuzluluğunu: The salinometer monitors the salinity of the water produced; above the threshold the dump valve operates.
Reverse osmosis (RO) sistemleri, yarı ge: Reverse osmosis (RO) systems produce pure water under high pressure through a semi-permeable membrane.
Vakum pompasını çalıştır, vakum -90 kPa: Start the vacuum pump and bring the vacuum to about −90 kPa.
Jacket water'ı buharlaştırıcıya yönlendi: Direct the jacket water to the evaporator.
Üretilen suyu ilk dakikalarda dump'a al,: Dump the water produced in the first minutes; direct it to the tank once the quality has stabilised.
Vakum pompasını kontrol et, evaporatörü: Check the vacuum pump; clean the evaporator with acid.
Demister kontrol, sensör kalibre, dump d: Check the demister, calibrate the sensor, dump the output.
Clean the membrane; replace it if necessary.
Liman, nehir ağzı veya kirlenme şüphesin: In port, in a river mouth or when pollution is suspected, isolate the FWG/RO as required by the Water Safety Plan/SMS; re-verify the quality of the tank and product water.
Üretilen su içme amaçlı kullanılacaksa U: If the water produced is to be used for drinking, it must be treated by UV/silver/chlorination.
Periyodik mikrobiyolojik analiz yapılmal: Periodic microbiological analysis must be carried out.
Asit temizliğinde uygun PPE (yüz maskesi: Suitable PPE (face shield, gloves) must be used for acid cleaning.
Burner, chamber'i type-approved feed-ena: The burner brings the chamber to the type-approved feed-enable temperature; sludge/garbage is not fed until the control system permits it.
Sludge dosing pompası ısıtılmış sludge'ı: The sludge dosing pump atomises the heated sludge and sprays it into the combustion chamber.
Hava fanı yanma için yeterli oksijen sağ: The air fan supplies enough oxygen for combustion; the ratio is controlled.
Baca gazı sıcaklık sensörüyle izlenir; d: The flue gas is monitored by a temperature sensor; if it falls, the unit shuts down automatically.
Sludge tankı seviyesini, yakıt tankını v: Check the sludge tank level, the fuel tank and the air fan.
Burner ile maker start sequence'ini tama: Complete the maker's start sequence with the burner; start the sludge/solid feed only at the chamber temperature permitted by the type approval and the interlock.
Chamber/combustion-gas sıcaklığını type-: Keep the chamber/combustion gas temperature within the type-approved operating band; do not accept over-dosing or visible smoke as normal.
Çalışma sonunda dosingi kes, brulor ile: At the end of operation, stop the dosing and cool/purge the chamber with the burner on clean fuel.
Garbage Record Book'a tür, hacim, başlan: Enter the type, volume and start/finish times in the Garbage Record Book.
Yakıt yok, ignition elektrot kirli, foto: No fuel, ignition electrode dirty, photocell faulty
Yakıt valfini aç, elektrotları temizle,: Open the fuel valve, clean the electrodes, check the photocell.
Hava yetersiz, atomizer tıkalı, sludge ç: Insufficient air, atomiser blocked, sludge too viscous
Hava fanı debisi artır, atomizer söküm t: Increase the air fan flow, dismantle and clean the atomiser, check the sludge preheating.
Refrakter hasarı, fazla sludge dosingi,: Refractory damage, too much sludge dosing, low-calorie fuel
Refrakter inspeksiyon, dosing kıs, yakıt: Inspect the refractory, reduce the dosing, do not mix the fuel with dirty sludge.
Replace the switch and seal; test the lock.
Çalışırken charge door kesinlikle açılma: The charging door must never be opened during operation; risk of flashback.
Plastik veya PVC içeren atık dioxin/fura: Waste containing plastic or PVC produces dioxins/furans, which are harmful to health and the environment.
Refrakteri termal şoktan korumak için ma: Complete the maker's controlled cool-down/purge time to protect the refractory from thermal shock; a fixed 4 hours is not valid for all models.
Stack çıkışı çevresinde personel olmamal: No personnel may be near the stack outlet; in cold weather invisible hot gas is a danger.
Sintine pompası yağlı suyu separatöre be: The bilge pump feeds oily water to the separator; in the first chamber free oil rises to the top and is collected in the oil tank.
Su, koalesan filtre elemanından geçer; m: The water passes through the coalescing filter element; micron droplets combine and rise to the surface.
Çıkış suyu OCM'den geçer; numune sürekli: The outlet water passes through the OCM; the sample is measured continuously and the data are logged.
≥15 ppm okumada 3-yollu solenoid valf ot: At a reading of ≥15 ppm, the 3-way solenoid valve automatically diverts the outlet back to the bilge tank and gives an alarm.
Çalıştırmadan önce sealing water hattını: Before starting, open the sealing water line (required on some models).
Pompa başlat, ilk birkaç dakika resirkül: Start the pump; prime the OCM in recirculation mode for the first few minutes.
Deşarj koşulları checklist ile doğruland: After the discharge conditions have been verified with the checklist and the responsible officer has given permission, select overboard in the maker's sequence; monitor the OCM value, sample flow and the function of the automatic stopping device.
ORB Code'a uygun operasyon kodu, start/s: Have the responsible officer record without delay the operation code under the ORB Code, start/stop times, position, quantity and method; apply the Master's check/signature arrangement.
Bitirince hatları temiz su ile flush et,: When finished, flush the lines with clean water and keep the OCM sensor clean.
OCM sensörü kirli, koalesan element doym: OCM sensor dirty, coalescing element saturated
OCM cell temizliği, koalesan element değ: Clean the OCM cell; replace the coalescing element.
Sintine kuyusu boş, hava emiyor: Bilge well empty, pump drawing air
Suction kontrol, hava al, valfleri kontr: Check the suction, vent, check the valves.
Transfer to the sludge tank and record in the ORB.
Üretici prosedürüne göre temiz su ile ze: Carry out zero and span calibration with clean water according to the manufacturer's procedure.
OCM mührü (seal) PSC inspeksiyonunda kon: The OCM seal is checked in PSC inspections; the seal must not be broken.
Bypass hattı veya sahte OCM bağlantısı k: A bypass line or false OCM connection must never be made; it carries heavy fines and prison sentences.
Numune hattı sürekli akışlı olmalı; tıka: The sample line must have a continuous flow; a blockage does not raise an alarm but gives a false low reading.
Slop tankı transferi shore reception fac: When the slop tank contents are delivered to a shore reception facility, the receipt is attached to the ORB.
Aerobik tankta blower hava verir; aktif: In the aerobic tank, a blower supplies air; bacteria in the activated sludge convert organic matter into CO₂ and H₂O.
Settling tankında çamur çöker; dipte bir: Sludge settles in the settling tank; the sludge collected at the bottom is recirculated to the aerobic tank.
Üst sıvı kontak tankında klor (kalsiyum: The clear liquid is disinfected with chlorine (calcium hypochlorite tablets or electrolytic) in the contact tank.
Discharge pompası işlenmiş su tankından: The discharge pump pumps from the treated water tank overboard; a level switch provides automatic control.
Biyolojik proseste blower duty/standby v: In the biological process, maintain the blower duty/standby and operating cycle according to the maker's manual; after a long loss of air, analyse the health of the biomass and carry out a controlled recovery.
Dezenfeksiyon tipine göre dozaj/elektrol: According to the type of disinfection, check the dosing/electrolysis, residual and consumables against the maker's manual and the discharge standard.
Discharge pompasını ancak Annex IV, spec: Start the discharge pump only after the conditions of Annex IV, any special-area/port rules and the ship's Sewage Management Plan have been verified.
Haftalık olarak çamur seviyesini ölç; ge: Measure the sludge level weekly; if necessary, transfer the excess sludge to the sludge tank.
Blower yetersiz, aşırı yükleme, deterjan: Insufficient blower air, overloading, too much detergent
Hava debisini artır, mutfak greywater'ı: Increase the air flow, bypass the galley grey water, add a micro-organism culture.
Klor tabletini doldur, settling'i temizl: Refill the chlorine tablets, clean the settling tank, re-seed the system.
Level switch arızalı, impeller tıkalı (p: Level switch faulty, impeller blocked (napkins, etc.)
Test the switch; dismantle and clean the pump.
Filtre değiştir, kayış gerginlik kontrol: Replace the filter; check the belt tension.
STP girişine wet wipe, peçete, bez atılm: Wet wipes, napkins or rags must not be put into the STP inlet; they block the pumps and nozzles.
Klor/dezenfektan ile çalışırken SDS'de b: When working with chlorine/disinfectant, use the chemical PPE, ventilation and emergency response arrangements specified in the SDS; an unsuitable mixture with acid can release toxic gas.
Sistem 24+ saat durduğunda bakteri kültü: When the system is stopped for 24+ hours, the bacterial culture may die; re-seeding may be needed when restarting.
Holding tank kapasitesi POB, üretim debi: The holding tank capacity is calculated from the POB, the production rate, route/port restrictions and the reception plan; the remaining holding time is monitored at the watch handover with the high-level alarm.
U = 3000 W/m²·K, A = 8 m², ΔTlm = 15 K o: Find the heat transfer capacity of an L.O. cooler with U = 3000 W/m²·K, A = 8 m² and ΔTlm = 15 K.
Sıcak akışkan (yağ, ceket suyu, hava) bi: The hot fluid (oil, jacket water, air) flows on one side and the cooling fluid (seawater or LT fresh water) on the other side in the opposite direction (counter-flow).
İnce ayırıcı yüzey (plaka/boru) üzerinde: Heat passes from hot to cold by conduction through the thin separating surface (plate/tube).
Termostatik/üç-yollu valf çıkış sıcaklığ: The thermostatic/three-way valve adjusts the coolant flow by monitoring the outlet temperature.
Central sistemde SW yalnızca central coo: In a central system, SW cools only the central cooler; the internal circuit runs on clean FW.
Devreye almadan önce hava kilidini gider: Before putting it into service, remove air locks (vent); start the SW and FW pumps.
Giriş/çıkış sıcaklık ve basınç farkını (: Note the inlet/outlet temperatures and the pressure difference (ΔP); an increase in ΔP is a sign of fouling.
Check the set temperature of the thermostatic valve (e.g. jacket water ~80–85 °C).
Deniz suyu strainer'ını düzenli temizle;: Clean the seawater strainer regularly; if the SW flow falls, the outlet temperature rises.
Plakalı cooler'ı periyodik aç, plakaları: Open the plate cooler periodically, clean the plates with chemicals (acid) and check the gaskets.
Plaka/boru kirli (fouling), SW debisi dü: Plates/tubes fouled, low SW flow, air lock
Cooler temizliği, SW strainer temizliği,: Clean the cooler, clean the SW strainer, vent.
Plaka çatlağı, gasket bozuk, boru delinm: Cracked plate, defective gasket, perforated tube
Basınç testi, hasarlı plaka/boru değişim: Pressure test, replace damaged plates/tubes, renew gaskets.
Nitrit seviyesini test et ve dozla, hava: Test the nitrite level and dose; eliminate the air ingress.
Kimyasal temizlikte (asit) uygun PPE kul: Use suitable PPE for chemical (acid) cleaning and rinse thoroughly after neutralisation.
Plakalı cooler'ı sökerken plaka sırasını: When dismantling a plate cooler, mark the order and direction of the plates; a wrong arrangement causes leaks.
Basınçlıyken flanş/cıvata gevşetilmez; ö: Flanges/bolts must not be loosened while under pressure; first isolate and release the pressure.
Deniz suyu tarafı galvanik korozyon için: On the seawater side, the condition of anodes/coatings must be checked against galvanic corrosion.
Kompresör soğutucu gazı sıkıştırır → kon: The compressor compresses the refrigerant gas → the condenser liquefies it with seawater (liquid) → liquid receiver → expansion valve (pressure drops) → evaporator (cools the room air, becomes gas) → compressor.
Termostat oda sıcaklığını okur; set nokt: The thermostat reads the room temperature; when the set point is reached it closes the solenoid valve and the compressor pumps down.
Defrost timer/sensör tetiklendiğinde sıc: When the defrost timer/sensor triggers, hot gas or an electric heater is directed to the evaporator.
Sefere çıkmadan kumanya yüklendiğinde tü: When provisions are loaded before the voyage, all rooms are brought down to the set temperature.
Sıcaklık ve alarm kayıtlarını Food Safet: Keep temperature and alarm records as required by the Food Safety Management Plan/MLC, the company procedure and the cargo/provisions; do not generalise that 'HACCP is mandatory in the same form on every ship'.
Evaporator coil'inde aşırı buz birikimi: If there is excessive ice build-up on the evaporator coil, defrost is started manually.
Refrigerant level (sight glass) ve oil l: The refrigerant level (sight glass) and the oil level (compressor) are checked.
Condenser sea-water strainer'ını differe: Clean the condenser seawater strainer according to the differential pressure, the flow/temperature trend and the PMS; do not use a fixed weekly interval in place of evidence of fouling.
Gaz kaçağı, evaporator buzlu, solenoid v: Gas leak, evaporator iced up, solenoid valve closed
LP switch ayarsız, gaz az, sıvı geri dön: LP switch out of adjustment, low gas charge, liquid return
Switch ayar, gaz şarj, ekspansiyon valf: Adjust the switch, charge gas, service the expansion valve.
Replace the seal; increase the defrost frequency.
Check the SW pump, strainer; clean the condenser.
Soğuk depoya tek başına girilmez; içerid: Never enter a cold store alone; risk of being trapped inside (panic alarm + radio).
Defrost sırasında üretilen sıvı drain ha: The drain line for the liquid produced during defrost must not be blocked (freezing/leakage).
Refrigerant kaçağı boğulma, toksisite ve: A refrigerant leak can create a risk of asphyxiation, toxicity or flammability; the need for a fixed detector is verified from the refrigerant class/charge, the space and the class/flag risk assessment, and portable measurement and ventilation are kept ready.
Kompresör çalışırken suction valf kapatı: The suction valve must not be closed while the compressor is running (liquid compression = breakage).
Ana bara gerilimi kaybolur; düşük gerili: Voltage on the main busbar is lost; the undervoltage relay sends a start signal to the emergency generator.
Marş kaynağı (akü/hidrolik/hava) ana güç: The starting source (battery/hydraulic/air) starts the set independently of main power.
Set nominal gerilim ve frekansa ulaşınca: When the set reaches nominal voltage and frequency, the emergency busbar breaker closes and the interconnector remains open.
Geçici güç kaynağı, jeneratör yüke alına: The transitional source of power supplies the emergency lighting and communications until the generator takes the load.
Ana güç geri geldiğinde düzen prosedüre: When main power is restored, the arrangement returns to normal supply in accordance with the procedure and the set is put back into automatic mode.
Testten önce yakıt seviyesi, yağ, soğutm: Before the test, check the fuel level, oil, cooling water, battery voltage, block heater and ventilation of the space.
Seti SMS/PMS sıklığında çalıştır; mümkün: Run the set at the SMS/PMS frequency; where possible, verify both the automatic start sequence and supply under load.
Acil switchboard üzerindeki tüketici bre: Confirm that the consumer breakers on the emergency switchboard and the interconnector are in the positions stated in the procedure.
Test sonrası seti soğut, yakıtı tamamla: After the test, cool the set down, top up the fuel and put it in automatic mode; record the result.
Yıl içinde en az bir kez, planlı ve izin: At least once a year, practise a blackout scenario under planned and authorised conditions according to the company procedure.
Akü zayıf/şarj arızası, start rölesi vey: Weak battery/charger fault, start relay or undervoltage sensor fault, fuel valve closed
Akü gerilimini yük altında ölç, manuel s: Measure the battery voltage under load, distinguish the fault with a manual start, trace the fuel line and the sensor circuit.
AVR arızası, breaker kapanma mantığı vey: AVR fault, breaker closing logic or overload
Gerilim/frekansı ölç, breaker kapatma iz: Measure the voltage/frequency; check the breaker closing permissives and the consumer list.
Egzozdan yağlı duman, düşük yüklerde çal: Oily smoke from the exhaust, poor running at low load
Uzun süre yüksüz çalıştırma (wet stackin: Prolonged running at no load (wet stacking)
Gerçek yük veya yük bankasıyla periyodik: Apply periodic loading with real load or a load bank; check the injectors and the exhaust side.
Ana güç geldiğinde acil bara beslemesi g: Emergency busbar supply does not change back when main power returns
Interconnector arızası veya hatalı mod s: Interconnector fault or wrong mode selection
Transfer mantığını ve breaker konumların: Verify the transfer logic and breaker positions on the diagram.
Test sonrası set manuel modda kalmış: Set left in manual mode after the test
Prosedür sonrası mod konumunun kontrol e: Mode position not checked after the procedure
Mod konumunu tur kontrol listesine ekle: Add the mode position to the rounds checklist and confirm it at the handover.
Acil jeneratör mahalli depo olarak kulla: The emergency generator room must not be used as a store; access routes, doors and ventilation are kept clear.
Test sırasında ana bara ile paralelleme: During the test, paralleling with the main busbar is done only if the arrangement allows it and there is a written procedure.
Egzoz hattı, damper ve mahal havalandırm: The exhaust line, dampers and room ventilation are checked before the test; running with a closed damper creates a risk of CO and overheating.
Akü mahallinde hidrojen birikimine karşı: Ventilation is provided in the battery room against the build-up of hydrogen, and sources of sparks are kept away.

Devir %10 düşerse N = 810 dev/dak: If the speed falls by 10%, N = 810 rpm
Ana makine şaftı, dişli kutusu veya doğr: The main engine shaft drives the electrical machine through a gearbox or a direct coupling.
PTO modunda makine senkron jeneratör gib: In PTO mode the machine works as a synchronous generator; the voltage is maintained by the AVR and the frequency by constant speed or a converter.
PTI/PTH modunda aynı makine şebekeden be: In PTI/PTH mode the same machine is supplied from the network and works as a motor, delivering torque to the shaft.
PMS, yük durumuna göre şaft jeneratörü i: The PMS manages load sharing and changeover between the shaft generator and the auxiliary diesel generators according to the load.
Devreye almadan önce şaft devri, ana mak: Before putting it on line, verify that the shaft speed, main engine load and propeller mode (CPP pitch) are suitable.
Senkronizasyon koşullarını (gerilim, fre: Meet the synchronising conditions (voltage, frequency, phase sequence, phase angle) and connect to the busbar.
Yük transferini kademeli yap; yardımcı j: Transfer the load gradually; before taking the auxiliary generator off line, see that the shaft generator carries the load steadily.
Manevra öncesi yardımcı jeneratörü devre: Before manoeuvring, put the auxiliary generator on line and take the shaft generator off line in accordance with the procedure.
Konvertör soğutması, harmonik filtre ve: Check the converter cooling, harmonic filter and fan/filter condition periodically.
Şaft devri değişimi, CPP hatve kontrolü: Change in shaft speed, CPP pitch control or converter regulation fault
Devir ve hatve geri beslemesini kontrol: Check the speed and pitch feedback, review the converter alarm log, change over to the auxiliary generator if necessary.
Mod seçimlerini ve kW/kVAr tepkisini jen: Compare the mode selections and the kW/kVAr response generator by generator.
Ana makine yavaşladığında güç kaybı: Loss of power when the main engine slows down
Düşük devirde şaft jeneratörü kapasitesi: Reduced shaft generator capacity at low speed
Seyir safhasına göre stand-by jeneratörü: Put the standby generator on line in advance according to the phase of the voyage.
Fan/filtre tıkanıklığı, soğutma suyu sor: Fan/filter blockage, cooling water problem, overload
Yükü azalt, soğutma ve filtre durumunu k: Reduce the load, check the cooling and filter condition, observe the manufacturer's limits.
PTH modunda beklenen hız sağlanamıyor: Expected speed not reached in PTH mode
Sınırlı güç, hatve/ayar hatası veya bata: Limited power, pitch/setting error or battery capacity
Düzenin tasarım gücünü ve süresini doğru: Verify the design power and duration of the arrangement; revise the passage plan accordingly.
Şaft jeneratörü devredeyken ana makine y: If the main engine load and speed are to be changed while the shaft generator is on line, the electrical load is managed in advance.
Konvertör ve alternatör mahallinde yükse: High-voltage warnings and the lock-out (LOTO) procedure are applied in the converter and alternator spaces.
Harmonik bozulma hassas elektronik cihaz: Harmonic distortion can affect sensitive electronic equipment; measurements and filter maintenance are not neglected.
PTH düzeninin kapasitesi ve çalışma süre: The emergency plan is not based on the PTH arrangement without knowing its capacity and operating time.
Elektrik veya hidrolik motor, dişli kutu: An electric or hydraulic motor turns the propeller inside the tunnel through a gearbox.
Kuvvetin yönü ve şiddeti, CPP düzeninde: The direction and magnitude of the thrust are set by the pitch angle in a CPP arrangement, and by the direction and speed of rotation through a converter in an FPP arrangement.
Köprüüstü kumandası, hatve/devir talebin: The bridge control sends the pitch/speed demand to the local control unit; the feedback indicator shows the actual pitch.
Yağ sistemi dişli kutusunu ve sızdırmazl: The oil system supplies the gearbox and the seals; the pressure and level are monitored.
Manevradan önce ilave jeneratörü devreye: Before manoeuvring, put an additional generator on line, report the thruster ready to the bridge and verify the transfer of control.
İticiyi kademeli yükle; sürekli tam güçt: Load the thruster gradually; prolonged continuous use at full power pushes the motor and converter temperature limits.
Hatve göstergesi ile gerçek kuvvet tepki: Compare the pitch indicator with the actual thrust response; if load is drawn at zero pitch, the feedback or the mechanism is faulty.
Manevra bitiminde iticiyi durdur, hatvey: At the end of manoeuvring, stop the thruster, set the pitch to zero and cut off the electrical supply according to the procedure.
Yağ seviyesi, sıcaklık, titreşim ve moto: Record the oil level, temperature, vibration and motor winding temperature.
Tünel ızgarası kirli, hatve geri besleme: Tunnel grating fouled, wrong pitch feedback, damaged propeller
Izgara ve pervane durumunu dalgıç/havuzl: Check the grating and propeller by diver/dry-docking; verify the pitch calibration.
Yol verirken bara frekansı düşüyor / bla: Busbar frequency drops on starting / risk of blackout
Yetersiz jeneratör kapasitesi, ani yük a: Insufficient generator capacity, sudden load increase
İlave jeneratörü devreye al, yol verme r: Put an additional generator on line; review the start ramp and PMS settings.
Kavitasyon, yabancı cisim, kanat hasarı: Cavitation, a foreign object, blade damage or bearing wear
Yükü azalt, titreşim ölçümü al, ilk fırs: Reduce the load, take a vibration measurement and plan a diver inspection at the first opportunity.
Kullanımı sınırla, seviye trendini kayde: Limit its use, record the level trend, report the pollution risk and plan a repair.
Uzun süreli tam yük, soğutma veya filtre: Prolonged full load, cooling or filter problem
Yükü düşür, soğutma ve havalandırmayı ko: Reduce the load, check the cooling and ventilation, keep within the manufacturer's operating time limit.
Tünel bölgesinde dalgıç çalışması varsa: If divers are working in the tunnel area, the thruster is electrically isolated and locked out (LOTO).
İtici mahalline giriş öncesi mahal haval: Before entering the thruster room, the ventilation of the space and enclosed-space risks are assessed.
Aşırı ısınmayı önlemek için üreticinin s: To prevent overheating, the manufacturer's continuous operating time and restart limits are observed.
Yağ kaçağı şüphesinde kirlilik bildirim: If an oil leak is suspected, the obligation to report pollution is assessed together with the Master.

LT devresinde 200 m³/h debi dolaşıyor ve: A flow of 200 m³/h circulates in the LT circuit, and the difference between the inlet and outlet of the central cooler is measured as 5 K. Calculate the heat transferred.
Deniz suyu pompası, sandıktan aldığı suy: The seawater pump draws water from the sea chest and pumps it through the strainer to the central cooler.
LT devresi ekipman soğutucularından geçe: The LT circuit collects heat as it passes through the equipment coolers and transfers it to seawater in the central cooler.
HT devresi ana makine gömleklerini soğut: The HT circuit cools the main engine jackets; the temperature is kept constant with a three-way thermostatic valve, and excess heat is given to the LT circuit or the fresh water generator.
Genleşme tankı devrenin havasını atar, ı: The expansion tank vents the circuit, takes up thermal expansion and serves as the filling point.
Vardiyada deniz suyu süzgeç fark basıncı: On watch, check the seawater strainer differential pressure, the pump pressures and that the standby pump is in automatic.
HT/LT giriş-çıkış sıcaklıklarını yükle b: Trend the HT/LT inlet and outlet temperatures together with the load; a rising difference at the same load indicates fouling.
Genleşme tankı seviyesini her turda kayd: Record the expansion tank level on every round; if it changes suddenly, check for leaks and internal leakage.
Sığ ve çamurlu sularda uygun deniz sandı: In shallow and muddy waters, change over to the suitable sea chest; if necessary, use the blowing line according to the procedure.
Kimyasal ölçümleri planlı aralıkta yap,: Carry out chemical tests at the planned intervals; record the dosing and the results.

Karışım tankında sürekli hava/gaz: Continuous air/gas in the mixing tank
Emiş tarafında kaçak veya besleme basınc: Leak on the suction side or low supply pressure
Emiş hattını sızdırmazlık yönünden kontr: Check the suction line for tightness; increase the supply pressure.
Sıcak yakıt hatlarında sızıntı yangın ri: A leak on hot fuel lines is a fire risk; insulation and spray shields must be complete.

Yakıt değişimi manevra veya kritik seyir: Fuel changeover is carried out under planned, traceable conditions, not during manoeuvring or a critical phase of the voyage.

Pompa, yağı tanktan alıp soğutucu ve fil: The pump draws oil from the tank and delivers it through the cooler and filter to the bearings.

Silindir yağlama ünitesi, yük ve devir b: The cylinder lubrication unit gives a metered dose according to load and speed.
Kıç şaft baş tankı, su hattı üzerindeki: The stern tube header tank, positioned above the waterline, provides a positive oil pressure in the bearing.

Planlı aralıklarla yağ numunesi al; su i: Take oil samples at planned intervals; follow the water content, viscosity and wear metal results.

Yetersiz silindir yağı beslemesi veya uy: Insufficient cylinder oil feed or unsuitable BN

Trendi kaydet, kullanım koşullarını sını: Record the trend, restrict the operating conditions, report the pollution risk and plan a repair.
Karter kapağı, makine durdurulup soğuma: The crankcase door is not opened before the engine has stopped and the cooling time has passed; hot oil vapour carries a risk of explosion.
Yağ kaçakları sıcak yüzeylerde yangın ka: Oil leaks on hot surfaces are a source of fire; insulation and spray shields are kept complete.
Yağ numunesi alırken sıcak yağ ve basınç: Suitable PPE is used against hot oil and pressure when taking oil samples.
Kullanılmış yağ ve filtreler atık yöneti: Used oil and filters are collected and recorded in accordance with the waste management rules.
3000 m³ balastın 500 m³/saat kapasiteli: How long does it take to pump 3,000 m³ of ballast with a single pump of 500 m³/h capacity? What should be done if loading is to be completed in 4 hours?
Balast pompası, deniz sandığından veya t: The ballast pump takes water from the sea chest or a tank and delivers it through the main line to the target tank.
Uzaktan kumandalı valfler hidrolik/pnöma: Remotely controlled valves are opened by hydraulic/pneumatic actuators; position feedback is shown on the panel.
Eductor, tahrik suyu ile vakum oluşturar: The eductor creates a vacuum with driving water and strips the water from the bottom of the tank.
Sintine pompası, kuyulardan aldığı suyu: The bilge pump sends the water from the bilge wells to the holding tank or the approved separator.
Yüksek seviye alarmı, kuyudaki su seviye: The high-level alarm warns the control room when the water level in a well exceeds the threshold.

Sintine kuyularını turlarda gözle kontro: Check the bilge wells visually on rounds and test the alarms at planned intervals.
Tüm aktarım ve deşarj işlemlerini ilgili: Enter all transfer and discharge operations in the relevant record book on time and with actual values.

Balast tankında beklenmeyen seviye değiş: Unexpected level change in a ballast tank

İlgili valfleri izole ederek ayrım yap,: Identify the source by isolating the valves concerned, compare the tank sounding trend, inform the Chief Engineer.
Balast tankı ve kuyu girişleri kapalı ma: Ballast tanks and well access openings are enclosed spaces; they are not entered without an entry permit, gas testing and ventilation.
Sintine ve balast hatları arasında geçic: No temporary connection is made between bilge and ballast lines; such arrangements are a serious non-conformity in inspections.
Onaylı ayırıcı devre dışıyken sintine su: Bilge water is not discharged overboard while the approved separator is out of service; holding capacity and a shore facility plan are arranged in advance.
Ağır hava ve yükleme safhalarında serbes: In heavy weather and during loading phases, tanks are kept full or empty as far as possible, taking account of the free surface effect.

Tüketici bazında hareket hızını ve tutma: Check the speed of movement and holding of each consumer; slowing down indicates internal leakage.
Yağ numunesini periyodik al; partikül ve: Take oil samples periodically; update the filter/oil plan according to the particle and water content results.
Pompa aşınması, iç kaçak, emniyet valfi: Pump wear, internal leakage, relief valve set too low

Emniyet valfinden sürekli dönüş, soğutuc: Continuous return through the relief valve, fouled cooler, low oil level

Akümülatör ön şarj kaybı veya sistemde k: Loss of accumulator pre-charge or a leak in the system
Ön şarjı ölç ve düzelt, hat/valf kaçakla: Measure and correct the pre-charge; look for line/valve leaks.
Sistemde gürültü ve titreşim: Noise and vibration in the system
Emişte hava, kavitasyon, tank seviyesi d: Air in the suction, cavitation, low tank level
Seviyeyi tamamla, emiş hattı sızdırmazlı: Top up the level, check the suction line for tightness, vent the air.
Kaynağı belirle (soğutucu, havalandırma,: Identify the source (cooler, vent, deck water), take a sample, change the oil if necessary.

Kaçak aramak için karton veya uygun bir: A piece of cardboard or another suitable surface is used to look for leaks; never a hand or bare skin.
Yüksek basınçlı yağ yaralanmalarında gör: In high-pressure oil injection injuries, medical help is requested immediately even if the visible wound is small.
Yağ kaçakları güvertede kayma riski ve d: Oil leaks create a slip hazard on deck and pollution of the sea; they are cleaned up and recorded at once.
Transfer pompası, bunker tankından aldığ: The transfer pump delivers fuel from the bunker tank to the selected tank; the line arrangement is set with valves.
Isıtma serpantinleri viskoziteyi pompala: Heating coils keep the viscosity in the pumpable range.
Separatör, filtre ve drenaj kaynaklı kal: Residues from the separators, filters and drains are collected in the sludge tank.
Sludge pompası, tank içeriğini insinerat: The sludge pump sends the tank contents to the incinerator feed tank or to a shore facility through the standard connection.
Yüksek seviye alarmı ve taşma tankı, aşı: The high-level alarm and the overflow tank are the last layer of protection against overfilling.
Transfer öncesi tank seviyelerini, hat d: Before the transfer, verify the tank levels, the line arrangement and the alarm status; calculate the capacity of the target tank.
Transferi sürekli gözetim altında yürüt;: Carry out the transfer under continuous supervision; compare the change in level with the expected flow rate.
Isıtma sıcaklığını yakıt tipine uygun tu: Keep the heating temperature suited to the fuel type; avoid overheating.
Sludge tankı seviyesini haftalık trendle: Trend the sludge tank level weekly; plan incineration or delivery ashore accordingly.

Kötü yakıt kalitesi, separatör ayar/perf: Poor fuel quality, separator setting/performance problem, excessive draining
Separatör sıcaklık ve debisini gözden ge: Review the separator temperature and flow, check the fuel analysis, measure the sources separately.
Tank ısıtmasını çalıştır, emiş ağzını ve: Switch on the tank heating; check the suction bellmouth and the line.
Transferi durdur, kaynağı belirle, olayı: Stop the transfer, identify the source, record the incident and the corrective action.
Bunker ve transfer sırasında güverte fir: During bunkering and transfer, the deck scuppers are closed, the drip trays kept empty and the SOPEP equipment kept ready.
Sıcak yakıt hatlarında sızıntı yangın ri: A leak on hot fuel lines is a fire risk; insulation and spray shields are maintained.
Sludge tankı kapalı mahaldir; giriş yaln: The sludge tank is an enclosed space; entry is made only with a permit, gas testing and ventilation.
Kayıt defteri girişleri sonradan toplu d: Record book entries are made as each operation is completed, not collectively afterwards, and are signed by the person in charge.
Pompa deniz suyunu kingstondan alır, bas: The pump takes seawater from the sea chest (Kingston valve), pressurises it and delivers it to the fire main.
Hat boyunca basınç sensörü ve PSV (press: There is a pressure sensor and a PSV (pressure safety valve) along the line.
Hidrant açıldığında basınç düşer; otomat: When a hydrant is opened, the pressure drops; the automatic start sensor starts the pump.

Pompayı yerel veya uzaktan (köprüüstü/ko: Start the pump locally or remotely (bridge/control room).

PMS/SMS testinde seçilmiş en olumsuz hid: In the PMS/SMS test, verify the start, priming, pressure/flow and independent suction function at the selected most unfavourable hydrant(s).
Suction tıkalı, hava emiyor, impeller aş: Suction blocked, drawing air, impeller worn
Strainer temizle, pompayı priming et, im: Clean the strainer, prime the pump, check the impeller.
Acil yangın pompası start almıyor: Emergency fire pump does not start
Akü ve yakıt seviyesini kontrol et, manu: Check the battery and fuel level; try a manual start.
Hat üzerinde sızıntı, valfler tam kapanm: Leak in the line, valves not fully closed
Hattı izle, valfleri sıkıştır, sızıntı n: Trace the line, tighten the valves, look for the leak.
Acil yangın pompasını PMS/SMS sıklığında: Test the emergency fire pump at the PMS/SMS frequency, including actual suction and hydrant pressure; do not consider a short no-load start sufficient.
Hidrant valfleri ve hortumları açık/kapa: Hydrant valves and hoses must be inspected against corrosion in both the open and closed positions.
ISC bağlantısı kolay erişilebilir yerde,: The ISC (international shore connection) must be easily accessible and clearly marked.
Kış aylarında açık güverte hatlarında do: In winter, precautions against freezing must be taken on open-deck lines.
CO₂ ortamdaki oksijeni seyrelterek yanma: CO₂ stops the combustion reaction by diluting the oxygen in the space.
Pilot silindiri açıldığında pnömatik bas: When the pilot cylinder is opened, pneumatic pressure triggers the master valve and the required number of cylinders.
Gaz manifolddan dağıtılır; nozüllerden h: The gas is distributed from the manifold and spreads through the space from the nozzles.
CO₂, oksijen parsiyel basıncını ve alev: CO₂ reduces the oxygen partial pressure and the flame reaction to an unsustainable level; adequacy is verified by the approved agent quantity/distribution calculation, and it does not mean the O₂ is safe for re-entry.
Yangın doğrulandıktan sonra makine daire: After the fire has been confirmed, the engine room is evacuated.
Quick closing valves, fan, jaluzi ve yak: The quick-closing valves, fans, louvres and fuel valves are closed (remotely).
Release box açılır: önce alarm/time dela: The release box is opened: first the alarm/time delay operates, then the master and cylinder valves open.
Boşaltım sonrası hacim soğuyana ve gaz a: After discharge, the space is not entered until it has cooled down and the gas has been analysed.
Silindiri tart, %10 kayıpta yeniden dold: Weigh the cylinder; refill or replace it if 10% has been lost.
Pilot hattını kontrol et, manuel boşaltı: Check the pilot line; change over to the manual release lever.
Hatları sızdırmazlık testi, yedek pilot: Leak-test the lines; change over to the spare pilot cylinder.
CO₂ odası iyi havalandırılmalı, sıcaklık: The CO₂ room must be well ventilated and the temperature must be < 55 °C.
Hacme girmeden önce oksimetre ile O₂ ölç: Before entering the space, O₂ must be measured with an oxygen meter (it must be > 20.5%).
Release box erişilebilir, işaretli ve ka: The release box is kept accessible, marked and protected against accidental operation; the seal/interlock/alarm function is tested according to the ship's approved arrangement.
Personel kazara aktivasyona karşı eğitil: Personnel must be trained against accidental activation and must know what the alarm means.
Yangın pompası deniz suyunu basınçlandır: The fire pump pressurises the seawater.
Inductor (proportioner) venturi etkisiyl: The inductor (proportioner) injects the foam concentrate into the main line at a set ratio by the venturi effect.
Foam–su karışımı nozüldeki hava ile çırp: The foam–water mixture is aerated by air at the nozzle to form foam.
Köpük yüzey üzerine örtülerek yangını bo: The foam blankets the surface, smothers the fire and suppresses fuel vapour.
Yangın pompasını çalıştır ve hatta basın: Start the fire pump and pressurise the line.
Foam tankı valfini aç, inductor seçim va: Open the foam tank valve; set the inductor selector valves.
Monitor/aplikatörü yangının kenarından m: Sweep the monitor/applicator from the edge of the fire towards the centre.
Söndürme sonrası örtü tabakasını bozma;: After extinguishment, do not disturb the foam blanket; prevent re-ignition.
Tank seviyesini kontrol et, inductor sök: Check the tank level; dismantle and clean the inductor.
Karışım oranı yanlış, hava emilimi düşük: Wrong mixing ratio, low air induction
Proportioner kalibrasyonu yap, nozülü ko: Calibrate the proportioner; check the nozzle.
Foam numunesini test et, gerekirse tankı: Test a foam sample; if necessary, empty the tank and refill with new concentrate.
Foam konsantresinin yıllık laboratuvar t: The foam concentrate must be laboratory-tested annually.
AFFF cilde temas ederse bol su ile yıkan: If AFFF comes into contact with skin, it must be washed off with plenty of water.
Tatbikat sonrası hat tatlı suyla yıkanma: After a drill, the line must be flushed with fresh water to prevent corrosion.
Foam genişleme oranı ve drenaj süresi pe: The foam expansion ratio and drainage time must be measured periodically.
Cam ampul ısıyla genleşip patlar, başlık: The glass bulb expands with heat and bursts, opening the head.
Hat basıncı düşer, alarm valfi açılır ve: The line pressure drops, the alarm valve opens and the pump starts.
Deluge sisteminde manuel veya dedektör t: In a deluge system, all the heads in the zone discharge at the same time when triggered manually or by a detector.
Sistemi her zaman basınçlı (charged) kon: Keep the system charged at all times.
Manometre, tank/pump ve alarm testlerini: Carry out the pressure gauge, tank/pump and alarm tests according to the PMS and the maker/FSS test arrangement.
Test valfinden örnek deşarj alarak alarm: Test the alarm valve by taking a sample discharge from the test valve.
Deşarj sonrası ıslanan sigorta panelleri: After a discharge, wetted fuse panels and electronics are checked.
Sızıntıyı tespit et, jokey pompayı kontr: Find the leak; check the jockey pump.
Replace the head and tighten it to the correct torque.
Switch test, kontak temizle veya değişti: Test the switch; clean or replace the contacts.
Sprinkler başlıklarına boya, izolasyon v: Sprinkler heads must not be painted, insulated or modified.
Başlık çevresinde 50 cm açık alan bırakı: A clear space of 50 cm must be left around the head.
Donma riskli alanlarda kuru tip (dry pip: In areas at risk of freezing, a dry-pipe type should be preferred.
Muayene, flow test ve basınç test aralık: Verify the inspection, flow test and pressure test intervals from the maker, class/flag and MSC guidance/PMS; a hydraulic test of the whole system every year is not a general rule.
Boiler exhaust ~%4 O₂ ile scrubber'a gir: Boiler exhaust at ~4% O₂ enters the scrubber; it is cooled and cleaned by seawater washing.
The blower delivers this gas to the deck main.
Deck water seal sıvı bariyer oluşturarak: The deck water seal forms a liquid barrier that prevents backflow.
Hat basıncı düşerse alarm; çok artarsa P: If the line pressure falls there is an alarm; if it rises too high, the P/V breaker relieves it.
Boiler'ı yeterli yükte tut, scrubber pom: Keep the boiler at a sufficient load; start the scrubber pump.
Blower'ı low/high speed devreye al, çıkı: Start the blower at low/high speed; monitor the outlet O₂.
O₂ %5'in altına inince main isolation va: When the O₂ falls below 5%, open the main isolation valve.
Discharge sırasında tank pozitif basınçt: During discharge, the tank is kept at positive pressure (~200 mmWC).
Boiler düşük yük, blower kaçırıyor: Boiler at low load, blower leaking
Boiler yükünü artır, blower seal/conta k: Increase the boiler load; check the blower seal/gasket.
Seviye otomatiğini kontrol et, manuel be: Check the automatic level control; feed manually.
Tank valfi sızdırıyor, P/V valve açık ka: Tank valve leaking, P/V valve stuck open
Check the valves; test the P/V valve.
Tank atmosferine giriş öncesi mutlaka ga: Before entering a tank atmosphere, gas-freeing and an O₂ measurement are always required.
Discharging cargo while the IGS is off is prohibited.
Scrubber'da yıkama suyu sürekli akmalı,: Wash water must flow continuously in the scrubber; otherwise overheating and corrosion occur.
Sistem üzerinde her zaman iki bağımsız n: There must always be two independent non-return barriers in the system.
Duman dedektöründe optik oda; partikül g: In a smoke detector's optical chamber, light is scattered when particles enter and the photocell signal increases.
Sabit sıcaklık dedektöründe bimetal/eute: In a fixed-temperature detector, a bimetal/eutectic element closes the circuit at the threshold temperature.
Sinyal merkezi panel tarafından bölgeye: The signal is matched to its zone by the central panel, and a visual + audible alarm is given.
Panel lamp, fault, isolator ve zone/loop: Carry out panel lamp, fault, isolator and zone/loop tests with the Fire Safety Operational Booklet at the PMS frequency.
Dedektörleri onaylı test gazı/ısı/alev s: Function-test the detectors with an approved test gas/heat/flame simulator according to the maker's and the MSC.1/Circ.1432 maintenance plan.
Dedektör temizleme/değişim aralığını çev: Plan the detector cleaning/replacement interval according to environmental contamination, self-monitoring, the maker's limit and the test trend.
Yanlış alarm sonrası bölge önce silinir,: After a false alarm, the zone is first silenced, then reset.
Clean the detector; replace it if necessary.
Measure the line; check the terminations.
Replace the battery; test the charging circuit.
Dedektör altında 50 cm açık koni olmalı,: There must be a clear cone of 50 cm under the detector; no objects may be placed there.
Boya/dekorasyon sırasında dedektörler sö: During painting/decoration, detectors must not be removed or covered.
Test sırasında köprüüstüne ve makine kon: The bridge and the engine control room must be informed before a test.
Yıllık sertifika ve test raporları gemi: Annual certificates and test reports must be kept in the ship's records.
Su: soğutma ile söndürür (yangın üçgenin: Water: extinguishes by cooling (removes the heat from the fire triangle).
Köpük: yakıt yüzeyini örter, oksijeni ke: Foam: blankets the fuel surface and cuts off the oxygen.
CO₂: oksijeni seyreltir, soğutur (-78 °C: CO₂: dilutes the oxygen and cools (−78 °C).
Kuru kimyasal: yanma reaksiyonunu kimyas: Dry chemical: interrupts the combustion reaction chemically (chain breaking).
P-A-S-S: Pin çek, Aim (alevin tabanına n: P-A-S-S: Pull the pin, Aim at the base of the flame, Squeeze the handle, Sweep from side to side.
Rüzgârı arkana al, alevin tabanına yönle: Keep the wind behind you; aim at the base of the flame.
Söndürdükten sonra geri çekil, yeniden a: After extinguishing, step back and watch for re-ignition.
Kullanılan veya boşalmış söndürücü hemen: A used or discharged extinguisher is replaced at once and its use is recorded.
Manometre kırmızı bölgede (basınç düşük): Pressure gauge in the red zone (low pressure)
Send it for servicing and have it refilled.
Hortumu değiştir, yıllık servis kontrolü: Replace the hose; mark it at the annual service check.
Söndürücüye yakın elektrik tablosu varsa: If there is an electrical panel near the extinguisher, CO₂/dry chemical must be chosen; water is prohibited.
CO₂ kapalı küçük hacimde kullanırsa boğu: Using CO₂ in a small enclosed space carries a risk of asphyxiation.
Kuru kimyasal sonrası elektronik ekipman: After dry chemical has been used, electronic equipment needs drying and cleaning.
Söndürücü kullanımı eğitimi SOLAS III/19: Training in the use of extinguishers is given under SOLAS III/19.4: to personnel joining the ship within two weeks at the latest, and covering all equipment within two-month periods.
Yüksek basınçlı tüp (200–300 bar) hava r: The high-pressure cylinder (200–300 bar) air is reduced to medium pressure by the regulator.
Demand valf, kullanıcı nefes aldıkça mas: The demand valve supplies air to the mask as the user breathes in.
Low-pressure warning maker set değerinde: The low-pressure warning operates at the maker's set value; at entry control the team works out the pressure–time calculation and turn-around pressure and starts the return without waiting for the whistle.
Kullanım öncesi tüp basıncını sıcaklık d: Before use, check the cylinder pressure with a temperature correction against the maker's full-charge value; record that it is sufficient for the team's entry time/return reserve.
Maske sızdırmazlık testi: tüm girişi kap: Mask seal test: block the inlet completely and breathe in deeply — it must hold the vacuum.
Cihazı tak, ana valfi tam aç, demand val: Put on the set, open the main valve fully, connect the demand valve.
Görev sırasında basıncı izle; düdük çald: Monitor the pressure during the task; turn back when the whistle sounds.
Conta kontrol et, kompresörden yeniden d: Check the seal; refill from the compressor.
Send it for servicing; replace with a spare set.
Doğru boy seç, contayı değiştir, sakal t: Choose the correct size, replace the seal, shave off the beard.
SCBA tüpünün hydrostatic test ve ömür li: Verify the hydrostatic test and service life limits of the SCBA cylinder from the cylinder standard, the manufacturer and the flag requirements; do not judge the certificate/marking by a fixed 5-year rule alone.
Hava kompresöründe CO/CO₂/yağ buharı fil: The CO/CO₂/oil vapour filters of the air compressor must be replaced periodically.
EEBD eğitimi yapılmadan kullanılmamalı;: An EEBD must not be used without training; the hood must provide eye protection.
Yangın takımı yerinde, mühürlü ve eksiks: The fireman's outfit must be kept in place, sealed and complete; the monthly check must be recorded.
QCV sapanı çekildiğinde önceden kurulmuş: When the QCV pull wire is pulled, the pre-set spring force closes the valve disc.
Pnömatik tipte ise kontrol valfi açılınc: On pneumatic types, the cylinder closes the QCV when the control valve is opened.
Fan stop kontağı motor kontaktörünü açar: The fan stop contact opens the motor contactor and the fan stops.
Yakıt servis pompası emergency stop kont: The emergency stop contact of the fuel service pump cuts the circuit through the protection relay.
Yangın doğrulanıp tahliye sağlandıktan s: After the fire has been confirmed and evacuation ensured: shut off the fuel (QCV) → stop the fans → stop the fuel pumps → release the CO₂.
Aylık testlerde her QCV ayrı ayrı kapatı: In the monthly tests, each QCV is closed, opened and greased individually.
Emergency stop butonları PSC denetiminde: The emergency stop buttons are function-tested in PSC inspections.
Test sonrası ilgili sistemlerin yeniden: After the test, it is entered in the log book that the systems concerned have been put back into service.
Yay korozyonu, kablo gevşek, hava basınc: Spring corroded, wire slack, no air pressure
Mekanik kontrol, yağla, hava şişesi bası: Check mechanically, lubricate, recharge the air bottle.
Test the contactor; replace the coil.
Valf revize edilmeli, gerekirse değiştir: The valve must be overhauled and replaced if necessary.
Tatbikat dışında QCV asla kapatılmamalı: A QCV must not be closed except in an emergency or during a planned test/drill (the main engine may stop).
Test öncesi köprüüstü ve makine kontrol: The bridge and engine control room must be informed before a test.
Re-set sonrası yakıt hattında havayı al,: After resetting, vent the fuel line and check for leaks.
Etiketleme net olmalı: hangi tank/pompa: Labelling must be clear: it must show which tank/pump is connected to which pull wire.
Santrifüj pompada impeller döner; merkez: In a centrifugal pump the impeller rotates; centrifugal force throws the liquid outwards into the volute and the discharge pressure is created.
Submerged pompada tank içi pompa motoru: In a submerged pump, the in-tank pump motor is driven by hydraulic oil; the liquid rises directly through the pump to the riser pipe.
Pozitif deplasmanlı stripping pompası he: A positive displacement stripping pump moves a fixed volume every revolution; it gives a low flow but a high vacuum.
Booster pompa ana pompanın discharge'ını: The booster pump takes the discharge of the main pump and pressurises it again.
Tank discharge planına göre suction valf: Open the suction valve according to the tank discharge plan; line up the manifold valve to the terminal.
Pump room'u ventile et, gas detection si: Ventilate the pump room; keep the gas detection system active.
Pompayı düşük rpm'de çalıştır, prime tam: Start the pump at low rpm; when priming is complete, increase the flow gradually.
Tank seviyesi ~%10'a düştüğünde strippin: When the tank level falls to ~10%, change over to the stripping pump; check with the vacuum-cleared lamp.
Hava emiyor, valf kapalı, impeller aşınm: Drawing air, valve closed, impeller worn
Suction line ve valfleri kontrol et, pri: Check the suction line and valves, prime, service the impeller.
Yatak yağı yetersiz, mekanik conta sızın: Insufficient bearing oil, mechanical seal leakage
Yağı kontrol et, mechanical seal değişti: Stop immediately, check the oil, replace the mechanical seal.
Provide a liquid seal; replace the seal.
Pump room'a girmeden önce O₂, LEL ve H₂S: Before entering the pump room, O₂, LEL and H₂S must be measured; SCBA must be used if necessary.
Statik biriktiren cargo ve boş tanka ilk: For static-accumulator cargoes and at the start of loading into an empty tank, a low line velocity is used until the inlet is covered; the exact velocity/height is taken from ISGOTT, the terminal and the cargo plan — 1 m/s is not applied blindly to every cargo.
Cargo ESD/remote stop istasyonlarının ye: The locations of the cargo ESD/remote stop stations and the equipment they affect are verified from the approved plan and the ship–shore checklist; the effect of an unwanted valve surge is assessed in advance.
Boşaltım sırasında trim ve heel sürekli: Trim and heel must be monitored continuously during discharge; the free surface moment must be taken into account.
Tank seviyesi belirli bir oranda boşaltı: After the tank has been discharged to a certain level, the COW pump is started.
Makine, tank içinde belirli açıda dönerk: As the machine rotates through set angles inside the tank, the jet of crude oil strikes the bulkheads and dissolves the sediment.
Çözünen tortu yükle birlikte stripping p: The dissolved sediment is transferred with the cargo by the stripping pump to the slop tank.
İkinci aşama (bottom wash) tank dibine o: The second stage (bottom wash) concentrates on the tank bottom; the ROB is minimised.
Top wash'i yalnız onaylı COW Manual'deki: Start the top wash only at the tank-specific ullage, machine pattern and point in the discharge sequence given in the approved COW Manual.
Bottom wash/stripping zamanını tank plan: Carry out the bottom wash/stripping timing according to the approved COW programme, with the tank plan, suction coverage and terminal discharge sequence.
Yıkama süresince hat basıncını ve makine: Monitor the line pressure and machine speed throughout the wash.
Yıkama sonrası tankı stripping ile boşal: After washing, strip the tank and keep it under pressure with the IGS.
Yıkama kayıtlarını COW Operations Manual: Enter the washing records in the COW Operations Manual and the Oil Record Book.
Pompa arızası, hat sızıntısı, makine tık: Pump failure, line leak, machine blocked
Pompa kontrol, hat sızıntı testi, makine: Check the pump, leak-test the line, dismantle and clean the machine.
Türbin kanadı tıkalı, hidrolik motor arı: Turbine blade blocked, hydraulic motor faulty
Makineyi sök, türbini temizle veya motor: Dismantle the machine; clean the turbine or replace the motor.
Tank O₂/IG basıncı limit dışı: Tank O₂/IG pressure outside the limits
IGS yetersiz, analizör/sampling hatası v: Insufficient IGS, analyser/sampling fault or tank leakage
COW'u derhal durdur; onaylı manual'deki: Stop COW immediately; re-establish the tank O₂ and supply O₂ limits, positive pressure and analyser accuracy given in the approved manual.
COW sırasında fixed/portable O₂ ölçümler: During COW, fixed/portable O₂ measurements are compared at the frequency in the approved manual; the stop criteria in the manual are applied before the tank approaches the 8% O₂ limit.
Yıkama makineleri için onaylı operasyone: The approved operational envelope for the washing machines must not be exceeded.
Statik şarj birikimini önlemek için yıka: The washing flow must be controlled to prevent the build-up of static charge.
Personel pump room'a girmeden önce H₂S ö: Personnel must measure H₂S before entering the pump room (especially with sour crude).
Radar gauge, tank tepesindeki anten 6–10: In a radar gauge, the antenna at the top of the tank transmits 6–10 GHz microwaves; the delay of the signal reflected from the liquid surface is converted into ullage.
Hidrostatik sensör tank dibindeki basınc: A hydrostatic sensor calculates the level by dividing the pressure at the bottom of the tank by the liquid density.
PT100 sıcaklık sensörü tankın 3 farklı y: PT100 temperature sensors give the average temperature at 3 different heights in the tank.
Sinyaller CCR (cargo control room) ekran: The signals are displayed graphically on the CCR (cargo control room) screen.
Yükleme/boşaltım öncesi radar gauge'ı ma: Before loading/discharging, cross-check the radar gauge with a manual UTI.
High level alarm test butonu ile çalışır: Verify that the high-level alarm works with its test button.
Ullage, sıcaklık ve trim'i CCR'da sürekl: Monitor the ullage, temperature and trim continuously in the CCR.
Inerted tank'a UTI sokmadan önce vapor l: Before inserting a UTI into an inerted tank, the vapour lock valve must be opened and static bonding ensured.
Anten kirli, vapor space yoğun buhar: Antenna dirty, dense vapour in the vapour space
Sensörü test et, hattı ölç, yedek devrey: Test the sensor, measure the line, bring the back-up into use.
Bağlantıyı sıkı, gerekirse PT100 değişti: Tighten the connection; replace the PT100 if necessary.
UTI manuel ölçümde statik bonding kablos: The static bonding cable must always be connected for manual UTI measurement.
Yükleme sırasında bağımsız overfill alar: The independent overfill alarm must be functional during loading.
Tank ullage planı ve sıcaklık logu shift: The tank ullage plan and temperature log must be kept for each shift.
Sensör kalibrasyon sertifikası periyodik: The sensor calibration certificate must be renewed periodically.
Hidrolik güç ünitesi (HPU), silindirleri: The hydraulic power unit (HPU) operates the cylinders and locking mechanisms.
Açma sırasında: kilitler açılır → kapak: When opening: the locks open → the cover rises → the cylinders fold the panel sideways/downwards.
Sızdırmazlık coaming çevresindeki rubber: Weathertightness is provided by the rubber gasket around the coaming; it is compressed as the cover closes.
Drainage channel sızan suyu over-board v: The drainage channel leads leaking water overboard or to the bilge.
Açmadan önce kapağın üstündeki yük ve bu: Before opening, any load and ice/snow on top of the cover must be removed.
HPU'yu çalıştır, basıncı set değere geti: Start the HPU and bring the pressure to the set value.
Kilitleri sırasıyla aç, kapak hareketi s: Open the locks in sequence; keep everyone clear while the cover is moving.
Kapatma sonrası gasket'in tam oturduğunu: After closing, check that the gasket is fully seated and tighten the locks.
Denize çıkmadan önce hose test ile sızdı: Verify weathertightness with a hose test before going to sea.
Coaming üzerinde tortu, hidrolik basınç: Debris on the coaming, low hydraulic pressure
Clean the coaming; check the HPU pressure.
Renew the gasket; straighten the compression bar.
Sistemi havadan al, valf ve seal kontrol: Vent the system; check the valves and seals.
Açık kapak fırtınalı havada operasyon ya: Hatch covers must not be opened or operated in stormy weather.
Kapak üzerinde personel çalışacaksa kili: If personnel are to work on the cover, the locking safety (chock pin) must be fitted.
Periyodik gasket kontrolü ve hose/ultras: Records of periodic gasket checks and hose/ultrasonic tests must be kept.
Hatch cover load capacity stowage planın: The hatch cover load capacity must be taken into account in the stowage plan.
Twist-lock üst container'ın corner casti: The twistlock enters the corner casting of the upper container and locks when turned 90°.
Lashing rod'un alt ucu D-ring'e takılır,: The lower end of the lashing rod is attached to the D-ring and the upper end to the container corner; it is tightened with a turnbuckle.
Yükün eylemsizliği (acceleration × mass): The inertia of the cargo (acceleration × mass) must be less than the total MSL of the lashings.
CSM, geminin GM ve roll periyoduna göre: The CSM gives the lashing force calculation according to the ship's GM and roll period.
Yükleme öncesi tüm ekipman görsel kontro: All equipment is visually inspected before loading.
Stowage planına göre twist-lock'lar kont: Twistlocks are placed under the containers according to the stowage plan.
Container indirilip locked edildikten so: After the container has been landed and locked, the lashing rods are fitted.
Turnbuckle hand-tight + 1/2 tur ile sıkı: The turnbuckle is tightened hand-tight + 1/2 turn; slackness is checked daily at sea.
Heavy weather raporu sonrası lashing kon: After a heavy weather report, the lashing check is repeated.
Yedek twist-lock ile değiştir, arızalıyı: Replace with a spare twistlock; send the faulty one for servicing.
Locknut/wire ile emniyete al, periyodik: Secure with a locknut/wire; retighten periodically.
Lashing operasyonu sırasında baret, eldi: A hard hat, gloves and safety shoes are mandatory during lashing operations.
Yüksek seviyelere lashing eldiveni ile m: For the upper tiers, a mast climber/cherry picker must be used (with lashing gloves).
Aşırı sıkmaktan kaçın; turnbuckle thread: Avoid over-tightening; the turnbuckle thread will be damaged.
Heavy weather durumunda güverteye lashin: In heavy weather, going on deck to check lashings may be prohibited.
Plug bağlantısı yapıldığında container i: When the plug is connected, the PLC inside the container runs the compressor to bring the temperature to the set value.
Soğutucu gaz (R-134a, R-404A vb.) kompre: The refrigerant (R-134a, R-404A, etc.) is compressed in the compressor → condensed by outside air in the condenser → the pressure drops at the expansion valve → it cools the air inside the container in the evaporator.
Defrost cycle (otomatik) periyodik olara: The (automatic) defrost cycle periodically melts the ice on the evaporator.
RMS, alarmları gemi şebekesine ethernet/: The RMS transmits alarms to the ship's network via Ethernet/PLC.
Container'ı plug'a takmadan önce socket: Before plugging in the container, check the socket by measuring its voltage.
Set sıcaklık, vent ve hava değişim oranı: Set the temperature, vent and air exchange rate according to the manifest.
Günlük RMS kontrolü yap; alarm varsa yed: Check the RMS daily; if there is an alarm, connect to a spare socket.
Boşaltımdan önce sıcaklık logu çıktısını: Print out the temperature log before discharge.
Reset the fuse; test the cable.
Kondenseri temizle, gaz şarjını kontrol: Clean the condenser; check the gas charge.
Test the heater; check the control board.
Toplam yük jeneratör kapasitesini aştı: Total load exceeded the generator capacity
Reefer'leri kademeli devreye al, PMS lim: Connect the reefers gradually; set the PMS limit.
Plug ve cable bağlantısı yapılırken eldi: Gloves and insulating footwear must be used when connecting plugs and cables.
IMDG sınıfı tehlikeli yük varsa reefer'l: If there are IMDG-class dangerous goods, the reefers must be distributed according to the segregation rules.
Yangın riski: reefer plug yangınları sık: Fire risk: reefer plug fires are common; the temperature of the fuse panels must be monitored.
RMS kayıtları konişmento (BL) için kanıt: RMS records are evidence for the bill of lading (B/L) and must be kept.
HPU hidrolik silindirleri besler; ramp m: The HPU supplies the hydraulic cylinders; the ramp opens on its hinges.
Locking pinler kapalı pozisyonda otomati: The locking pins lock automatically or manually in the closed position.
Weathertight gasket coaming üzerinde sız: The weathertight gasket on the coaming provides tightness.
Inclination ve closure switch sinyali br: The inclination and closure switch signals go to the bridge alarm system.
Açmadan önce trim/list kontrol et, ramp: Before opening, check the trim/list; the ramp end must land on the quay.
Kilitleri açıp HPU'yu devreye al; ramp'ı: Open the locks and start the HPU; lower the ramp slowly.
Yükleme sonrası ramp'ı kaldır, kilitle v: After loading, raise the ramp, lock it and check the tightness.
Closure indicator'ın 'closed' sinyali br: The 'closed' signal of the closure indicator must be shown on the bridge.
Denizde fırtınada ramp ekstra securing p: At sea in a storm, the ramp is secured with extra securing pins/wires.
HPU basıncı yok, kilit takılı, kontrol v: No HPU pressure, lock engaged, control valve faulty
HPU ve kilitleri kontrol et, valfi devre: Check the HPU and locks; try moving it manually with the valve bypassed.
Switch arızalı, kapak tam oturmamış: Switch faulty, door not fully seated
Test the switch; close the door again.
Renew the gasket; tighten the locks.
Ramp altında personel/araç bulunduğunda: Movement is prohibited while there are persons/vehicles under the ramp.
Bow ramp/visor weathertight integrity'si: The weathertight integrity of the bow ramp/visor must always be verified before proceeding to sea.
Trim ve list ramp eğiminden ±2° aşmamalı: Trim and list must not exceed the ramp slope by more than ±2°.
Yıllık class survey kapsamında ramp yapı: A structural inspection of the ramp must be carried out as part of the annual class survey.
Hidrolik motor → ana tambur (hoist) → wi: Flow: hydraulic motor → main drum (hoist) → wire rope → block → hook.
Slewing (dönüş) hidrolik veya elektrik m: Slewing is provided by a hydraulic or electric motor and gearing.
Luffing silindiri bom açısını değiştirir: The luffing cylinder changes the jib angle (the SWL varies with the jib angle).
Limit switch'ler aşırı yük, aşırı yüksel: Limit switches provide protection against overload, overhoisting and end positions.
Vinci çalıştırmadan önce yağ seviyesi, t: Before operating the crane, check the oil level, the wire rope and the hook safety catch.
Yük ağırlığını SWL × açı tablosundan doğ: Verify the load weight against the SWL × angle table.
Slewing sırasında ani durdurmadan kaçın;: Avoid sudden stops while slewing; this prevents the load from swinging.
Tag line (rehber halat) ile yük dönüşü k: The turning of the load is controlled with a tag line.
Operasyon bitince bom kavrama bracket'in: When the operation is finished, the jib is placed in its cradle.
Hidrolik basınç düşük, valf bobin arızas: Low hydraulic pressure, valve coil fault
Pompa basıncını kontrol et, bobini değiş: Check the pump pressure; replace the coil.
Slewing bearing yağı kontrol, gerektiğin: Check the slewing bearing grease; renew it when necessary.
Halatı segment olarak inceleme, kriter a: Inspect the rope section by section; replace it if the criteria are exceeded.
Limit switch ayarı, mekanik mafsal kontr: Adjust the limit switch; check the mechanical linkage.
Yük altında veya salınım yörüngesinde pe: No personnel may be under the load or in its swinging path.
Wind, list/trim ve sea-state stop limitl: Apply the wind, list/trim and sea-state stop limits from the approved load chart/operating manual; a fixed 15 m/s and 5° is not a safe limit for all cranes/configurations.
Wire rope'u maker/ISO discard criteria i: Assess the wire rope visually and by measurement against the maker/ISO discard criteria; do not write classic MPI/UT for the rope as a routine habit, and lubricate according to the rope construction and the PMS.
Sertifikalı operatör + sinyalist ile çal: Work with a certified operator + signaller; hand signals must be standardised.
Yıkama makinesi yüksek basınçlı suyu tan: The washing machine sprays high-pressure water onto the tank walls.
Yıkama suyu tank dibinde toplanır; educt: The washing water collects at the bottom of the tank; the eductor draws it by the venturi effect and pumps it to the slop tank.
Slop ayrışma süresi sıcaklık, emülsiyon: The slop settling time is set by the temperature, emulsion and interface measurement; waiting a fixed 24 hours does not on its own prove the discharge quality.
Üstteki yağ tabakası bir sonraki yüke ka: The upper oil layer is mixed with the next cargo (load on top, LOT); the lower water is discharged under control with the ODME.
Yıkama programını cargo planına göre haz: Prepare the washing programme according to the cargo plan (hot/cold, chemicals, etc.).
İnertlenen tankta tank atmosferini ≤%8 O: In an inerted tank, keep the tank atmosphere at ≤8% O₂ and at positive pressure; monitor the ≤5% O₂ limit for the supply gas separately.
Yıkama makinesini approved cycle/program: Run the washing machine according to the approved cycle/programme, shadow diagram and coating/cargo restrictions; do not use an arbitrary 90° position.
Slop interface ve sample'ı doğrula; yaln: Verify the slop interface and sample; start a controlled discharge only if MARPOL Annex I Reg. 34, the ODME operational manual and the discharge criteria are fully met.
