Tank gas free yapılmadan girişe izin ver: Do not allow entry until the tank is gas-free; issue a permit to enter.
Driving water basıncı düşük, nozül tıkal: Low driving water pressure, nozzle blocked
Check the pump pressure; dismantle and clean the nozzle.
Dismantle for maintenance; replace the bearing.
Filtre temizliği, sensör kalibrasyon ve: Clean the filter; calibrate and test the sensor.
Tank içi giriş Enclosed Space Entry perm: Entry into a tank is made with an Enclosed Space Entry permit and the gas test results must be satisfactory.
Settling time, portable conductive/non-c: Verify the settling time, the use of portable conductive/non-conductive equipment and the water-mist/static precaution times from ISGOTT, the cargo SDS and the approved tank-cleaning procedure; a fixed 30 minutes is not sufficient for all operations.
ODME logu Oil Record Book'a işlenir; PSC: The ODME log is entered in the Oil Record Book; it is asked for in PSC inspections.
Sıcak yıkamada personel yanık önlemi (PP: During hot washing, personnel must take precautions against burns (PPE).
Ballast in: deniz suyu pompası → filtre: Ballasting: seawater pump → filter (40 µm) → UV reactor or EC unit → ballast tank.
Ballast out: tank → bypass filtre → UV (: Deballasting: tank → bypass filter → UV (again if required) → neutralisation (for EC) → overboard.
UV reaktörde lambalar yüksek yoğunluklu: In the UV reactor, the lamps produce high-intensity UV-C; a sensor monitors the intensity and transmittance.
EC ünitesinde elektrotlar deniz suyunu e: In the EC unit, electrodes electrolyse seawater; the TRO (Total Residual Oxidant) produced is kept at 2–10 mg/L.
Operasyon öncesi BWMS'i hazırla, lamba ı: Before the operation, prepare the BWMS and wait for the lamp warm-up time (UV systems).
Pompa başlat, akış BWMS rated capacity a: Start the pump; the flow must be kept below the BWMS rated capacity.
TRO/UV intensity sensörlerini izle; alar: Monitor the TRO/UV intensity sensors; in case of an alarm, do not switch to bypass mode — stop the operation.
Deballast sonunda nötralizasyon ünitesin: At the end of deballasting, run the neutralisation unit (EC systems) and verify that the overboard TRO is < 0.1 mg/L.
BWRB'a tarih, koordinat, hacim, yapılan: Enter the date, position, volume, operation carried out and system status in the BWRB.
Lamba ömrü dolmuş, kuvars kılıf kirli: Lamp life expired, quartz sleeve dirty
Lambaları değiştir, kuvars kılıfları tem: Replace the lamps; clean the quartz sleeves (acid wash).
Otomatik backflush devrede mi kontrol et: Check that the automatic backflush is working; clean manually.
Tuzluluk ölç, asit yıkama yap, elektrot: Measure the salinity, carry out an acid wash, check the electrodes.
Sistem bypass moduna geçti: System has switched to bypass mode
Operasyonu durdur, PSC bildirim ve servi: Stop the operation, notify PSC and call for service.
UV lambalarına çıplak gözle bakma (göz h: Do not look at UV lamps with the naked eye (eye damage); the lamps must be de-energised during maintenance.
EC ünitesinde hidrojen birikimi olabilir: Hydrogen may build up in the EC unit; the ventilation must always be working (explosion risk).
Kimyasal nötralizasyon ürünleri (sodyum: Chemical neutralisation products (sodium thiosulphate) must be stored according to the MSDS.
Sistem arızasında 'Contingency Measure': In the event of a system failure, the 'contingency measures' procedure (notification of the port State, alternative port) is applied.
Chiller kompresörü gaz sıkıştırır → kond: The chiller compressor compresses the gas → the condenser is cooled by seawater (liquid) → expansion valve → evaporator (cools the chilled water).
Chilled water pompa ile AHU coil'lerine: The chilled water is pumped to the AHU coils; the coils cool the air flow and reduce its humidity.
AHU fanı şartlandırılmış havayı kanallar: The AHU fan delivers the conditioned air into the ducts; diffusers distribute it in the spaces.
Termostat oda sıcaklığını okur; chilled: The thermostat reads the room temperature and modulates the chilled water valve or damper.
Sezon başında chiller'ı start et; oil he: At the start of the season, start the chiller; switch on the oil heater 24 hours beforehand (compressor protection).
Deniz suyu hattı pump filter temizliği y: Clean the seawater line pump filter.
Chilled water pompa ve expansion tank se: Check the chilled water pump and the expansion tank level.
Filtreleri 1–3 ayda bir temizle/değiştir: Clean/replace the filters every 1–3 months; a blocked filter overloads the fan motor.
Yıllık leak test, oil analizi ve refrako: Annual leak test, oil analysis and glycol check with a refractometer.
Filtre tıkalı, gaz kaçağı, valf kapalı: Filter blocked, gas leak, valve closed
Check the filter and gas charge; test the valve.
SW pompa, strainer kontrol; kondenser as: Check the SW pump and strainer; acid-wash the condenser.
Gaz kaçağı, expansion valf arızalı, evap: Gas leak, expansion valve faulty, evaporator dirty
Sızdırmazlık testi, valf bakım, evap tem: Leak test, valve maintenance, evaporator cleaning.
Clean the drain pan; repair the insulation.
Soğutucu gaz sızıntısında ortam ventile: In the event of a refrigerant leak, the space must be ventilated; high concentrations cause asphyxiation.
Chiller machinery space gaz dedektörüyle: The chiller machinery space must be protected by a gas detector (for R134a).
Bakım sırasında sistem boşaltma için 're: Use a recovery unit to empty the system during maintenance; the gas must not be released to the atmosphere.
Provision room'a giren personel için içe: For personnel entering a provision room, the door-opening handle on the inside must always work.
Pompa FWT'den suyu alır, basınç tankına: The pump takes water from the FWT and delivers it to the pressure tank; the air cushion is compressed and stores energy.
Musluklar açıldığında basınç tankından s: When taps are opened, water flows from the pressure tank and the pressure falls.
Stop basıncının (örn. 3 bar) altına düşü: When the pressure falls below the cut-in pressure (e.g. 3 bar), the pressure switch starts the pump; when it reaches the upper pressure (e.g. 5 bar), it stops it.
UV sterilizator akış sırasında suyu ster: The UV steriliser sterilises the water as it flows.
FWT seviyesini günlük kontrol et; hidrof: Check the FWT level daily; the hydrophore pump must not run dry (the mechanical seal will burn).
Basınç tankı ön havasını ayda bir kontro: Check the pressure tank pre-charge air once a month (with a pressure gauge, water side empty).
Klor dozaj veya UV lambasını çalışır tut: Keep the chlorine dosing or UV lamp working.
Pompa start/stop sıklığını izle; >6/dk i: Monitor the pump start/stop frequency; if it is >6 per minute, the tank pre-charge is low.
Pressure tank ön havası boş, kaçak var,: Pressure tank pre-charge empty, leak, pressure switch out of adjustment
Tank havası şarj, hat sızdırmazlık, pres: Recharge the tank air, check the lines for leaks, adjust the pressure switch.
Musluktan kesik kesik su: Intermittent water flow from the tap
Hava emiyor, basınç tankı membranı yırtı: Drawing air, pressure tank membrane torn
Check the suction line; replace the membrane.
Calorifier rezistansı bozuk, termostat a: Calorifier heating element defective, thermostat faulty
Test the heating element; replace the thermostat.
Tank kirli, klor düşük, UV bozuk: Tank dirty, low chlorine, UV defective
Tank temizlik, klor şoku, UV lamba değiş: Clean the tank, shock-chlorinate, replace the UV lamp.
Tank inspeksiyonu enclosed space entry p: Tank inspection with an enclosed space entry permit and a gas (O₂) test.
Pres tank şarj havası kompresörden alınm: The pressure tank charge air must not be taken from the compressor (oil contamination); use pure N₂ or clean air.
FWT giriş hatlarında non-return valve sa: The non-return valves on the FWT inlet lines must be sound (risk of contamination).
Calorifier elektrik rezistansı kuruda en: The calorifier electric heating element must not be energised when dry (it will burn out).
Kompresör atmosferden hava çeker, 1. kad: The compressor draws air from the atmosphere, compresses it to 5–7 bar in the 1st stage and cools it in the intercooler.
2. kademede 30 bara çıkarılır, aftercool: In the 2nd stage it is raised to 30 bar, cooled in the aftercooler and the moisture separated.
Receiver'a basılır; tank dolduğunda unlo: It is delivered to the receiver; when the receiver is full the unloader operates or the compressor stops.
Dryer adsorpsiyon (silica gel) veya refr: The dryer removes water by adsorption (silica gel) or refrigeration.
Kompresör start öncesi yağ seviyesi, soğ: Before starting the compressor, check the oil level, cooling water and drains.
Otomatik mod: receiver tank basıncı düşt: Automatic mode: automatic start when the receiver pressure falls.
Drain'leri condensate yükü, auto-drain i: Check the drains according to the condensate load, the auto-drain function and the PMS/watch routine; lead oily condensate to a suitable collection system.
Start air valfi izolasyonu kontrol et; k: Check the isolation of the starting air valve; an accidental start may occur.
Inter/aftercooler temizliğini pressure d: Plan the cleaning of the inter/aftercoolers according to pressure drop, temperature approach, leak tests and the PMS condition trend.
Suction filter tıkalı, kafa contası, kap: Suction filter blocked, cylinder head gasket, broken valve plate
Filter, remove the head, valve maintenance.
Soğutma suyu yok, kondenser kirli, inter: No cooling water, condenser dirty, intercooler blocked
Emniyet valfi sızdırıyor, drain valfi aç: Safety valve leaking, drain valve open, line leak
Reseat the valve; leak-test the line.
Replace the desiccant; check the regeneration heater.
Receiver tank üzerinde safety valve mutl: The safety valve on the receiver must always work; manual tests are carried out regularly.
Yüksek basınç hattında çatlak/sızıntıya: When approaching a crack/leak in a high-pressure line, do not expose your body (a high-velocity jet cuts).
Bakım öncesi tank tamamen depressurize e: Before maintenance, the receiver must be completely depressurised and isolation and lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) applied.
Yağlı kompresörde aşırı yağ taşkını patl: In an oil-lubricated compressor, excessive oil carry-over creates a risk of explosion; check the oil filter and separator regularly.
Yakıtlı kazanda brulor su yüzeyini ısıtı: In an oil-fired boiler, the burner heats the water; the water evaporates and dry steam is taken from the top.
Buhar kollektörden tüketicilere dağıtılı: Steam is distributed from the header to the consumers; it condenses as it gives up heat at the point of use.
Kondens steam trap üzerinden kondens hat: The condensate passes through a steam trap into the condensate line and returns to the hot well.
Feed water pompası hot well'den kazana b: The feed water pump delivers from the hot well to the boiler; the level controller keeps the drum level constant.
Kazanı çalıştırmadan önce su seviyesi (g: Before firing the boiler, check the water level (gauge glass) and test the safety valve.
Brulor yakıt valfini yavaş aç; alev tutu: Open the burner fuel valve slowly; check the ignition of the flame (flame eye).
Drum basıncı yükselirken çıkış valfini k: As the drum pressure rises, open the outlet valve gradually (to prevent thermal shock).
Operasyon sırasında pH, klorür, fosfat,: During operation, pH, chloride, phosphate and salinity tests are carried out daily.
Blow-down: kazan suyundaki çamur ve tuzu: Blowdown: surface and bottom blowdown to remove sludge and salts from the boiler water.
Yakıt soğuk, ignition arızası, fotosel k: Fuel cold, ignition fault, photocell dirty
HFO ısıt, ignition kontrol, fotosel temi: Heat the HFO, check the ignition, clean the photocell.
Kazan suyu kirli, yüksek TDS, alkalinity: Boiler water dirty, high TDS, high alkalinity
Blow down; check the chemical dosing.
Steam trap takılı kalmış, kondens hattın: Steam trap stuck, leak in the condensate line
Test the trap; leak-test the line.
Soot birikimi, düşük yük, alkali yakıt: Soot build-up, low load, alkaline fuel
Soot blow düzenli yap, yangın halinde st: Carry out soot blowing regularly; in a fire, use steam smothering or CO₂.
Buhar hattı çalıştırılırken yavaş ısıtıl: A steam line must be warmed up slowly when put into service; opening it suddenly causes water hammer (it can burst the pipe).
Safety valve manuel test düzenli yapılır: The safety valve is tested manually at regular intervals; a blocked safety valve is a disaster.
Sıcak yüzey yanığı için hatlar izole edi: Lines must be insulated against burns from hot surfaces; contact with bare hands is prohibited.
Boş çalışan kazan (low water) overheatin: A boiler running without water (low water) carries a risk of overheating and explosion; the level alarms must be kept sensitive.
Tehlike çağrısı DSC ile (kim, nerede, ne: A distress alert is sent automatically by DSC (who, where, what kind of distress) with a single button.
Sahil istasyonu / yakın gemiler DSC alar: Coast stations / nearby ships are alerted by the DSC alarm and receive the details on the voice channel.
MSI (NAVTEX, SafetyNET) otomatik olarak: MSI (NAVTEX, SafetyNET) automatically prints weather reports, NAVAREA warnings and SAR broadcasts.
EPIRB ve SART'ın aktivasyonu uydu/Radar: Activation of the EPIRB and SART directs search and rescue units by satellite/radar.
Vardiya başında battery, antenler, lamba: At the start of the watch, check the batteries, antennas, lamps and printer paper.
Günlük DSC self-test (test çağrısı sahil: Daily DSC self-test (an internal test, not a test call to the shore).
Live DSC test çağrısını Radio Log proced: Make a live DSC test call according to the Radio Log procedure, coast-station availability, flag guidance and the maker's instructions; if there is no coverage/acknowledgement, record the failed attempt and its cause — do not use a distress alert.
Aylık EPIRB self-test, SART self-test, b: Monthly EPIRB self-test, SART self-test, battery expiry check.
Radio log'a tüm test ve tehlike trafiği: All tests and distress traffic are recorded in the radio log.
GPS feed yok, MMSI girilmemiş, anten arı: No GPS feed, MMSI not entered, antenna fault
GPS bağlantı, MMSI kontrol, antenna VSWR: Check the GPS connection and the MMSI; measure the antenna VSWR.
Anten kopuk, kanal seçimi yanlış (518 kH: Antenna broken, wrong channel selection (518 kHz English), squelch too high
Antenna ve preamp test, frekans/lang aya: Test the antenna and preamplifier; set the frequency/language.
Şarj devresi arızalı, battery ömrü dolmu: Charging circuit faulty, battery life expired
Charger ölçüm, battery load test, gereki: Measure the charger, load-test the battery, replace if necessary.
Tehlike butonuna kazara basılırsa hemen: If the distress button is pressed by accident, a voice cancellation message is sent to the coast station immediately (DSC cancel).
EPIRB hidrostatik release ünitesi (HRU): The expiry date of the EPIRB hydrostatic release unit (HRU) must not have passed.
Telsiz odasında reserve power source ve: In the radio room, the reserve source of power and the batteries must be kept charged at all times.
Radyo arıza günlüğü ve onarım kayıtları: The radio fault log and repair records are requested in PSC inspections.
DSC çağrısı: sender MMSI, alıcı MMSI/all: DSC call: sender MMSI, recipient MMSI/all ships, category (distress/urgency/safety/routine), position, nature.
VHF DSC distress alert acknowledgement a: If no acknowledgement of a VHF DSC distress alert is received, the equipment may automatically repeat the attempt after about 3.5–4.5 minutes; this must not be confused with the 'five consecutive transmissions' of MF/HF formats, and the maker's display must be watched.
Distress alert sonrasında telsiz Ch 16'y: After a distress alert, the radio switches automatically to Ch 16 and a voice MAYDAY is expected.
Check power on, GPS feed and self-test.
Ch 16 ve Ch 70 daima açık (silent watch): Ch 16 and Ch 70 always on (listening watch).
Çağrı için uygun channel/power seç, dinl: For a call, select a suitable channel/power, listen, press the PTT and speak briefly using SMCP/radio procedure; do not keep the carrier on unnecessarily.
Distress için nature/position/time otoma: For distress, check the automatic/manual nature/position/time data and hold the protected DISTRESS button pressed for the time marked on the equipment.
Test çağrısını gemi planı ve coast-stati: Make the test call according to the ship's plan and the coast station's instructions; enter the acknowledgement/failure result in the Radio Log.
Test the settings; replace the loudspeaker.
Anten/connection korozyon, başka cihaz i: Antenna/connection corrosion, interference from other equipment
Anten konnektör temizlik, EMI kaynak izo: Clean the antenna connector; isolate the EMI source.
MMSI yok, GPS feed yok, Ch 70 başka ciha: No MMSI, no GPS feed, Ch 70 in use by another unit
Set the MMSI, connect the GPS, resolve the conflict.
Ch 16 must be monitored continuously (listening watch).
Yanlış DSC çağrısı: hemen Ch 16'da sesli: False DSC alert: immediately broadcast a voice cancellation on Ch 16 and record it in the log.
Anten/feedline sağlığını forward/reflect: Trend the antenna/feeder health with forward/reflected power or the maker's BIT; take the VSWR alarm and acceptance value from the manufacturer's manual; do not take unauthorised measurements on a live antenna line.
Frekans seçilir, ATU ground plane ile an: The frequency is selected; the ATU tunes the antenna to 50 Ω with the ground plane.
DSC modülü tehlike çağrısını dijital ola: The DSC module modulates the distress alert digitally (FSK).
Sahil veya gemi DSC alarmı ile uyarılır;: The shore or a ship is alerted by the DSC alarm; the MAYDAY is received on the voice channel.
NBDP mod: ARQ (otomatik tekrar isteği) i: NBDP mode: error-free telex exchange with ARQ (automatic repeat request).
Gemi pozisyonuna göre uygun band seç (ya: Select a suitable band according to the ship's position (MF for near, HF for far).
Self-test ve live DSC testini Radio Log: Carry out the self-test and the live DSC test according to the Radio Log procedure/maker's instructions; record coast-station availability and the acknowledgement received.
Distress: nature, position/time ve uygun: Distress: select the nature, position/time and the appropriate attempt; press the protected distress button for the time marked on the equipment and watch the DSC/voice follow-up display.
Ack alındıktan sonra voice frekansa geç: After the acknowledgement is received, change to the voice frequency and give the details.
Anten kopuk, ground bağlantısı zayıf, AT: Antenna broken, poor ground connection, ATU fault
Anten süreklilik, ground bond temizlik,: Check antenna continuity, clean the ground bond, service the ATU.
Final amplifier zayıflamış, anten verim: Final amplifier weakened, low antenna efficiency
Test the PA; measure the antenna VSWR.
Renew the paper; clean the mechanism.
Yüksek voltajlı PA modülü; servis sırası: High-voltage PA module; capacitors must be discharged during servicing.
Anten yakın çalışan personel için RF rad: RF radiation risk for personnel working near the antenna; keep clear during transmission.
Frekans çakışmasını önlemek için ITU pla: The ITU plan must be followed to avoid frequency conflicts.
GPS pozisyonu otomatik enjekte; mesajla: The GPS position is injected automatically and sent with the message.
Store-and-forward: gemi LES'e iletir, LE: Store-and-forward: the ship sends to the LES, the LES forwards to the recipient; it is not real-time.
Distress: tek tuş ile RCC'ye iletilir, a: Distress: sent to the RCC with a single button; an acknowledgement is received.
Login durumu ve LES seçimi günlük kontro: Check the log-in status and the LES selection daily.
EGC mesajları printer çıktısı veya scree: EGC messages are printed or logged on screen; check them every watch.
Position report otomatik; manuel test ay: Position reports are automatic; manual test once a month.
Distress test: gemi VHF'inden RCC'ye tel: Distress test: a live test is possible after informing the RCC (via the ship's VHF or by telephone).
Login yok, LES dışında, anten obstructio: Not logged in, outside the LES area, antenna obstruction
Login yap, LES seç, anten önündeki obstr: Log in, select the LES, remove the obstruction in front of the antenna.
Renew the consumables; test the port.
Test the GPS; check the cable.
Mesaj iletim ücretli; uzun mesaj LES tar: Message transmission is charged; long messages may be expensive at the LES tariff.
EGC/MSI reception seçimini seyredilen NA: Set the EGC/MSI reception for the NAVAREA/METAREA and coastal warning areas being navigated; do not use settings that suppress mandatory distress/urgency and relevant area messages.
Antenna 360° serbest açıya sahip olmalı;: The antenna must have a clear 360° view; do not mount it behind a mast or funnel.
Su ile temas → switch kapanır → 50 sn iç: Contact with water → the switch closes → within 50 s the 406 MHz alert + 121.5 MHz homing transmission starts.
Cospas-Sarsat uyduları (LEO + GEO + MEO): Cospas-Sarsat satellites (LEO + GEO + MEO) receive the signal and pass it to the RCC.
RCC gemi sahibini ve son pozisyonu doğru: The RCC verifies the ship's owner and last position and activates SAR.
Aylık görsel inspeksiyon: bracket sağlam: Monthly visual inspection: bracket sound, expiry date checked, HRU sound.
Self-test'i maker'ın izin verdiği test p: Carry out the self-test within the test window/duration permitted by the maker; do not drain the battery by repeating the GNSS self-test unnecessarily, and record the displayed result.
Yıllık servis: yetkili tarafından batter: Annual service: battery, GPS and transmit power tested by an authorised person.
Gemi terk durumunda: bracket'tan al, su: When abandoning ship: take it from the bracket and throw it into the water, or activate it with the manual switch.
Send it for servicing; replace if necessary.
Suya düşmüş, manuel butona basılmış: Fallen into the water, manual button pressed
EPIRB'i çıkar, kapat (manuel switch off): Retrieve the EPIRB, switch it off (manual switch off), and report the cancellation to the RCC by telephone.
Yanlış alarm SAR kaynaklarını bağlar; te: A false alert ties up SAR resources; apply the test button/duration from the instructions on the beacon, and if there is a real activation, switch the beacon off and report the cancellation to the RCC at once with the identity/position.
EPIRB'i seyir köprüsünün dışına, suyun u: Mount the EPIRB outside the wheelhouse, where water can reach it (the HRU must work when abandoning ship).
Do not paint around the bracket (the HRU will jam).
Radar pulse SART'a ulaştığında SART aynı: When a radar pulse reaches the SART, the SART transmits a 12-pulse reply on the same frequency.
Yanıt PRF artarken tek noktaya, azalırke: The reply appears as a line of 12 dots extending outward from the SART position; as the ship approaches (about 1 NM) the dots become arcs, and at very close range concentric circles.
AIS-SART aynı şekilde GPS pozisyonu ile: An AIS-SART similarly transmits periodic AIS messages with its GPS position.
Aylık görsel: bracket, switch, expiry ko: Monthly visual check: bracket, switch, expiry.
Aylık self-test: butona bas, LED + sesli: Monthly self-test: press the button; LED + audible alarm → OK.
Aktivasyon: switch açılır, 9 GHz pulse a: Activation: the switch is turned on; it replies when it detects a 9 GHz pulse.
Yüksek bir yere asılır (lifeboat tepe ve: It is hoisted high (on top of the lifeboat or on the mast inside the liferaft).
Radar ekranında görünmüyor: Not visible on the radar screen
Çok alçak monte, 3 GHz radar kullanımı,: Mounted too low, use of a 3 GHz radar, SART not activated
Yüksek monte, X-band radar, switch kontr: Mount it high, use an X-band radar, check the switch.
Self-test'i yalnız maker işaretli süre/m: Carry out the self-test only for the time/in the mode marked by the maker; the Radar SART reply may be seen on nearby X-band displays, and the AIS-SART test message on AIS units.
Yanlış aktivasyonda hemen kapat, RCC'ye: In the event of a false activation, switch it off at once and report the cancellation to the RCC.
Test sırasında diğer geminin radar ekran: During a test, the SART may appear on another ship's radar screen; a warning is given.
Reset interval boyunca nöbetçinin reset: During the reset interval, the watchkeeper is expected to reset (manual button or motion sensor).
Reset alınmazsa bridge visual → bridge a: If no reset is received, the sequence bridge visual → bridge audible → remote second/third stage proceeds with the MSC.128(75) timing.
Gemi ECDIS, AIS gibi sistemlerden bilgi: It does not take information from the ship's ECDIS, AIS or similar systems; it works independently.
Vardiya başında BNWAS aktif olduğunu doğ: At the start of the watch, verify that the BNWAS is active.
Dormancy interval'i Master'ın protected: Verify the dormancy interval against the Master's protected setting and standing orders; do not go outside the 3–12 minute approval range.
Underway durumunda approved operational: When under way, verify on the panel and the alarm inhibit indicator that the approved operational mode is really active.
PMS testinde dormancy, bridge visual/aud: In the PMS test, verify with timing the dormancy, bridge visual/audible alarms, remote call locations, reset points and the power-failure alarm.
Hoparlör arıza, kablo bağlantı, ayar yan: Loudspeaker fault, cable connection, wrong setting
Test the loudspeaker, check the line, correct the setting.
Reset switch arızalı, motion sensor takı: Reset switch faulty, motion sensor stuck
Test the switch; clean/replace the sensor.
BNWAS'ı kalıcı devre dışı bırakmak SOLAS: Permanently disabling the BNWAS is a SOLAS violation; a serious PSC deficiency.
Reset için sahte düzenek (bantlı buton v: Fake reset devices (taped buttons, etc.) are prohibited.
Remote alarm location/sequence'i onaylı: Verify the remote alarm locations/sequence from the approved BNWAS plan; inform the Master, the bridge team and the crew affected before the test.
Tüm veri kaynakları VDR concentrator uni: All data sources are connected to the VDR concentrator unit.
Concentrator dahili memory'ye sürekli ya: The concentrator writes continuously to its internal memory (FIFO).
Kayıt aynı anda long-term medium ile ins: The recording is written at the same time to the long-term medium and the installed fixed/float-free capsule for the retention period in the performance standard.
Kazada save butonu basılırsa tüm memory: If the save button is pressed after an accident, the whole memory becomes write-protected.
Power, recording, source-fault ve UTC st: Check the power, recording, source-fault and UTC status in the maker/PMS routine; do not reset a fault and lose it.
Audio/source testini maker test mode ve: Carry out the audio/source test according to the maker's test mode and the APT/PMS, without disturbing the real bridge recording.
Capsule/locating device kontrolünü APT k: Check the capsule/locating device according to the APT scope, expiry and service instructions.
Kaza/olay sonrası Master/SMS talimatıyla: After an accident/incident, use the save/protect function on the Master's/SMS instruction; do not switch the equipment off arbitrarily, and preserve the data chain of custody.
Kablo, mikrofon arızası, audio level düş: Cable, microphone fault, low audio level
Test the microphone, check the cable, adjust.
Test the grabber; replace the cable.
VDR memory'ye doğrudan müdahale yasak; y: Direct interference with the VDR memory is prohibited; unauthorised personnel must not delete data.
Olay sonrası preservation, indirme ve te: After an incident, record the preservation, download and handover in accordance with company emergency/authority instructions; manage the risk of altering or overwriting the data without delay.
Capsule çevresini erişilebilir tut ve fi: Keep the area around the capsule accessible and verify its physical survival rating from its own type approval/marking; do not copy a single temperature/depth value from the internet.
Davit gravity tipi: brake bırakılır, dav: Gravity davit type: the brake is released, the davit swings out by gravity and the boat is lowered under control on the winch wire.
Free-fall: release handle çekilir, lifeb: Free-fall: the release handle is pulled and the lifeboat slides down the ramp into the water; it dives bow first on entry, then rises to the surface.
Release gear, normal tahliyede tekne wat: In a normal evacuation, the release gear is used for off-load release when the boat is waterborne and the falls are unloaded; the on-load capability is for emergencies/special cases, and misuse can be fatal.
Hydrostatic interlock, hook reset indica: The hydrostatic interlock, hook reset indicator and operating handle form a single safety chain; the reset/locked condition is verified physically on each hook according to the maker's instructions.
Embarkation: launch alarm → muster stati: Embarkation: launch alarm → muster station → the person in charge of the lifeboat manages boarding.
Davit/winch'i assigned operator ve coxsw: Operate the davit/winch within the chain of command of the assigned operator and coxswain; do not release the brake until the gripes, plug, painter, falls and lowering area checklist has been completed.
Tekne waterborne, falls unloaded ve hydr: Apply the approved off-load release procedure after verifying that the boat is waterborne, the falls are unloaded and the status of the hydrostatic interlock; cross-check the hook reset on both sides before recovery.
Free-fall launch'ta tüm kişiler numaralı: For a free-fall launch, everyone sits in a numbered seat in the maker-approved restraint/head support position; simulated/actual launches are made only under the approved drill procedure.
Fren balata aşınmış, ayar bozuk: Brake lining worn, out of adjustment
Replace the lining; adjust the brake.
Yağlama, sheave hizası, deniz suyu veya: Lubrication, sheave alignment, seawater or fatigue
Tekneyi kullanımdan çıkar; SOLAS III/20,: Take the boat out of service; inspect/renew the falls according to SOLAS III/20, the maker's discard criteria and the approved maintenance plan; do not apply a wrong practice such as 'turn end-for-end every 5 years'.
Battery zayıf, yakıt eski/su girmiş: Weak battery, old fuel/water in the fuel
Charge the battery; drain and renew the fuel.
Maintain the hooks; test the hydrostatic mechanism.
Drill/bakım sırasında secondary safety d: During drills/maintenance, use the secondary safety device or fall prevention arrangement only as described in the maker's and MSC.402 procedures; do not interfere with a hook under live load.
Free-fall release sırasında baş ve boyun: During a free-fall release, the head and neck must be supported against the backrest; the PFD must be worn.
Davit altındaki bölgede personel olmasın: No personnel may be in the area under the davit (risk of falling if there is no limit switch).
Yağlama düzenli; korozyon ve sıkışma kaz: Lubricate regularly; corrosion and seizure lead to accidents.
Manuel: painter line gemiden serbest bır: Manual: the painter is secured to the ship, the raft is thrown overboard, and when the painter is pulled hard the CO₂ valve opens → the raft inflates.
Otomatik (HRU): su basıncı HRU'yu çalışt: Automatic (HRU): water pressure operates the HRU and releases the lashing; the container floats, the painter attached to the ship tightens and triggers inflation, and if the ship continues to sink the weak link breaks and frees the inflated raft from the ship.
Inflation/orientation süresi çevre ve ty: The inflation/orientation time depends on the environment and the type approval; if the raft inflates upside down, the marked righting strap/procedure is used.
Aylık görsel: canister sağlam, painter b: Monthly visual check: canister sound, painter attached, HRU expiry, lashing bracket sound.
Yıllık servis: yetkili istasyona gönder,: Annual service: send it to an authorised station and obtain a certificate.
Drill'de manuel atış simülasyonu (gerçek: In drills, simulate a manual launch (not a real deployment — it is expensive).
Manual launch'ta painter'ın gemiye doğru: In a manual launch, verify that the painter is attached to a strong point on the ship, throw the container clear of obstructions and pull the painter until the firing lanyard operates; if possible, board dry by the embarkation ladder/davit, and treat jumping into the sea as a last resort.
Liferaft konteyneri etrafında istif/eşya: No stowage/objects may be around the liferaft container; it must float free if the ship sinks.
HRU 'weak link' painter ile gemi arasınd: The HRU weak link is between the painter and the ship; when the ship sinks, the painter is pulled, the raft inflates and the weak link breaks (the raft is freed).
Pyrotechnic expiry tarihini item label/s: Track the pyrotechnic expiry date from the item label/service certificate; do not assume a fixed 5 years, and hand expired items over to the approved shore disposal chain.
Liferaft yıllık servis sertifikası gemid: The liferaft annual service certificate must be kept on board (PSC check).
Davit gravity ile veya hidrolik ile boat: The davit swings the boat out by gravity or hydraulically.
Single-fall davit ile hızlı iniş; suda q: Fast lowering with a single-fall davit; the fall is released with the quick-release hook in the water.
Motor start, mürettebat MOB veya raft'a: The engine is started and the crew heads for the MOB or the raft.
Recovery: boat altına horse-collar, hook: Recovery: the hook is connected (with the horse-collar/lifting strop where provided) and the boat is hoisted with the davit.
Vardiya başı: motor yakıt, battery, lash: At the start of the watch: check the engine fuel, battery, lashing and painter.
Launch alarm: 2 kişi rescue boat'a, davi: Launch alarm: 2 persons board the rescue boat, the davit operator opens the hydraulics and the boat is lowered into the water.
Suda motor start, görev yap, geri dön, h: Start the engine in the water, carry out the task, return, connect the hook and hoist with the davit.
Launch/manoeuvre drill ile annual/five-y: Carry out the launch/manoeuvring drill and the annual/five-yearly davit and release gear examinations/tests separately according to SOLAS III/19-20, MSC.402 and the maker's maintenance plan.
Yakıt eski, buji kirli, primer pump hata: Old fuel, dirty spark plug, primer pump fault
Renew the fuel, clean the spark plug, test the pump.
Yağ az, pompa zayıf, valf takılı: Low oil, weak pump, valve sticking
Add oil, service the pump, maintain the valve.
Boat altında personel olmamalı; düşme ri: No personnel may be under the boat; risk of falling.
Outboard motor egzozu CO içerir; uzun sü: Outboard motor exhaust contains CO; prolonged idle running must not be done in an enclosed space.
Recovery sırasında dalga koşullarına dik: Watch the wave conditions during recovery; a hook coming off can be fatal.
FRB/rescue-boat drill PPE'sini approved: Choose the PPE for FRB/rescue boat drills according to the approved boat manual, the risk assessment, water/weather conditions and the company procedure; verify the lifejackets and communication arrangements completely.
Deniz emniyetinin temel taşıdır. Yetersi: It is the cornerstone of safety at sea. Inadequate watchkeeping leads directly to collisions, groundings and loss of life. It is mandatory for maintaining safe operations under ISM Code Section 7.
Vardiya düzenini belirler, özel talimatl: Sets the watch arrangements, gives special instructions and is called to the bridge when necessary.
Vardiya süresince geminin güvenli seyri: Is fully responsible for the safe navigation of the ship during the watch.
Hava ve trafik koşullarına göre ayrı bir: A separate lookout is assigned according to the weather and traffic conditions. The OOW may be the sole lookout only in daylight, in open sea and in good visibility.
Manuel dümen gerektiğinde görev alır. Kı: Takes the helm when hand steering is required. Is kept continuously available in restricted waters.
STCW Kod A-VIII/2 – Vardiya tutma ilkele: STCW Code A-VIII/2 – Principles of watchkeeping
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 14 – Personel ve kö: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 14 – Ships' manning and bridge arrangements
ISM Kod Bölüm 7 – Gemi operasyonlarının: ISM Code Section 7 – Planning of shipboard operations
Pusula kursu ve autopilot ayarı kontrol: Compass course and autopilot setting checked
Sonraki waypoint mesafesi/ETA bilinir: Distance/ETA to the next waypoint known
Vardiya devrinde '5 dakika kuralı' uygul: The '5-minute rule' applies at the change of watch: the relieving officer stays on the bridge for at least 5 minutes to adjust to the dark and grasp the current situation. A hurried handover is never made.
Kısıtlı görüşte seyir için temel cihaz o: It is the basic instrument for navigation in restricted visibility, and its use for determining the risk of collision is required by COLREG Rule 7. Not using radar, or using it wrongly, is one of the main causes of marine accidents.
Radar/ARPA'yı etkin kullanır, hedefleri: Uses the radar/ARPA effectively, tracks targets and makes manoeuvring decisions when necessary.
Kısıtlı görüşte köprüüstüne gelir. CPA a: Comes to the bridge in restricted visibility. Sets the CPA alarm limits.
COLREG Kural 7 – Çatışma riski (Radar ku: COLREG Rule 7 – Risk of collision (use of radar)
COLREG Kural 19 – Kısıtlı görüşte seyir: COLREG Rule 19 – Conduct of vessels in restricted visibility
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19.2 – Seyir cihazl: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19.2 – Requirements for navigational equipment
STCW Kod A-II/1 – Radar ve ARPA yetkinli: STCW Code A-II/1 – Radar and ARPA competence
Range/gain/clutter ayarları mevcut koşul: Range/gain/clutter settings suited to the conditions
Kısıtlı görüşte tek bir range'de kalmayı: In restricted visibility, do not stay on a single range. Switch regularly between the 6 NM and 12 NM ranges so that you miss neither close nor distant targets. Suppressing sea clutter completely makes small targets disappear.
COLREG, denizde çatışmaları önlemenin te: COLREG is the basic legal framework for preventing collisions at sea. A breach can result both in criminal liability and in the rejection of insurance claims.
COLREG kurallarını anlık olarak uygular,: Applies the COLREG rules in real time and makes manoeuvring decisions.
Karmaşık trafik durumlarında köprüüstüne: Comes to the bridge in complex traffic situations and makes the final decision.
Reports changes in the bearings of targets.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 34 – Güvenli seyir: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 34 – Safe navigation
Radar kullanılarak çatışma riski değerle: Risk of collision assessed using radar (Rule 7)
Manevra yeterince erken ve belirgin yapı: Manoeuvre made in ample time and substantial (Rule 8)
COLREG kurallarını ezberlemek yetmez; he: Memorising the COLREG rules is not enough; you need to understand 'why' each rule exists. For example, the stand-on vessel's right to take action under Rule 17(a)(ii) applies only when the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action.
STCW Kod A-VIII/2 Bölüm 3-1, kaptanın uy: STCW Code A-VIII/2 Part 3-1 clearly defines the situations in which the Master must be called. Failing to call the Master when required is gross negligence and leads to disciplinary/criminal liability.
Kaptanı uygun zamanda, yeterli bilgiyle: Calls the Master in good time and with sufficient information. Does not hesitate.
Night/standing orders ile çağrılma krite: Writes the calling criteria clearly in the night/standing orders. Comes to the bridge immediately when called.
STCW Kod A-VIII/2, Bölüm 3-1 – Kaptanın: STCW Code A-VIII/2, Part 3-1 – Informing the Master
ISM Kod Bölüm 5 – Kaptanın yetki ve soru: ISM Code Section 5 – Master's responsibility and authority
Kıyı/sığlık yaklaşması var mı?: Is the ship approaching the coast/shoals?
Makine/dümen arızası bildirildi mi?: Has an engine/steering failure been reported?
Distress/urgency mesajı alındı mı?: Has a distress/urgency message been received?
Night orders'ta belirtilen durum oluştu: Has a situation specified in the night orders arisen?
Altın kural: 'Tereddüt ettiğiniz anda ka: Golden rule: 'Call the Master the moment you are in doubt.' The Master will not be angry with you, but if an accident happens because you did not call, the consequences are severe. Even experienced officers never relax this rule.
Logbook'lar yasal belgelerdir ve mahkeme: Logbooks are legal documents and are admissible as evidence in court. They are among the documents most often checked in PSC inspections. Missing or incorrect entries are a reason for fines and detention of the ship.
Keeps all records during the watch.
Günlük kontrol ve onay. Önemli olayların: Daily check and approval. Confirms that important events are recorded correctly.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 28 – Kayıt tutma yü: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 28 – Records of navigational activities
MARPOL Ek I, Kural 17 – Oil Record Book: MARPOL Annex I, Regulation 17 – Oil Record Book
MARPOL Ek V, Kural 10.3 – Garbage Record: MARPOL Annex V, Regulation 10.3 – Garbage Record Book
MLC 2006 – Çalışma saatleri kaydı: MLC 2006 – Records of hours of work
Saatlik mevki ve seyir bilgileri işlendi: Hourly position and navigation data entered
Logbook yazarken 'mahkemede okunabilecek: Write the logbook in the knowledge that it 'may be read in court'. Avoid vague expressions; use exact values instead of 'approximately' or 'about'. Times must always be given in 24-hour format and in UTC.
Pilot transfer sırasında düşme ve yarala: Falls and injuries during pilot transfer make it one of the highest-risk operations. SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 23 and IMO Res. A.1045(27) set the standards for pilot transfer arrangements.
Pilotla bilgi alışverişi, manevra soruml: Information exchange with the pilot, responsibility for manoeuvring, safety decisions.
Pilot merdiveni hazırlığı, güverte ekibi: Preparation of the pilot ladder, coordination of the deck crew.
Merdiven rigleme, güvenlik ekipmanları h: Rigging the ladder, preparing the safety equipment.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 23 – Pilot transfer: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 23 – Pilot transfer arrangements
STCW Kod A-II/1 – Pilot alma/bırakma yet: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in embarking/disembarking pilots
VHF ile pilot istasyonu ile temas kuruld: Contact made with the pilot station by VHF
Pilot merdiveni basamaklarını her kullan: Check the steps of the pilot ladder ONE BY ONE before every use. A cracked, loose or worn step can cause a fatal accident. With a freeboard of more than 9 metres, a combination arrangement (pilot ladder + accommodation ladder) is mandatory.
Kısıtlı sularda manevra alanı sınırlıdır: In restricted waters the room to manoeuvre is limited, the squat effect increases and traffic density is high. Most accidents happen in restricted waters.
Köprüüstünde bizzat bulunur. Tüm kararla: Is personally on the bridge. Bears the final responsibility for all decisions.
Mevki tespiti, radar gözetimi, trafik iz: Position fixing, radar monitoring, traffic monitoring.
Manuel dümen. Kurs talimatlarını tekrarl: Hand steering. Repeats and carries out the course orders.
Özellikle dar sularda bow lookout görevl: A bow lookout is assigned, especially in narrow waters.
İstanbul Boğazı geçişinde squat etkisi c: In the transit of the Istanbul Strait, the squat effect can become serious. At 12 knots, squat can reach 1.5 metres in shallow sections. Always include squat in your UKC calculation.
GMDSS, denizde can güvenliğinin son savu: The GMDSS is the last line of defence for safety of life at sea. It is mandatory for all Convention ships under SOLAS Chapter IV.
Distress çağrısı kararını verir. Genel a: Decides on the distress call. Decides on the general alarm and abandoning ship.
Maintenance and operation of the GMDSS equipment. Must hold a GOC (General Operator's Certificate).
Vardiyada GMDSS cihazlarını izler. Alına: Monitors the GMDSS equipment during the watch. Responds to calls received in accordance with procedure.
STCW Kod A-IV/2 – GMDSS operatör yetkinl: STCW Code A-IV/2 – GMDSS operator competence
Inmarsat-C açık ve mesaj kontrolü yapılı: Inmarsat-C switched on and messages checked
Distress prosedürü köprüüstünde asılı: Distress procedure posted on the bridge
EPIRB'in HID (Hydrostatic Release) ünite: Always check the expiry date of the EPIRB's hydrostatic release unit (HRU). An expired HRU may prevent the EPIRB from floating free if the ship sinks. It is usually replaced every 2 years.
Deniz kazalarının %80'inden fazlasında i: The human factor plays a part in more than 80% of marine accidents. Bridge discipline is the most effective tool for minimising it.
Köprüüstü disiplin kurallarını belirler: Sets and enforces the bridge discipline rules. Leads by example.
Disiplin kurallarına uyar. Closed-loop i: Follows the discipline rules. Uses closed-loop communication. Embraces a challenge culture.
STCW Kod A-VIII/2 – Köprüüstü kaynak yön: STCW Code A-VIII/2 – Bridge resource management
ISM Kod Bölüm 7 – Gemide operasyonların: ISM Code Section 7 – Development of plans for shipboard operations
En tehlikeli an 'sıkıcı' anlardır. Açık: The most dangerous moments are the 'boring' ones. In open sea, in fine weather and light traffic, attention wanders. It is exactly then that the lookout slackens and danger goes unnoticed. Build a routine check cycle: every 15 minutes, scan the horizon, check the radar and verify the position.
Güncel olmayan haritayla seyir etmek kar: Navigating with charts that are not up to date can lead to grounding or striking unknown dangers. Chart corrections are checked meticulously in PSC inspections.
Tüm harita düzeltmelerinden birinci dere: Is primarily responsible for all chart corrections.
Checks that the charts are kept up to date.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Navigational equipment and charts
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 27 – Haritaların gü: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 27 – Nautical charts and publications kept up to date
Son NtM bülteni tarih numarası kontrol e: Date/number of the latest NtM bulletin checked
Düzeltme kaydı harita üzerine işlendi: Correction record entered on the chart
Geçersiz haritalar (withdrawn) listeden: Withdrawn charts removed from the list
Harita düzeltmelerini biriktirmeyin. Her: Do not let chart corrections pile up. Do them regularly every week. When a PSC inspector picks a chart at random and looks at the last correction date, a delay of weeks is recorded as a serious deficiency.
ECDIS'in birincil seyir cihazı olarak ku: On ships where the ECDIS is the primary means of navigation, navigating with out-of-date ENCs can be as serious an offence as not using paper charts.
ECDIS güncelleme ve lisans yönetiminden: Is responsible for ECDIS updates and licence management.
Checks that the ECDIS is up to date.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19.2.1.4 – ECDIS ge: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19.2.1.4 – ECDIS requirements
ECDIS yazılım versiyonu güncel: ECDIS software version up to date
ECDIS'te 'base display' modunda seyir et: Do not navigate with the ECDIS in 'base display' mode. Use the Standard or All display mode. In base display much critical information (depth contours, wrecks, restricted areas) is not shown.
NtM takibi yapılmadan harita düzeltmesi: Charts cannot be corrected without following the NtMs. They are the starting point of the whole updating chain.
Is responsible for following up and applying the NtMs.
Son NtM bülten numarası kaydedildi: Number of the latest NtM bulletin recorded
İlgili NtM'ler haritaya uygulandı: Relevant NtMs applied to the charts
NAVAREA uyarıları acil NtM niteliğindedi: NAVAREA warnings are of the nature of urgent NtMs and must be entered on the chart immediately as T (temporary). Ignoring NAVAREA warnings received by NAVTEX or Inmarsat-C SafetyNET means heading for a known danger with your eyes open.
Navigational warnings hayat kurtarır. NA: Navigational warnings save lives. NAVAREA, coastal and local warnings have different areas of coverage, and all of them must be monitored.
Tüm navigational warnings takibi ve hari: Following up all navigational warnings and plotting them on the charts.
Vardiya sırasında gelen uyarıların anınd: Reading and assessing warnings received during the watch immediately.
Rota üzerindeki uyarılar haritaya işlend: Warnings on the route plotted on the chart
NAVTEX'te bazı mesaj kategorileri varsay: Some message categories may be disabled by default on NAVTEX. In particular, military exercise warnings (category L) and aids-to-navigation failures (category A) must always be enabled.
Pusula hataları tespit edilmezse gemi ya: If compass errors are not detected, the ship steers the wrong course. If the gyro fails, the magnetic compass is used as a back-up; without knowing the deviation, the magnetic compass is of no use.
Düzenli gyro/manyetik pusula karşılaştır: Compares the gyro and magnetic compasses regularly and records the errors.
Her vardiyada en az bir gyro kontrolü ya: Checks the gyro at least once every watch.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Navigational equipment
STCW Kod A-II/1 – Pusula kullanımı yetki: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in the use of compasses
Gyro/manyetik karşılaştırması logbook'a: Gyro/magnetic comparison entered in the logbook
Gyro hatası aniden değişiyorsa (1° üzeri: If the gyro error changes suddenly (a shift of more than 1°), the gyrocompass may be faulty. In that case, inform the engine room and prepare to change over to the magnetic compass. Navigating by the magnetic compass without a deviation card is not safe.
Draft bilgisi UKC hesabında, stabilite d: Draft information is critical for the UKC calculation, the stability assessment and meeting port entry conditions. Position fixing is the basis of navigational safety.
Düzenli mevki tespiti ve haritaya işleme: Regular position fixing and plotting on the chart.
Draft okumaları ve draft survey koordina: Reading drafts and coordinating the draft survey.
STCW Kod A-II/1 – Mevki tespiti yetkinli: STCW Code A-II/1 – Position fixing competence
Açık denizde saatlik, kıyısal sularda he: Hourly in open sea, every 15–30 minutes in coastal waters
Draft değerleri limandan ayrılırken kayı: Drafts recorded on departure from port
GPS'e körü körüne güvenmeyin. Her mevki: Do not trust the GPS blindly. Verify every position fix with at least one independent source (radar range, visual bearing). Do not forget to check the GPS antenna offset setting.
BNWAS, vardiya zabitinin köprüüstünde ak: The BNWAS verifies that the officer of the watch is active on the bridge and starts an alarm chain if not. The AIS enables ships to identify each other and reduces the risk of collision.
BNWAS'ın aktif çalışmasını sağlar. AIS v: Ensures that the BNWAS is active. Updates the AIS data.
AIS'in kapatılma kararı sadece master'ın: The decision to switch off the AIS rests only with the Master (on security grounds).
BNWAS aktif ve alarm zinciri çalışıyor: BNWAS active and alarm chain working
AIS dinamik verileri güncellendi (draft,: AIS dynamic data updated (draft, destination, ETA, navigational status)
AIS 'Navigational Status' alanını her du: Update the AIS 'Navigational Status' field at every change of status. If you anchor and do not change 'Under way using engine' to 'At anchor', other ships will think you are moving. It is also a parameter often checked by PSC.
Arızalı seyir cihazı, seyir emniyetini d: Defective navigational equipment directly threatens navigational safety. SOLAS Chapter V requires navigational equipment to be kept in working order.
Seyir cihazları bakım ve testlerin koord: Is responsible for coordinating the maintenance and testing of the navigational equipment.
Elektriksel arıza tespiti ve basit onarı: Electrical fault finding and simple repairs.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Carriage requirements for navigational equipment
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 25 – Cihazların bak: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 16 – Maintenance of equipment
IMO Res. A.694(17) – Seyir cihazları tes: IMO Res. A.694(17) – General requirements for shipborne radio equipment and electronic navigational aids
Tüm seyir cihazları çalışır durumda: All navigational equipment in working order
Radar manyetron ömrü genellikle 5.000-10: A radar magnetron usually lasts 5,000–10,000 hours. Monitor the signal level on the radar performance monitor (PM) regularly. A level below 50% indicates that the magnetron needs replacing.
Hatalı yük planı, aşırı stress, stabilit: A faulty cargo plan can lead to excessive stress, loss of stability, cargo damage and even the loss of the ship. It is governed by the ISM Code and SOLAS Chapters VI/VII.
Yük planının hazırlanması ve uygulanması: Is primarily responsible for preparing and carrying out the cargo plan.
Yük planını onaylar. Nihai sorumluluk ma: Approves the cargo plan. The final responsibility lies with the Master.
SOLAS Bölüm VI – Yük taşıma: SOLAS Chapter VI – Carriage of cargoes
SOLAS Bölüm VII – Tehlikeli yük taşıma: SOLAS Chapter VII – Carriage of dangerous goods
IMDG Code – Tehlikeli yük segregasyonu: IMDG Code – Segregation of dangerous goods
Loading computer'da stabilite kontrol ed: Stability checked on the loading computer
Loading computer sonuçlarına körü körüne: Do not trust the loading computer results blindly. A computer gives wrong results when wrong data are entered. Cross-check with tank soundings and draft readings. Especially on ships carrying heavy cargo, do not use the SF/BM check points without applying the corrections.
Yükleme/tahliye sırasında stabilite, muk: During loading/discharging, stability, strength and cargo safety must be monitored continuously. A faulty operation leads to cargo damage, loss of stability and injury to personnel.
Yükleme/tahliye operasyonunun genel koor: Overall coordination of the loading/discharging operation.
Supervision on site, soundings, draft readings.
Operasyonun genel güvenliğinden nihai so: Ultimately responsible for the overall safety of the operation.
Yükleme hızını kontrol edemediğiniz duru: Do not compromise safety even when you cannot control the loading rate (pressure from the terminal). The Master's authority under SOLAS is a legal right: the Master always has the authority to reduce the loading rate or stop the operation.
Kuru yük gemilerinde yük miktarının beli: It is the most common method of determining the cargo quantity on dry cargo ships. It is accepted as legal evidence in resolving commercial disputes.
Draft survey'in koordinasyonu ve hesapla: Coordination and calculations of the draft survey.
Bağımsız doğrulama (gönderen/alıcı adına: Independent verification (on behalf of the shipper/receiver).
IMO MSC/Circ.1228 – Draft survey prosedü: Draft survey procedures (UNECE Code of Uniform Standards and Procedures for the Performance of Draught Surveys of Coal Cargoes; not IMO MSC/Circ.1228)
Constant son güncelleme tarihi kontrol e: Date of the last update of the constant checked
Draft okumasını sakin suda yapın. Dalga: Read the drafts in calm water. If there are waves, read for a few minutes and take the average. In the trim correction, the second trim correction (from the change of MCT) is often ignored, but it makes a significant difference at large trims.
Doğru sounding verileri stabilite hesabı: Correct sounding data are critical for the stability calculation, fuel planning and determining the cargo quantity. Wrong soundings lead to calculation errors and stability problems.
Balast ve kargo tanklarının sounding koo: Coordination of soundings of the ballast and cargo tanks.
Soundings of the fuel and lubricating oil tanks.
SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Tank sounding düzenle: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Tank sounding arrangements
MARPOL Ek I – Yağlı suların izlenmesi: MARPOL Annex I – Monitoring of oily water
Sounding tape'i çekerken hızlı çekmeyin;: Do not pull the sounding tape up quickly; it causes wrong readings. Use sounding paste in oil tanks to make the reading clearer. Even if remote gauges are fitted, verify with a manual sounding at least once a week.
Cargo watch, kargo hasarının önlenmesi,: A cargo watch is essential to prevent cargo damage, ensure security and carry out the operation as planned.
Sets and supervises the cargo watch arrangements.
Cargo watch sırasında uyanık ve mobil ol: Stay alert and mobile during the cargo watch. Watching from one spot is ineffective. Make regular rounds and check all hatch openings, crane areas and the ship's sides.
Mooring, gemicilik mesleğinde en tehlike: Mooring is one of the most dangerous operations in seamanship. A parting rope/wire causes serious injury and death. The OCIMF MEG (Mooring Equipment Guidelines) standards must be followed.
Manevra sorumluluğu. Bağlama/çözme komut: Responsibility for the manoeuvre. Orders for making fast/letting go.
Leader of the forward or aft mooring team.
Güverte ekibini yönetir, halat/tel opera: Manages the deck crew and coordinates the rope/wire operation.
SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 3-8 – Mooring dü: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 3-8 – Towing and mooring equipment
SNAP-BACK ZONE'DA ASLA DURMAYIN. Kopan b: NEVER STAND IN A SNAP-BACK ZONE. A parting mooring rope/wire carries enough energy to cut a human body in two. These zones are marked on deck with yellow/red lines. Keep clear of them whenever any line is under tension.
Su sızdıran hatch cover, kargo hasarı, s: A leaking hatch cover is one of the most common causes of cargo damage, loss of stability and ship losses. P&I clubs attribute a large share of cargo damage claims to hatch cover leakage.
Hatch cover operasyonunun genel sorumlul: Overall responsibility for the hatch cover operation.
Actual management of the operation and maintenance.
International Load Line Convention – Hat: International Load Line Convention – Hatch cover standards
IACS UR S21 – Hatch cover mukavemeti: IACS UR S21 – Hatch cover strength
Hose test yapıldı ve geçti: Hose test carried out and passed
Hatch cover gasket'lerini kargoya baslam: Check the hatch cover gaskets BEFORE cargo work starts. Once a damaged gasket is found, replacing it under time pressure is very difficult. Carry a spare stock of gaskets between ports. An ultrasonic test gives much more reliable results than a hose test.
Kargo hasarı tazminat talepleri P&I kulü: Cargo damage claims are one of the biggest cost items for P&I clubs. Correct documentation is vital in establishing the ship's liability.
Kargo hasar takibi ve belgelenmesinden s: Is responsible for following up and documenting cargo damage.
Identifying and photographing damage on site.
Letter of Protest imzası ve P&I bildirim: Signing the Letter of Protest and notifying the P&I club.
Yükleme öncesi kargo durumu kontrol edil: Condition of the cargo checked before loading
Hasarlar Mate's Receipt'e işlendi: Damage entered on the Mate's Receipt
Mate's Receipt'e 'clean' (temiz) yazmak: Do not give in to pressure to sign the Mate's Receipt 'clean'. If the cargo is damaged, always add a remark. The wording 'apparent good order and condition' means that the ship accepts liability. This can later turn into a claim worth millions of dollars.
Denizde iş kazaları, karada endüstriyel: Occupational accidents at sea happen at several times the rate of industrial accidents ashore. Effective safety management minimises deaths and injuries.
ISM Kod kapsamında gemideki güvenliğin n: Has the final responsibility for safety on board under the ISM Code.
ILO C155 – İş güvenliği ve sağlığı sözle: ILO C155 – Occupational Safety and Health Convention
Risk assessment operasyon öncesi yapıldı: Risk assessment made before the operation
Near-miss raporu sisteme girildi: Near-miss report entered in the system
Near-miss raporlamayı teşvik edin, cezal: Encourage near-miss reporting; do not punish it. Every near miss is an accident that did not happen and a learning opportunity. According to Heinrich's pyramid, every serious accident is the result of 300 unsafe situations.
Denizde yangın, en tehlikeli acil duruml: Fire at sea is one of the most dangerous emergencies. Until help arrives, the crew must respond with their own resources. An equipment failure can end in disaster.
Yangın ekipmanlarının bakımı ve kontrol: Is responsible for the maintenance and inspection programme of the fire-fighting equipment.
Makine dairesi yangın sistemlerinin bakı: Maintenance of the engine room fire-fighting systems.
FSS Code – Yangın güvenlik sistemleri ko: FSS Code – International Code for Fire Safety Systems
STCW Kod A-VI/3 – İleri yangınla mücadel: STCW Code A-VI/3 – Advanced fire fighting
Fire hose ve lans çalışır durumda: Fire hoses and nozzles in working order
BA setleri tüpleri dolu, maskeleri temiz: BA set cylinders full, masks clean
BA (Breathing Apparatus) kullanmayı dril: Practise using BA (breathing apparatus) CONSTANTLY in drills. In a real fire, donning BA under adrenaline and stress is much harder. Every crew member must be able to move with BA in dark, smoke-filled conditions.
Abandon ship durumunda bu ekipmanlar hay: In an abandon ship situation, this equipment is the only difference between life and death. Poorly maintained equipment does not work when it is needed.
Can kurtarma araçlarının bakım programın: Is responsible for the maintenance programme of the life-saving appliances.
Drill organizasyonu ve etkinliğinin değe: Organising drills and assessing their effectiveness.
LSA Code – Can kurtarma gereçleri kodu: LSA Code – International Life-Saving Appliance Code
Immersion suit'ler sağlam ve yerinde: Immersion suits intact and in place
Lifeboat hook'ları (on-load release) den: Lifeboat on-load release hooks are among the most dangerous mechanisms in maritime history. Accidental opening during maintenance means DEATH. Hook maintenance must always be carried out by trained personnel with the safety pin fitted. Follow the IMO MSC.1/Circ.1206/Rev.2 guidance.
Periyodik kontroller, ekipman arızaların: Periodic checks allow equipment failures to be detected early and prevent 'detainable deficiencies' in PSC inspections.
Emniyet ekipmanı haftalık/aylık testleri: Coordinates the weekly/monthly tests of the safety equipment.
SOLAS Bölüm III, Kural 20 – Periyodik ba: SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 20 – Operational readiness, maintenance and inspections
SOLAS Bölüm II-2, Kural 14 – Yangın güve: SOLAS Chapter II-2, Regulation 14 – Fire safety tests
Testleri sadece 'kâğıt üzerinde' yapmayı: Do not carry out tests only 'on paper'. The PSC inspector will ask 'when was the last test?' and ask you to operate the equipment. Equipment that does not work + 'tested' in the records = a serious finding and possible detention.
Drill, mürettebatın acil durumlarda otom: Drills are the only way to make the crew respond automatically and correctly in emergencies. SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 19 requires drills at least once a month.
Drill emrini verir, performansı değerlen: Orders the drill and assesses performance.
Supervises the performance of the deck team.
Supervises the performance of the engine-room team.
SOLAS III/19 – Drill ve eğitim gereklili: SOLAS III/19 – Drill and training requirements (monthly abandon ship and fire drills, enclosed space entry and rescue drills, launching of lifeboats and rescue boats)
SOLAS III/30.2 – Yolcu gemilerinde hafta: SOLAS III/30.2 – Weekly drills on passenger ships
ISPS Code A/13.4 – Güvenlik drilleri (en: ISPS Code A/13.4 – Security drills (at least every three months)
ISM Code 8 / şirket SMS'i – Oil spill (S: ISM Code 8 / company SMS – Additional scenarios such as oil spill (SOPEP), MOB and blackout
Aylık abandon ship drill'i yapıldı: Monthly abandon ship drill carried out
En az 2 ayda bir kapalı mahal giriş/kurt: Enclosed space entry/rescue drill at least every 2 months
En az 3 ayda bir filika suya indirildi v: Lifeboat launched and manoeuvred in the water at least every 3 months
Gemiye katılan personele en geç 2 hafta: LSA/FFE training given to personnel joining the ship within 2 weeks at the latest
Drill'leri her zaman aynı senaryoyla yap: Always running drills with the same scenario prepares the crew only for that scenario. Add challenging conditions such as night drills, bad-weather drills and injured-person scenarios. Real emergencies never come at a 'convenient' time.
Muster list, acil durumda kargaşayı önle: The muster list is the basic organisational tool that prevents confusion in an emergency. It is mandatory under SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 37.
Muster list'in hazırlanması ve onaylanma: Has the final responsibility for preparing and approving the muster list.
Muster list'in güncellenmesi ve asılması: Updating and posting the muster list.
SOLAS Bölüm III, Kural 37 – Muster list: SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 37 – Muster list and emergency instructions
STCW Kod A-VI/1 – Temel güvenlik eğitimi: STCW Code A-VI/1 – Basic safety training
Muster list güncel (son personel değişik: Muster list up to date (latest crew change reflected)
Alarm sinyalleri muster list'te açıklanm: Alarm signals explained on the muster list
Muster list'i sadece kağıt üzerinde tutm: Do not keep the muster list only on paper; make sure every crew member memorises THEIR OWN duty. Reading the list during a drill wastes time. Ideally, when the alarm sounds, everyone runs straight to their station.
ISM Kod uyumsuzluğu, DOC (Document of Co: ISM Code non-compliance can lead to the withdrawal of the DOC (Document of Compliance) and SMC (Safety Management Certificate). This means the ship is barred from trading.
Gemideki ISM sisteminin uygulanmasından: Has the final responsibility for implementing the ISM system on board.
ISM Code (IMO Res. A.741(18)) – Tüm bölü: ISM Code (IMO Res. A.741(18)) – All sections
SOLAS Bölüm IX – ISM Code uygulaması: SOLAS Chapter IX – Implementation of the ISM Code
SMS dokümanları son versiyon: SMS documents in the latest version
ISM kayıtlarını 'denetim için' değil, 'ö: Keep ISM records 'to learn', not 'for the audit'. Every non-conformity is a learning opportunity. A record closed without a real root cause analysis lets the same problem happen again.
ISPS Code, gemilerin terörizm ve sabotaj: The ISPS Code aims to protect ships against the threats of terrorism and sabotage. Non-compliance may lead to the ship being refused entry to port.
Has the final responsibility for security on board.
ISPS uygulamalarını koordine eder. Genel: Coordinates ISPS implementation. Usually an officer is designated.
ISPS Code – Part A (zorunlu) ve Part B (: ISPS Code – Part A (mandatory) and Part B (recommendatory)
SSAS butonunun yerini TÜM zabitler bilme: ALL officers must know where the SSAS button is, but it must have a protective cover so that it is not pressed by accident. The SSAS sends a silent signal in a real security threat; it is a way of calling for help without alerting the attackers.
Limanda gemi, dışarıdan gelecek tehditle: In port, the ship is vulnerable to external threats (theft, sabotage, stowaways, terrorism). The security watch deters and detects these threats.
Plans and supervises the watch arrangements.
Ziyaretçi defteri mevcut ve kullanılıyor: Visitors' log available and in use
Security watch nöbetinde uyanık kalın. G: Stay alert on security watch. The gangway watch can be boring at night, but stowaways usually board quietly at night. The discovery of a stowaway costs the ship thousands of dollars and causes serious legal problems.
Corrosion is unavoidable in the marine environment. Without regular painting and rust maintenance, structural strength is lost, the ship may be detained in PSC inspections and her value falls.
Boya ve bakım programının planlanmasında: Is responsible for planning the painting and maintenance programme.
Boya ekibini yönetir, malzeme kontrolü y: Manages the painting team and checks the materials.
Paint in dry, mild weather. Do not paint when the relative humidity is above 85% or the surface temperature is not at least 3°C above the dew point; the paint will not adhere and will soon flake off, doubling the work.
Temiz güverte, kayma/düşme kazalarını ön: A clean deck prevents slips and falls, helps detect the onset of corrosion early and reflects the ship's general standard of maintenance.
Güverte yıkarken su hortumunu asla gözet: Never leave the water hose unattended while washing the deck; uncontrolled pressurised water can cause injury. Do not wash the deck in winter where there is a danger of freezing; ice makes the deck deadly slippery.
Kopan halat veya tel, personel için ölüm: A parting rope or wire is a deadly danger to personnel. If a worn rope/wire is not detected in time, a disaster can happen during mooring or cargo operations.
OCIMF MEG4 – Mooring halat/tel kriterler: OCIMF MEG4 – Criteria for mooring ropes/wires
Kopuk tel sayısı limit altında: Number of broken wires below the limit
ASLA tel halat ile sentetik halatı aynı: NEVER use a wire rope and a synthetic rope together on the same bollard or the same winch. Because their elasticity differs, the load is not shared equally; the stiffer wire rope takes most of the load and the risk of parting increases.
Yağlanmayan mekanik parçalar aşınır, ısı: Mechanical parts that are not lubricated wear, overheat and seize. A crane failure stops cargo operations; a winch failure endangers mooring safety.
Supervises the quality of the maintenance.
Grease gun ile yağlarken aşırı yağlama y: Do not over-grease when using a grease gun. Excess grease can force the seals and cause leaks. Use the correct grease type (marine grade, water resistant); the wrong grease gives no protection against seawater.
Yetersiz güverte aydınlatması gece opera: Insufficient deck lighting increases the risk of accidents during night operations. It is also critical that deck lighting other than the navigation lights does not impair the OOW's night vision at sea.
Seyirde gereksiz ışıklar kapatıldı: Unnecessary lights switched off at sea
LED aydınlatmaya geçiş yapın. Geleneksel: Change over to LED lighting. Conventional halogen bulbs fail very quickly in the marine environment and use a lot of power. LEDs last 10 times longer and save energy.
Seyir fenerleri, geminin diğer gemiler t: Navigation lights are the basic means by which other ships recognise a ship (her type, heading and status). A defective or wrong light can lead directly to a collision.
Seyir fenerleri ve işaretlerin sorumlulu: Responsibility for the navigation lights and shapes.
Cleaning the lights and replacing bulbs.
Fault finding in the navigation light circuits.
Fener paneli alarm testi yapıldı: Navigation light panel alarm test carried out
Fener arızası seyir sırasında acil durum: A navigation light failure at sea is an emergency. A set of spare (portable) lights must always be kept ready. Do not forget to test the 'fail-over to standby lamp' function of the light panel. On some older systems the automatic changeover may not work.
Plansız çalışma, verimsizlik, iş güvenli: Unplanned work leads to inefficiency, occupational safety risks and dissatisfaction among the crew. A good daily plan makes effective use of limited resources.
Prepares and approves the daily work plan.
İş planını güverte ekibine aktarır ve uy: Passes the work plan to the deck crew and manages its execution.
MLC 2006 – Çalışma saatleri düzenlemesi: MLC 2006 – Regulation of hours of work
İş güvenliği risk değerlendirmesi yapıld: Occupational safety risk assessment carried out
Çalışma saatleri MLC'ye uygun: Hours of work compliant with the MLC
Sabah toplantısını 5-10 dakikada tamamla: Finish the morning meeting in 5–10 minutes. Long meetings are inefficient. Stress the critical safety points, give clear tasks and ask 'any questions?'. Do not make plans that breach the hours of work/rest; an MLC breach is a PSC deficiency.
Doğru kişiyi doğru göreve atamak, hem em: Assigning the right person to the right task is critical for both safety and efficiency. Regular assessment of personnel competence is an ISM Code requirement.
Güverte personelinin yönetimi ve perform: Management and performance monitoring of the deck crew.
ISM Code, Bölüm 6 – Kaynaklar ve persone: ISM Code, Section 6 – Resources and personnel
Tecrübesiz personeli deneyimli personell: Pair inexperienced crew with experienced crew (buddy system). Do not give them tasks on their own. Every newcomer on board is a potential source of risk; carry out familiarisation training to really teach, not as a formality.
Disiplinsiz bir gemi, güvensiz bir gemid: An undisciplined ship is an unsafe ship. Establishing authority soundly directly affects both safety and team morale.
Has the final responsibility for discipline on board.
Monitors discipline in the deck department.
Monitors discipline in the engine department.
Alkol/uyuşturucu politikası tüm personel: Alcohol/drug policy communicated to all personnel
Disiplin, korku ile değil SAYGI ile sağl: Discipline is achieved through RESPECT, not fear. Be fair, consistent and transparent. Apply the same rules to everyone. A good Master listens to the crew but does not hesitate when a decision is needed.
Denizde iş kazaları, karadaki endüstriye: Occupational accidents at sea happen at 2–3 times the rate of industrial accidents ashore. Effective occupational safety management saves lives.
Coordination of the occupational safety system.
İş sorumlusu: Person in charge of the work
Bosun/İş sorumlusu: Bosun/person in charge of the work
En tehlikeli düşünce 'bunu her zaman böy: The most dangerous thought is 'we always do it this way and nothing has happened'. Assess every job as if it were being done for the first time. Complacency is the biggest killer at sea.
STCW Kod A-VI/1 ve ISM Code kapsamında z: It is mandatory under STCW Code A-VI/1 and the ISM Code. When new personnel work without knowing the ship, the risk of accidents multiplies.
Familiarization training'in koordinasyon: Coordinating familiarisation training and keeping records.
Introducing the deck crew to their duties.
Confirms that the familiarisation has been completed.
Muster station ve görev kartı gösterildi: Muster station and duty card shown
Familiarise new crew with the ship on the FIRST DAY. If they cannot find their way in an emergency, they may lose their life. Never postpone familiarisation. Even crew who join at night must do the tour first thing the next morning at the latest.
Sürekli eğitim, yetkinliğin korunması ve: Continuous training is essential for maintaining and developing competence. STCW and the ISM Code require training to be planned and recorded.
Eğitim programının onayı ve genel soruml: Approval of and overall responsibility for the training programme.
Eğitimi sıkıcı yapmayın. Gerçek kaza rap: Do not make training boring. Use real accident reports (MAIB, NTSB) as discussion topics. The crew learn far more from real events. The question 'could this have happened to us?' is a powerful learning tool.
PSC denetiminde ciddi eksiklik (deficien: If a serious deficiency is found in a PSC inspection, the ship may be detained. This means commercial loss, higher insurance premiums and loss of the company's reputation.
Has overall responsibility for PSC preparation.
Güverte tarafı ekipman ve kayıt kontrolü: Check of deck equipment and records.
Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – PSC prosedürleri: Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – PSC procedures
IMO Res. A.1138(31) – PSC prosedürleri: IMO Res. A.1138(31) – Procedures for port State control (PSC)
Tüm SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW, MLC gereklilikl: All SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW and MLC requirements
Logbook'lar güncel ve düzgün tutulmuş: Logbooks up to date and properly kept
Çalışma saatleri kayıtları uygun: Hours of work records in order
PSC müfettişinin ilk izlenimi çok önemli: The PSC inspector's first impression is very important. A clean gangway, a tidy deck, a friendly welcome and documents ready reduce the likelihood of an 'expanded inspection'. If the first impression is bad, the inspector will check everything.
Logbook'lar yasal belgelerdir. Mahkemede: Logbooks are legal documents. They are used as evidence in court, in insurance claims and in PSC inspections.
Vardiya süresince Deck Log Book tutulmas: Keeping the Deck Log Book during the watch.
Oil Record Book Part II (kargo operasyon: Oil Record Book Part II (cargo operations, tankers) and the Cargo Record Book.
SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 28 – Kayıt tutma: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 28 – Records of navigational activities
Deck Log Book güncel ve imzalı: Deck Log Book up to date and signed
Oil Record Book güncel: Oil Record Book up to date
Garbage Record Book güncel: Garbage Record Book up to date
Oil Record Book'u doldurmaktan ASLA kaçı: NEVER avoid filling in the Oil Record Book. PSC inspectors pay special attention to the ORB. A blank page or inconsistent entry raises suspicion of a MARPOL violation and triggers an expanded inspection. The time and quantity of every operation must be clear.
Checklist, kritik adımların atlanmasını: A checklist is the most effective tool for preventing critical steps from being skipped. Adapted from the aviation industry, this system has a proven record in preventing marine accidents.
Kendi sorumluluk alanındaki checklist'le: Uses the checklists for their own area of responsibility.
Checklist'i 'tick box exercise' olarak y: Do not treat the checklist as a 'tick-box exercise'. Mark each item only after actually checking it. Skipping items because 'I already know' has caused accidents even in aviation. Checklist discipline saves lives.
Geçersiz sertifika, geminin seferden men: An invalid certificate means the ship is barred from trading. Certificates are checked meticulously by the flag State and PSC.
Tüm sertifikaların geçerliliğinden nihai: Has the final responsibility for the validity of all certificates.
Kendi alanlarına ilişkin sertifikaların: Follows up the certificates relating to their own areas.
SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line Convention – Se: SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line Convention – Certificate requirements
Sertifika geçerliliğini bir Excel tablos: Track certificate validity with a spreadsheet or calendar so that no survey comes as a surprise. It is particularly critical not to miss the annual endorsement windows (±3 months). A missed endorsement makes the certificate invalid.
Etkin raporlama, kara ile gemi arasındak: Effective reporting keeps communication between ship and shore working properly and ensures ISM Code compliance.
Tüm raporlamanın doğruluğu ve zamanlamas: Is responsible for the accuracy and timing of all reporting.
Voyage raporu sefer sonunda tamamlanıyor: Voyage report completed at the end of the voyage
Noon report'taki verilerin DOĞRU olduğun: Make sure the data in the noon report are CORRECT. Under-reporting fuel consumption to 'make it look good' leads to serious problems later (charter party disputes, CII calculation errors). Report the real data.
Kapatılmayan deficiency, follow-up inspe: A deficiency that is not closed increases the risk of a follow-up inspection and detention. The ship's risk profile also rises and inspections become more frequent.
Güverte tarafı deficiency takibi ve düze: Following up and rectifying deck-side deficiencies.
Makine tarafı deficiency takibi ve düzel: Following up and rectifying engine-side deficiencies.
Overall follow-up and coordination with the company.
Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – Deficiency kodla: Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – Deficiency codes and procedures
Deficiency'yi sadece 'kapatmak' için değ: Work to really RECTIFY a deficiency, not just to 'close' it. If you make a superficial fix without a root cause analysis, the same deficiency will be written again at the next inspection. A repeated deficiency is a red flag for the inspector.
Yangın, geminin kaybına, personel ölümün: Fire can lead to the loss of the ship, the death of personnel and environmental disaster. A fast, organised response saves lives.
